import os
from dotenv import load_dotenv

load_dotenv()

TOKEN = os.getenv("BOT_TOKEN")

def _positive_int_env(name, default):
    raw = str(os.getenv(name, default)).strip()
    value = int(raw)
    if value <= 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"{name} має бути додатним цілим числом")
    return value

def _admin_ids_env():
    raw = str(os.getenv("ROM_ADMIN_USER_IDS", "")).strip()
    return frozenset(int(part.strip()) for part in raw.split(",") if part.strip())

ROM_ADMIN_USER_IDS = _admin_ids_env()
ROM_ADMIN_CRYSTAL_CREDIT_MAX = _positive_int_env("ROM_ADMIN_CRYSTAL_CREDIT_MAX", "10000")
ROM_ADMIN_CRYSTAL_DEBIT_MAX = _positive_int_env("ROM_ADMIN_CRYSTAL_DEBIT_MAX", "10000")

if not TOKEN:
    raise RuntimeError("BOT_TOKEN не знайдено у .env")

# ROM Stage 18.5.1: validated, fail-closed external links.
from urllib.parse import urlsplit as _urlsplit

_GAME_CHAT_URL_RAW = str(os.getenv("GAME_CHAT_URL", "") or "").strip()
_NEWS_CHANNEL_URL_RAW = str(os.getenv("NEWS_CHANNEL_URL", "") or "").strip()
_SUPPORT_URL_RAW = str(os.getenv("SUPPORT_URL", "") or "").strip()


def _validated_external_https_url(value, allowed_hosts):
    value = str(value or "").strip()
    if not value or len(value) > 2048:
        return None
    try:
        parsed = _urlsplit(value)
    except Exception:
        return None
    host = str(parsed.hostname or "").casefold()
    allowed = {str(item).casefold() for item in allowed_hosts}
    if (
        parsed.scheme.casefold() != "https"
        or not host
        or host not in allowed
        or parsed.username
        or parsed.password
        or parsed.fragment
    ):
        return None
    return value


GAME_CHAT_URL = _validated_external_https_url(
    _GAME_CHAT_URL_RAW, {"t.me", "telegram.me"}
)
NEWS_CHANNEL_URL = _validated_external_https_url(
    _NEWS_CHANNEL_URL_RAW, {"t.me", "telegram.me"}
)
SUPPORT_URL = _validated_external_https_url(
    _SUPPORT_URL_RAW, {"send.monobank.ua"}
)


def get_external_links_config():
    """Return only validated URLs; invalid or empty values stay disabled."""
    return {
        "game_chat": GAME_CHAT_URL,
        "news_channel": NEWS_CHANNEL_URL,
        "support": SUPPORT_URL,
    }

function Get-RelativePathSafe {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$BasePath,

        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$FullPath
    )

    $NormalizedBase = $BasePath.TrimEnd("\", "/")
    $BaseWithSeparator = $NormalizedBase + [System.IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar

    if ($FullPath.StartsWith($BaseWithSeparator, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
        return $FullPath.Substring($BaseWithSeparator.Length)
    }

    if ($FullPath.Equals($NormalizedBase, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
        return ""
    }

    return $FullPath
}

function Test-IsExcludedDirectory {
    param(
        [AllowEmptyString()]
        [string]$RelativeDirectory
    )

    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($RelativeDirectory)) {
        return $false
    }

    $Parts = $RelativeDirectory -split "[\\/]+"

    foreach ($Part in $Parts) {
        foreach ($ExcludedName in $ExcludeDirectoryNames) {
            if ($Part -ieq $ExcludedName) {
                return $true
            }
        }
    }

    return $false
}

function Test-IsExcludedFileName {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$FileName
    )

    foreach ($ExcludedName in $ExcludeExactFileNames) {
        if ($FileName -ieq $ExcludedName) {
            return $true
        }
    }

    foreach ($Pattern in $ExcludeFilePatterns) {
        if ($FileName -like $Pattern) {
            return $true
        }
    }

    return $false
}

function Test-IsAllowedTextFile {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [System.IO.FileInfo]$File
    )

    foreach ($AllowedName in $AllowedExactFileNames) {
        if ($File.Name -ieq $AllowedName) {
            return $true
        }
    }

    return ($AllowedExtensions -contains $File.Extension.ToLowerInvariant())
}

function Get-FileDecision {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [System.IO.FileInfo]$File
    )

    $RelativePath = Get-RelativePathSafe -BasePath $ProjectRoot -FullPath $File.FullName
    $RelativeDirectory = Split-Path -Path $RelativePath -Parent

    if (Test-IsExcludedDirectory -RelativeDirectory $RelativeDirectory) {
        return "ExcludedDirectory"
    }

    if (Test-IsExcludedFileName -FileName $File.Name) {
        return "ExcludedFileName"
    }

    if (-not (Test-IsAllowedTextFile -File $File)) {
        return "UnsupportedFileType"
    }

    return "Include"
}

function Get-SafeFileContent {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [System.IO.FileInfo]$File
    )

    try {
        return [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText(
            $File.FullName,
            [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false, $true)
        )
    }
    catch {
        try {
            return Get-Content -LiteralPath $File.FullName -Raw -ErrorAction Stop
        }
        catch {
            return "[FILE READ ERROR: $($_.Exception.Message)]"
        }
    }
}

Write-Host "Scanning project files..." -ForegroundColor Cyan

$AllFiles = @(
    Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $ProjectRoot -Recurse -File -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
)

$IncludedFilesList = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[System.IO.FileInfo]
$ExclusionStats = @{
    ExcludedDirectory  = 0
    ExcludedFileName   = 0
    UnsupportedFileType = 0
}

foreach ($File in $AllFiles) {
    $Decision = Get-FileDecision -File $File

    if ($Decision -eq "Include") {
        $IncludedFilesList.Add($File)
    }
    else {
        $ExclusionStats[$Decision]++
    }
}

$IncludedFiles = @($IncludedFilesList | Sort-Object FullName)
$ExcludedFilesCount = $AllFiles.Count - $IncludedFiles.Count

$IncludedSourceBytes = 0L
foreach ($File in $IncludedFiles) {
    $IncludedSourceBytes += $File.Length
}
$IncludedSourceMB = $IncludedSourceBytes / 1MB

$CreatedAt = Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss K"
$PowerShellVersion = $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString()
$Writer = $null

try {
    # UTF-8 with BOM is used for reliable display in Windows PowerShell 5.1 and text editors.
    $Utf8WithBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($true)
    $Writer = New-Object System.IO.StreamWriter($OutputFile, $false, $Utf8WithBom)

    $Writer.WriteLine("============================================================")
    $Writer.WriteLine("ROM PROJECT SAFE FULL DUMP")
    $Writer.WriteLine("============================================================")
    $Writer.WriteLine("")
    $Writer.WriteLine("Created: $CreatedAt")
    $Writer.WriteLine("Project root: $ProjectRoot")
    $Writer.WriteLine("PowerShell: $PowerShellVersion")
    $Writer.WriteLine("Scanned files: $($AllFiles.Count)")
    $Writer.WriteLine("Included files: $($IncludedFiles.Count)")
    $Writer.WriteLine("Excluded files: $ExcludedFilesCount")
    $Writer.WriteLine(("Included source size: {0:N2} MB" -f $IncludedSourceMB))
    $Writer.WriteLine("Per-file size limit: none")
    $Writer.WriteLine("")
    $Writer.WriteLine("EXCLUSION STATISTICS:")
    $Writer.WriteLine("- excluded directory: $($ExclusionStats.ExcludedDirectory)")
    $Writer.WriteLine("- excluded file name or pattern: $($ExclusionStats.ExcludedFileName)")
    $Writer.WriteLine("- unsupported file type: $($ExclusionStats.UnsupportedFileType)")
    $Writer.WriteLine("")
    $Writer.WriteLine("SECURITY AND SIZE EXCLUSIONS:")
    $Writer.WriteLine("- environment secrets and common key-store files")
    $Writer.WriteLine("- SQLite databases and WAL/SHM files")
    $Writer.WriteLine("- virtual environments")
    $Writer.WriteLine("- IDE metadata")
    $Writer.WriteLine("- Git and GitHub metadata")
    $Writer.WriteLine("- patch and backup history")
    $Writer.WriteLine("- reports, simulations and full MD documentation")
    $Writer.WriteLine("- caches and compiled files")
    $Writer.WriteLine("- binary and archive files")
    $Writer.WriteLine("- previous ROM_FULL_DUMP files")
    $Writer.WriteLine("")
    $Writer.WriteLine("==================== PROJECT TREE ====================")
    $Writer.WriteLine("")
    $Writer.WriteLine($ProjectRoot)

    if ($IncludedFiles.Count -eq 0) {
        $Writer.WriteLine("[NO FILES INCLUDED]")
    }
    else {
        foreach ($File in $IncludedFiles) {
            $RelativePath = Get-RelativePathSafe -BasePath $ProjectRoot -FullPath $File.FullName
            $Writer.WriteLine("- $RelativePath")
        }
    }

    $Writer.WriteLine("")
    $Writer.WriteLine("==================== FILE CONTENTS ===================")
    $Writer.WriteLine("")

    $CurrentIndex = 0

    foreach ($File in $IncludedFiles) {
        $CurrentIndex++
        $RelativePath = Get-RelativePathSafe -BasePath $ProjectRoot -FullPath $File.FullName

        $Percent = 0
        if ($IncludedFiles.Count -gt 0) {
            $Percent = [int](($CurrentIndex / $IncludedFiles.Count) * 100)
        }

        Write-Progress `
            -Activity "Creating ROM_FULL_DUMP.txt" `
            -Status "$CurrentIndex of $($IncludedFiles.Count): $RelativePath" `
            -PercentComplete $Percent

        $Writer.WriteLine("============================================================")
        $Writer.WriteLine("FILE: $RelativePath")
        $Writer.WriteLine("SIZE: $($File.Length) bytes")
        $Writer.WriteLine("LAST WRITE: $($File.LastWriteTime.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'))")
        $Writer.WriteLine("============================================================")
        $Writer.WriteLine("")

        $Content = Get-SafeFileContent -File $File

        if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($Content)) {
            $Writer.WriteLine("[EMPTY FILE]")
        }
        else {
            $Writer.Write($Content)
            if (-not $Content.EndsWith("`n")) {
                $Writer.WriteLine("")
            }
        }

        $Writer.WriteLine("")
    }
}
catch {
    Write-Progress -Activity "Creating ROM_FULL_DUMP.txt" -Completed
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "ERROR: Failed to create the dump." -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host $_.Exception.Message -ForegroundColor Red
    exit 1
}
finally {
    if ($null -ne $Writer) {
        $Writer.Flush()
        $Writer.Dispose()
    }
}

Write-Progress -Activity "Creating ROM_FULL_DUMP.txt" -Completed

if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $OutputFile -PathType Leaf)) {
    Write-Host "ERROR: Dump file was not created." -ForegroundColor Red
    exit 1
}

$DumpItem = Get-Item -LiteralPath $OutputFile
$SizeMB = $DumpItem.Length / 1MB

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "DONE" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "Dump created:" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host $OutputFile -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "Scanned files: $($AllFiles.Count)" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "Included files: $($IncludedFiles.Count)" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "Excluded files: $ExcludedFilesCount" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host ("Included source size: {0:N2} MB" -f $IncludedSourceMB) -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host ("Dump size: {0:N2} MB" -f $SizeMB) -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "No per-file size limit is applied." -ForegroundColor Yellow
Write-Host "The dump excludes secrets, databases, patch, backup, reports, MD and virtual environments." -ForegroundColor Yellow

"""Canonical defense policy approved in ROM Stage 18.14.2."""

DEFENSE_STAT_COEFFICIENT = 0.35
DAMAGE_DEFENSE_COEFFICIENT = 0.5
MINIMUM_DAMAGE = 1


def calculate_stat_defense(primary_stat):
    """Return the raw defense layer produced by STA or WIS."""
    return max(0.0, float(primary_stat or 0)) * DEFENSE_STAT_COEFFICIENT


def calculate_total_defense(item_defense, primary_stat):
    """Combine active item defense with the symmetric primary-stat layer."""
    return max(0.0, float(item_defense or 0)) + calculate_stat_defense(primary_stat)


def calculate_damage_after_defense(attack, defense):
    """Document the unchanged Stage 18 damage contract."""
    return max(float(MINIMUM_DAMAGE), float(attack) - max(0.0, float(defense)) * DAMAGE_DEFENSE_COEFFICIENT)

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Canonical pure policy for class-aware generated equipment primary stats.

This module contains configuration and validation only. It performs no SQL,
creates no items, and does not own equipment generation. Stage 18.17.2 will
connect this policy to the production generator.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from types import MappingProxyType

from data.stat_system_config import SUPPORTED_CLASSES

PRIMARY_STATS = ("str", "dex", "int", "wis", "sta")
PHYSICAL_CLASSES = frozenset({"warrior", "knight", "scout", "rogue"})
MAGICAL_CLASSES = frozenset({"mage", "priest"})
SUPPORTED_EQUIPMENT_KINDS = frozenset({"weapon", "armor", "off_hand", "jewelry"})

# Approved Stage 18.17 class identity. Weights are selection weights, not direct
# PATK/MATK coefficients and not additive stat budgets.
CLASS_STAT_WEIGHTS = MappingProxyType({
    "warrior": (("str", 60), ("sta", 30), ("dex", 10)),
    "knight":  (("sta", 50), ("str", 45), ("dex", 5)),
    "scout":   (("str", 45), ("dex", 45), ("sta", 10)),
    "rogue":   (("dex", 60), ("str", 30), ("sta", 10)),
    "mage":    (("int", 65), ("wis", 25), ("sta", 10)),
    "priest":  (("int", 50), ("wis", 40), ("sta", 10)),
})

# Main-hand keeps weapon identity while allowing every approved class scaling
# stat to appear. DEX remains rare on Warrior/Knight swords.
MAIN_HAND_STAT_WEIGHTS = MappingProxyType({
    "warrior": (("str", 65), ("sta", 25), ("dex", 10)),
    "knight":  (("str", 65), ("sta", 30), ("dex", 5)),
    "scout":   (("str", 45), ("dex", 45), ("sta", 10)),
    "rogue":   (("dex", 60), ("str", 30), ("sta", 10)),
    "mage":    (("int", 70), ("wis", 20), ("sta", 10)),
    "priest":  (("int", 55), ("wis", 35), ("sta", 10)),
})

# Explicit approved off-hand identities. Knight shield is STA + STR only.
OFF_HAND_STAT_WEIGHTS = MappingProxyType({
    ("warrior", "warrior_shield"): (("str", 65), ("sta", 35)),
    ("knight", "shield"): (("sta", 65), ("str", 35)),
    ("rogue", "dagger"): (("dex", 65), ("str", 35)),
    ("mage", "talisman"): (("int", 60), ("wis", 40)),
    ("priest", "talisman"): (("wis", 55), ("int", 45)),
})

# Jewelry is always target-class-aware. It never uses a universal all-stat pool.
JEWELRY_STAT_WEIGHTS = MappingProxyType({
    "warrior": (("str", 55), ("sta", 30), ("dex", 15)),
    "knight":  (("sta", 45), ("str", 45), ("dex", 10)),
    "scout":   (("str", 45), ("dex", 45), ("sta", 10)),
    "rogue":   (("dex", 60), ("str", 30), ("sta", 10)),
    "mage":    (("int", 60), ("wis", 30), ("sta", 10)),
    "priest":  (("int", 45), ("wis", 45), ("sta", 10)),
})

# Armor primary-stat selection is class-specific. PDEF/MDEF distribution remains
# owned by the existing cloth/leather/chain/plate defense profiles.
ARMOR_STAT_WEIGHTS = CLASS_STAT_WEIGHTS

CLASS_ARMOR_TYPES = MappingProxyType({
    "mage": "cloth",
    "priest": "cloth",
    "scout": "leather",
    "rogue": "leather",
    "warrior": "chain",
    "knight": "plate",
})

CLASS_MAIN_HAND_SUBTYPES = MappingProxyType({
    "mage": ("wand_1h", "staff_2h"),
    "priest": ("wand_1h", "staff_2h"),
    "scout": ("bow_2h", "crossbow_2h"),
    "rogue": ("dagger_1h",),
    "warrior": ("sword_1h", "sword_2h"),
    "knight": ("sword_1h",),
})

CLASS_OFF_HAND_SUBTYPES = MappingProxyType({
    "mage": ("talisman",),
    "priest": ("talisman",),
    "scout": (),
    "rogue": ("dagger",),
    "warrior": ("warrior_shield",),
    "knight": ("shield",),
})


def normalize_equipment_class(class_key: object) -> str:
    key = str(class_key or "").strip().lower()
    if key not in SUPPORTED_CLASSES:
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported equipment target class: {class_key!r}")
    return key


def _validate_weight_profile(profile: object, label: str) -> tuple[tuple[str, int], ...]:
    if not isinstance(profile, tuple) or not profile:
        raise ValueError(f"{label}: profile must be a non-empty tuple")
    seen = set()
    total = 0
    normalized = []
    for entry in profile:
        if not isinstance(entry, tuple) or len(entry) != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{label}: invalid weighted entry {entry!r}")
        stat_key, weight = entry
        if stat_key not in PRIMARY_STATS or stat_key in seen:
            raise ValueError(f"{label}: invalid or duplicate stat {stat_key!r}")
        if isinstance(weight, bool) or not isinstance(weight, int) or weight <= 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{label}: invalid weight for {stat_key}: {weight!r}")
        seen.add(stat_key)
        total += weight
        normalized.append((stat_key, weight))
    if total != 100:
        raise ValueError(f"{label}: weights total {total}, expected 100")
    return tuple(normalized)


def get_equipment_stat_weights(
    class_key: object,
    equipment_kind: str,
    *,
    item_subtype: str = "",
) -> tuple[tuple[str, int], ...]:
    """Return immutable weighted primary-stat choices for one target class."""
    cls = normalize_equipment_class(class_key)
    kind = str(equipment_kind or "").strip().lower()
    subtype = str(item_subtype or "").strip().lower()
    if kind not in SUPPORTED_EQUIPMENT_KINDS:
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported equipment kind: {equipment_kind!r}")
    if kind == "weapon":
        if subtype and subtype not in CLASS_MAIN_HAND_SUBTYPES[cls]:
            raise ValueError(f"Main-hand subtype {subtype!r} is not allowed for {cls}")
        profile = MAIN_HAND_STAT_WEIGHTS[cls]
    elif kind == "armor":
        profile = ARMOR_STAT_WEIGHTS[cls]
    elif kind == "jewelry":
        profile = JEWELRY_STAT_WEIGHTS[cls]
    else:
        if subtype not in CLASS_OFF_HAND_SUBTYPES[cls]:
            raise ValueError(f"Off-hand subtype {subtype!r} is not allowed for {cls}")
        profile = OFF_HAND_STAT_WEIGHTS[(cls, subtype)]
    return _validate_weight_profile(profile, f"{cls}:{kind}:{subtype or '*'}")


def get_allowed_equipment_stats(class_key: object, equipment_kind: str, *, item_subtype: str = "") -> tuple[str, ...]:
    return tuple(stat for stat, _weight in get_equipment_stat_weights(class_key, equipment_kind, item_subtype=item_subtype))


def validate_equipment_stat_policy() -> tuple[str, ...]:
    problems = []
    expected_classes = set(SUPPORTED_CLASSES)
    for label, mapping in (
        ("CLASS_STAT_WEIGHTS", CLASS_STAT_WEIGHTS),
        ("MAIN_HAND_STAT_WEIGHTS", MAIN_HAND_STAT_WEIGHTS),
        ("JEWELRY_STAT_WEIGHTS", JEWELRY_STAT_WEIGHTS),
        ("CLASS_ARMOR_TYPES", CLASS_ARMOR_TYPES),
        ("CLASS_MAIN_HAND_SUBTYPES", CLASS_MAIN_HAND_SUBTYPES),
        ("CLASS_OFF_HAND_SUBTYPES", CLASS_OFF_HAND_SUBTYPES),
    ):
        if set(mapping) != expected_classes:
            problems.append(f"{label}: class set mismatch")
    for cls in SUPPORTED_CLASSES:
        for kind in ("weapon", "armor", "jewelry"):
            try:
                profile = get_equipment_stat_weights(cls, kind)
                _validate_weight_profile(profile, f"{cls}:{kind}")
            except Exception as error:
                problems.append(str(error))
        for subtype in CLASS_OFF_HAND_SUBTYPES[cls]:
            try:
                get_equipment_stat_weights(cls, "off_hand", item_subtype=subtype)
            except Exception as error:
                problems.append(str(error))
    if get_allowed_equipment_stats("knight", "off_hand", item_subtype="shield") != ("sta", "str"):
        problems.append("Knight shield must allow exactly STA and STR")
    return tuple(problems)


def redistribute_primary_stat_budget(stats, class_key, equipment_kind, *, item_subtype="", chooser):
    """Redistribute existing positive primary-stat chunks by canonical class policy.

    The total primary-stat budget and number of generated chunks are preserved.
    `chooser` receives the immutable weighted profile and returns one stat key.
    """
    if not callable(chooser):
        raise ValueError("chooser must be callable")
    profile = get_equipment_stat_weights(class_key, equipment_kind, item_subtype=item_subtype)
    allowed = {stat for stat, _weight in profile}
    result = dict(stats)
    chunks = []
    for stat_key in PRIMARY_STATS:
        column = "bonus_" + stat_key
        value = int(result.get(column, 0) or 0)
        if value > 0:
            chunks.append(value)
        result[column] = 0
    if not chunks:
        return result
    for value in chunks:
        selected = str(chooser(profile) or "").strip().lower()
        if selected not in allowed:
            raise ValueError(f"chooser returned forbidden stat {selected!r}")
        column = "bonus_" + selected
        result[column] = int(result.get(column, 0) or 0) + value
    if sum(int(result.get("bonus_" + stat, 0) or 0) for stat in PRIMARY_STATS) != sum(chunks):
        raise ValueError("primary-stat budget changed during redistribution")
    return result


_POLICY_PROBLEMS = validate_equipment_stat_policy()
if _POLICY_PROBLEMS:
    raise ValueError("Invalid equipment stat policy: " + "; ".join(_POLICY_PROBLEMS))


__all__ = [
    "PRIMARY_STATS", "PHYSICAL_CLASSES", "MAGICAL_CLASSES",
    "CLASS_STAT_WEIGHTS", "MAIN_HAND_STAT_WEIGHTS", "OFF_HAND_STAT_WEIGHTS",
    "JEWELRY_STAT_WEIGHTS", "ARMOR_STAT_WEIGHTS", "CLASS_ARMOR_TYPES",
    "CLASS_MAIN_HAND_SUBTYPES", "CLASS_OFF_HAND_SUBTYPES",
    "normalize_equipment_class", "get_equipment_stat_weights",
    "get_allowed_equipment_stats", "redistribute_primary_stat_budget",
    "validate_equipment_stat_policy",
]

LOCATION_ORDER = [
    "start_path",
    "dark_forest"
]


def get_location(location_id):
    return LOCATIONS.get(location_id, LOCATIONS["start_path"])


def get_unlocked_locations(player_level):
    result = []

    for location_id in LOCATION_ORDER:
        location = LOCATIONS[location_id]

        if player_level >= location["unlock_level"]:
            result.append(location)

    return result


def is_location_unlocked(location_id, player_level):
    location = LOCATIONS.get(location_id)

    if not location:
        return False

    return player_level >= location["unlock_level"]

"""Canonical combat chance policy for ROM."""

CRIT_BASE_CHANCE = 5.0
CRIT_STAT_BASELINE = 10.0
CRIT_PER_STAT = 0.35
CRIT_MIN_CHANCE = 1.0
CRIT_MAX_CHANCE = 60.0
CRIT_SOFT_CAP_TRANSITION_STAT = 50.0
CRIT_SOFT_CAP_TRANSITION_CHANCE = 19.0
CRIT_SOFT_CAP_ASYMPTOTE = 60.0
CRIT_SOFT_CAP_RANGE = CRIT_SOFT_CAP_ASYMPTOTE - CRIT_SOFT_CAP_TRANSITION_CHANCE
CRIT_SOFT_CAP_K = CRIT_SOFT_CAP_RANGE / CRIT_PER_STAT

DODGE_BASE_CHANCE = 5.0
DODGE_PER_DEX_DELTA = 0.20
DODGE_MIN_CHANCE = 1.0
DODGE_MAX_CHANCE = 50.0
DODGE_SOFT_CAP_TRANSITION_DELTA = 40.0
DODGE_SOFT_CAP_TRANSITION_CHANCE = 13.0
DODGE_SOFT_CAP_ASYMPTOTE = 50.0
DODGE_SOFT_CAP_RANGE = DODGE_SOFT_CAP_ASYMPTOTE - DODGE_SOFT_CAP_TRANSITION_CHANCE
DODGE_SOFT_CAP_K = DODGE_SOFT_CAP_RANGE / DODGE_PER_DEX_DELTA

CRITICAL_DAMAGE_MULTIPLIER = 1.5


def clamp_chance(value, minimum, maximum):
    return max(float(minimum), min(float(maximum), float(value)))


def _calculate_crit_chance_with_soft_cap(total_stat):
    stat = float(total_stat or 0)
    if stat <= CRIT_SOFT_CAP_TRANSITION_STAT:
        return CRIT_BASE_CHANCE + max(0.0, stat - CRIT_STAT_BASELINE) * CRIT_PER_STAT
    excess = stat - CRIT_SOFT_CAP_TRANSITION_STAT
    return CRIT_SOFT_CAP_TRANSITION_CHANCE + CRIT_SOFT_CAP_RANGE * excess / (excess + CRIT_SOFT_CAP_K)


def calculate_physical_crit_chance(total_dex):
    return _calculate_crit_chance_with_soft_cap(total_dex)


def calculate_magical_crit_chance(total_wis):
    return _calculate_crit_chance_with_soft_cap(total_wis)


def calculate_dodge_chance(defender_dex, attacker_dex):
    dex_delta = float(defender_dex or 0) - float(attacker_dex or 0)
    if dex_delta <= -20.0:
        return DODGE_MIN_CHANCE
    if dex_delta <= DODGE_SOFT_CAP_TRANSITION_DELTA:
        return DODGE_BASE_CHANCE + dex_delta * DODGE_PER_DEX_DELTA
    excess = dex_delta - DODGE_SOFT_CAP_TRANSITION_DELTA
    return DODGE_SOFT_CAP_TRANSITION_CHANCE + DODGE_SOFT_CAP_RANGE * excess / (excess + DODGE_SOFT_CAP_K)


def calculate_enemy_crit_chance(player_sta):
    return clamp_chance(10.0 - (int(player_sta or 0) // 25), 0.0, 10.0)


def roll_chance(chance, rng):
    return rng.random() * 100.0 < clamp_chance(chance, 0.0, 100.0)

"""Canonical player HP policy for ROM Stage 18.12."""

STARTING_HP_BASE = 60
HP_PER_LEVEL = 20
HP_PER_STAMINA = 5
DEFAULT_STARTING_LEVEL = 1
DEFAULT_STARTING_STAMINA = 10


def calculate_base_max_hp(level, total_stamina):
    """Return base max HP before percentage modifiers such as armor refine."""
    safe_level = max(1, int(level or DEFAULT_STARTING_LEVEL))
    safe_stamina = max(0, int(total_stamina or 0))
    return max(1, STARTING_HP_BASE + safe_level * HP_PER_LEVEL + safe_stamina * HP_PER_STAMINA)


def get_starting_max_hp():
    return calculate_base_max_hp(DEFAULT_STARTING_LEVEL, DEFAULT_STARTING_STAMINA)

"""Canonical pure player EXP progression rules shared by production and simulation."""
from __future__ import annotations

BASE_EXP_BY_LEVEL = {
    1: 10, 2: 12, 3: 15, 4: 18, 5: 25, 6: 30, 7: 35, 8: 45, 9: 60, 10: 65,
    11: 75, 12: 85, 13: 95, 14: 110, 15: 120, 16: 135, 17: 150, 18: 170,
    19: 190, 20: 220, 21: 240, 22: 270, 23: 300, 24: 340, 25: 380,
    26: 420, 27: 460, 28: 520, 29: 600, 30: 600,
}

CONDITIONAL_MOBS_TO_NEXT_BY_LEVEL = {
    1: 50, 2: 150, 3: 300, 4: 500, 5: 1200, 6: 1800, 7: 2500, 8: 3500,
    9: 4500, 10: 5000, 11: 5500, 12: 6000, 13: 6000, 14: 6000, 15: 7000,
    16: 7000, 17: 7000, 18: 8000, 19: 8000, 20: 8500, 21: 8500, 22: 9500,
    23: 9500, 24: 9500, 25: 10500, 26: 10500, 27: 10500, 28: 12000,
    29: 12000, 30: 14000,
}

MAX_CONFIGURED_LEVEL = max(BASE_EXP_BY_LEVEL)

def get_base_exp_for_level(level: int) -> int:
    level = int(level)
    if level in BASE_EXP_BY_LEVEL:
        return BASE_EXP_BY_LEVEL[level]
    if level > MAX_CONFIGURED_LEVEL:
        return int(BASE_EXP_BY_LEVEL[MAX_CONFIGURED_LEVEL] * (1.12 ** (level - MAX_CONFIGURED_LEVEL)))
    return BASE_EXP_BY_LEVEL[1]

def get_exp_to_next_level(level: int) -> int:
    level = int(level)
    base_exp = get_base_exp_for_level(level)
    if level in CONDITIONAL_MOBS_TO_NEXT_BY_LEVEL:
        return int(base_exp * CONDITIONAL_MOBS_TO_NEXT_BY_LEVEL[level])
    mobs_required = int(CONDITIONAL_MOBS_TO_NEXT_BY_LEVEL[MAX_CONFIGURED_LEVEL] * (1.10 ** (level - MAX_CONFIGURED_LEVEL)))
    return int(base_exp * mobs_required)

def apply_exp_award(level: int, exp: int, amount: int, level_cap: int | None = None) -> dict:
    level, exp, amount = int(level), int(exp), int(amount)
    level_ups = 0
    while amount > 0:
        if level_cap is not None and level >= int(level_cap):
            break
        required = get_exp_to_next_level(level)
        missing = required - exp
        if amount < missing:
            exp += amount
            amount = 0
        else:
            amount -= missing
            exp = 0
            level += 1
            level_ups += 1
    return {"level": level, "exp": exp, "exp_to_next": get_exp_to_next_level(level), "level_ups": level_ups, "unapplied_exp": amount}

"""Pure candidate formulas for ROM Stat System 2.0.

This module has no database or systems dependencies. Candidate coefficients are
not connected to production gameplay until later shadow acceptance and switch stages.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
from types import MappingProxyType
from typing import Mapping

SUPPORTED_CLASSES = ("warrior", "knight", "rogue", "scout", "mage", "priest")
SUPPORTED_STATS = ("str", "dex", "int", "wis")
ROUNDING_POLICY = "round-half-away-from-zero"
UNKNOWN_CLASS_POLICY = "identity"

# Candidate A follows the technical-plan ordering.
_CANDIDATE_A = {
    "warrior": {"patk": {"str": 1.5}, "matk": {"int": 1.0}},
    "knight": {"patk": {"str": 2.0}, "matk": {"int": 1.0}},
    "rogue": {"patk": {"str": 0.5, "dex": 1.5}, "matk": {"int": 1.0}},
    "scout": {"patk": {"str": 0.5, "dex": 1.5}, "matk": {"int": 1.0}},
    "mage": {"patk": {"str": 1.0}, "matk": {"int": 2.0}},
    "priest": {"patk": {"str": 1.0}, "matk": {"int": 1.2, "wis": 0.8}},
}

# Candidate B follows the conceptual-plan warrior/knight ordering.
_CANDIDATE_B = {
    "warrior": {"patk": {"str": 2.0}, "matk": {"int": 1.0}},
    "knight": {"patk": {"str": 1.5}, "matk": {"int": 1.0}},
    "rogue": {"patk": {"str": 0.5, "dex": 1.5}, "matk": {"int": 1.0}},
    "scout": {"patk": {"str": 0.75, "dex": 1.25}, "matk": {"int": 1.0}},
    "mage": {"patk": {"str": 1.0}, "matk": {"int": 2.0}},
    "priest": {"patk": {"str": 1.0}, "matk": {"int": 1.2, "wis": 0.8}},
}

# Candidate C is normalized for the Stage 18.15.2 shadow comparison.
_CANDIDATE_C = {
    "warrior": {"patk": {"str": 2.0}, "matk": {"int": 1.0}},
    "knight": {"patk": {"str": 1.5}, "matk": {"int": 1.0}},
    "rogue": {"patk": {"str": 0.4, "dex": 1.6}, "matk": {"int": 1.0}},
    "scout": {"patk": {"str": 0.7, "dex": 1.3}, "matk": {"int": 1.0}},
    "mage": {"patk": {"str": 1.0}, "matk": {"int": 2.0}},
    "priest": {"patk": {"str": 1.0}, "matk": {"int": 1.1, "wis": 0.9}},
}

CLASS_SCALING_CANDIDATES = MappingProxyType({
    "current_identity": MappingProxyType({
        class_key: MappingProxyType({
            "patk": MappingProxyType({"str": 1.0}),
            "matk": MappingProxyType({"int": 1.0}),
        })
        for class_key in SUPPORTED_CLASSES
    }),
    "candidate_a": MappingProxyType({key: MappingProxyType({kind: MappingProxyType(values) for kind, values in value.items()}) for key, value in _CANDIDATE_A.items()}),
    "candidate_b": MappingProxyType({key: MappingProxyType({kind: MappingProxyType(values) for kind, values in value.items()}) for key, value in _CANDIDATE_B.items()}),
    "candidate_c": MappingProxyType({key: MappingProxyType({kind: MappingProxyType(values) for kind, values in value.items()}) for key, value in _CANDIDATE_C.items()}),
})


def normalize_class_key(value: object) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return ""
    return str(value).strip().lower()


def _number(value: object, name: str) -> float:
    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        raise TypeError(f"{name} must be an int or float, excluding bool")
    result = float(value)
    if not math.isfinite(result):
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be finite")
    if result < 0.0:
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be non-negative")
    return result


def round_stat(value: object) -> int:
    number = _number(value, "value")
    return int(math.floor(number + 0.5))


def validate_class_scaling(candidate: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Mapping[str, object]]]) -> None:
    if set(candidate) != set(SUPPORTED_CLASSES):
        raise ValueError("candidate must define exactly the six supported classes")
    for class_key in SUPPORTED_CLASSES:
        entry = candidate[class_key]
        if set(entry) != {"patk", "matk"}:
            raise ValueError(f"{class_key} must define patk and matk")
        for attack_kind in ("patk", "matk"):
            coefficients = entry[attack_kind]
            if not coefficients:
                raise ValueError(f"{class_key}.{attack_kind} must not be empty")
            for stat_name, coefficient in coefficients.items():
                if stat_name not in SUPPORTED_STATS:
                    raise ValueError(f"unsupported stat: {stat_name}")
                _number(coefficient, f"{class_key}.{attack_kind}.{stat_name}")


def get_candidate(name: str) -> Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Mapping[str, float]]]:
    key = str(name).strip().lower()
    if key not in CLASS_SCALING_CANDIDATES:
        raise KeyError(f"unknown scaling candidate: {name}")
    candidate = CLASS_SCALING_CANDIDATES[key]
    validate_class_scaling(candidate)
    return candidate


def _calculate_attack(
    class_key: object,
    stats: Mapping[str, object],
    attack_kind: str,
    candidate: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Mapping[str, object]]],
) -> int:
    validate_class_scaling(candidate)
    normalized = normalize_class_key(class_key)
    if normalized not in candidate:
        identity_stat = "str" if attack_kind == "patk" else "int"
        return round_stat(_number(stats.get(identity_stat, 0), identity_stat))
    total = 0.0
    for stat_name, coefficient in candidate[normalized][attack_kind].items():
        total += _number(stats.get(stat_name, 0), stat_name) * _number(coefficient, f"coefficient.{stat_name}")
    return max(0, round_stat(total))


def calc_patk(class_key: object, stats: Mapping[str, object], candidate_name: str = "candidate_c") -> int:
    return _calculate_attack(class_key, stats, "patk", get_candidate(candidate_name))


def calc_matk(class_key: object, stats: Mapping[str, object], candidate_name: str = "candidate_c") -> int:
    return _calculate_attack(class_key, stats, "matk", get_candidate(candidate_name))


def calc_max_hp_parity(level: object, total_sta: object, refine_percent: object = 0.0) -> int:
    from data.player_hp import calculate_base_max_hp
    base_hp = calculate_base_max_hp(round_stat(level), round_stat(total_sta))
    multiplier = 1.0 + _number(refine_percent, "refine_percent") / 100.0
    return max(1, round_stat(base_hp * multiplier))


def calc_pdef_parity(item_pdef: object, total_sta: object) -> int:
    from data.defense_policy import calculate_total_defense
    return int(calculate_total_defense(_number(item_pdef, "item_pdef"), _number(total_sta, "total_sta")))


def calc_mdef_parity(item_mdef: object, total_wis: object) -> int:
    from data.defense_policy import calculate_total_defense
    return int(calculate_total_defense(_number(item_mdef, "item_mdef"), _number(total_wis, "total_wis")))

from __future__ import annotations

import math

PRIMARY_STAT_KEYS = ("str", "dex", "int", "wis", "sta")
SUPPORTED_CLASSES = ("warrior", "knight", "rogue", "scout", "mage", "priest")
MANA_CLASSES = frozenset({"mage", "priest"})

PHYSICAL_ATTACK_SCALING = {
    "warrior": {"str": 1.00, "dex": 0.20, "int": 0.00, "wis": 0.00, "sta": 0.00},
    "knight":  {"str": 1.10, "dex": 0.10, "int": 0.00, "wis": 0.00, "sta": 0.00},
    "rogue":   {"str": 0.40, "dex": 0.80, "int": 0.00, "wis": 0.00, "sta": 0.00},
    "scout":   {"str": 0.65, "dex": 0.55, "int": 0.00, "wis": 0.00, "sta": 0.00},
    "mage":    {"str": 0.20, "dex": 0.00, "int": 0.00, "wis": 0.00, "sta": 0.00},
    "priest":  {"str": 0.20, "dex": 0.00, "int": 0.00, "wis": 0.00, "sta": 0.00},
}

MAGICAL_ATTACK_SCALING = {
    "warrior": {"str": 0.00, "dex": 0.00, "int": 0.20, "wis": 0.00, "sta": 0.00},
    "knight":  {"str": 0.00, "dex": 0.00, "int": 0.20, "wis": 0.00, "sta": 0.00},
    "rogue":   {"str": 0.00, "dex": 0.00, "int": 0.20, "wis": 0.00, "sta": 0.00},
    "scout":   {"str": 0.00, "dex": 0.00, "int": 0.20, "wis": 0.00, "sta": 0.00},
    "mage":    {"str": 0.00, "dex": 0.00, "int": 1.05, "wis": 0.15, "sta": 0.00},
    "priest":  {"str": 0.00, "dex": 0.00, "int": 0.90, "wis": 0.30, "sta": 0.00},
}

MAX_MP_SCALING = {
    "base": 100.0,
    "level": 20.0,
    "int": 1.0,
    "wis": 4.0,
}


def validate_stat_system_config() -> tuple[str, ...]:
    problems = []
    expected_classes = set(SUPPORTED_CLASSES)
    expected_stats = set(PRIMARY_STAT_KEYS)
    for label, matrix in (
        ("PHYSICAL_ATTACK_SCALING", PHYSICAL_ATTACK_SCALING),
        ("MAGICAL_ATTACK_SCALING", MAGICAL_ATTACK_SCALING),
    ):
        if set(matrix) != expected_classes:
            problems.append(f"{label}: class set mismatch")
        for class_key, coefficients in matrix.items():
            if set(coefficients) != expected_stats:
                problems.append(f"{label}/{class_key}: stat key mismatch")
            for stat_key, value in coefficients.items():
                if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)):
                    problems.append(f"{label}/{class_key}/{stat_key}: coefficient must be numeric")
                elif not math.isfinite(float(value)) or float(value) < 0:
                    problems.append(f"{label}/{class_key}/{stat_key}: coefficient must be finite and non-negative")
    if set(MAX_MP_SCALING) != {"base", "level", "int", "wis"}:
        problems.append("MAX_MP_SCALING: key mismatch")
    for key, value in MAX_MP_SCALING.items():
        if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)):
            problems.append(f"MAX_MP_SCALING/{key}: coefficient must be numeric")
        elif not math.isfinite(float(value)) or float(value) < 0:
            problems.append(f"MAX_MP_SCALING/{key}: coefficient must be finite and non-negative")
    return tuple(problems)


_CONFIG_PROBLEMS = validate_stat_system_config()
if _CONFIG_PROBLEMS:
    raise RuntimeError("Invalid stat system config: " + "; ".join(_CONFIG_PROBLEMS))

"""
Character management module - wrapper for systems.character_system
"""


def _character_system():
    from systems import character_system
    return character_system

    """Ініціалізує систему класів персонажів."""
    return _character_system().init_character_class_system()


# ==============================# CHARACTER NAME

def normalize_character_name(name):
    return _character_system().normalize_character_name(name)


def validate_character_name(name):
    return _character_system().validate_character_name(name)


def get_character_name(user_id):
    return _character_system().get_character_name(user_id)


def set_character_name(user_id, name):
    return _character_system().set_character_name(user_id, name)


def is_character_name_taken(name, exclude_user_id=None):
    """
    Перевіряє чи зайняте ім'я персонажа іншим користувачем.
    """
    from .connection import cursor
    
    from systems.character_system import normalize_character_name
    
    target_name = normalize_character_name(name)
    
    if not target_name:
        return False
    
    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT user_id, character_name
    FROM users
    WHERE character_name IS NOT NULL
      AND character_name != ''
    """)
    
    rows = cursor.fetchall()
    
    for row in rows:
        existing_user_id, existing_name = row
        
        if exclude_user_id is not None:
            try:
                if int(existing_user_id) == int(exclude_user_id):
                    continue
            except Exception:
                pass
        
        existing_normalized = normalize_character_name(existing_name)
        
        if existing_normalized.casefold() == target_name.casefold():
            return True
    
    return False


def needs_character_name(user_id):
    """Перевіряє чи потрібно встановити ім'я персонажа."""
    return _character_system().needs_character_name(user_id)


def needs_character_class(user_id):
    """Перевіряє чи потрібно обрати клас персонажа."""
    return _character_system().needs_character_class(user_id)

def spend_user_mp(user_id, amount):
    """
    Витрата MP для навичок.
    """
    from .connection import conn, cursor
    
    mp_data = get_user_mp(user_id)

    current_mp = mp_data.get("mp", 0)
    max_mp = mp_data.get("max_mp", 0)

    try:
        amount = int(amount)
    except Exception:
        amount = 0

    if amount <= 0:
        return {
            "success": True,
            "mp": current_mp,
            "max_mp": max_mp
        }

    if current_mp < amount:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": (
                f"❌ Недостатньо мани.\n\n"
                f"🔵 Потрібно: {amount} MP\n"
                f"🔵 У тебе: {current_mp}/{max_mp} MP"
            ),
            "mp": current_mp,
            "max_mp": max_mp
        }

    new_mp = current_mp - amount

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET mp=?
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (
        new_mp,
        user_id
    ))

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "success": True,
        "mp": new_mp,
        "max_mp": max_mp
    }


def restore_user_mp_to_full(user_id):
    """
    Повністю відновлює MP, якщо персонаж використовує ману.

    Для не-mana класів нічого не робить.
    """
    from .connection import conn, cursor
    from data.classes import CLASS_CONFIGS
    
    init_character_class_system()

    class_key = get_character_class(user_id)
    resource_type = CLASS_CONFIGS.get(class_key, {}).get("resource", "")

    if resource_type != "mana":
        return {
            "success": True,
            "restored": False,
            "mp": 0,
            "max_mp": 0
        }

    mp_data = get_user_mp(user_id)
    max_mp = mp_data.get("max_mp", 0)

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET mp=?
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (
        max_mp,
        user_id
    ))

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "success": True,
        "restored": True,
        "mp": max_mp,
        "max_mp": max_mp
    }


def get_max_mp(user_id):
    return _character_system().get_max_mp(user_id)

# ROM 17.19.1 MANA POTION PRICE BALANCE
"""
Database connection and initialization module.
"""

import sqlite3

# ==============================
# 🔌 ПІДКЛЮЧЕННЯ ДО БАЗИ
# ==============================

conn = sqlite3.connect("game.db", check_same_thread=False)
cursor = conn.cursor()


# ==============================
# ✅ EQUIPMENT CONFIG
# ==============================

DEFAULT_BAG_SLOTS = 60  # ROM 17.8.1 BASE BAG CAPACITY 60

SLOT_ORDER = [
    "main_hand",
    "off_hand",
    "helmet",
    "shoulders",
    "chest",
    "gloves",
    "legs",
    "boots",
    "necklace",
    "ring"
]


# ==============================
# ✅ DB INIT
# ==============================

def init_db():
    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
        user_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,

        hp INTEGER,
        max_hp INTEGER,
        level INTEGER,
        exp INTEGER,
        gold REAL,
        kills INTEGER,
        bag_slots INTEGER,
        current_location TEXT,

        str INTEGER,
        dex INTEGER,
        intelligence INTEGER,
        wis INTEGER,
        sta INTEGER,

        equipped_weapon INTEGER,
        equipped_armor INTEGER
    )
    """)

    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS inventory (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        user_id INTEGER,
        item_id INTEGER,
        quantity INTEGER,
        durability INTEGER
    ,
        refine_level INTEGER DEFAULT 0
    )
    """)

    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS items (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
        name TEXT,
        type TEXT,
        rarity TEXT,
        category TEXT,

        slot_key TEXT,
        weapon_hands INTEGER,

        max_stack INTEGER,
        sell_price REAL,

        bonus_str INTEGER,
        bonus_dex INTEGER,
        bonus_int INTEGER,
        bonus_wis INTEGER,
        bonus_sta INTEGER,

        pdef INTEGER,
        mdef INTEGER
    ,
        item_subtype TEXT DEFAULT ''
    ,
        armor_type TEXT DEFAULT ''
    ,
        weapon_min_damage INTEGER DEFAULT 0
    ,
        weapon_max_damage INTEGER DEFAULT 0
    ,
        weapon_min_magic_damage INTEGER DEFAULT 0
    ,
        weapon_max_magic_damage INTEGER DEFAULT 0
    ,
        weapon_attack_type TEXT DEFAULT ''
    ,
        shop_preview_owner INTEGER DEFAULT NULL
    ,
        shop_preview_price INTEGER DEFAULT 0
    )
    """)

    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS equipment_slots (
        user_id INTEGER,
        slot_key TEXT,
        inventory_id INTEGER,
        PRIMARY KEY (user_id, slot_key)
    )
    """)

    migrations = [
        ("users", "gold", "REAL DEFAULT 0"),
        ("users", "kills", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ("users", "bag_slots", "INTEGER DEFAULT 60"),
        ("users", "current_location", "TEXT DEFAULT 'start_path'"),

        ("inventory", "quantity", "INTEGER DEFAULT 1"),
        ("inventory", "durability", "INTEGER DEFAULT NULL"),

        ("items", "category", "TEXT DEFAULT 'equipment'"),
        ("items", "slot_key", "TEXT DEFAULT NULL"),
        ("items", "weapon_hands", "INTEGER DEFAULT 1"),
        ("items", "max_stack", "INTEGER DEFAULT 1"),
        ("items", "sell_price", "REAL DEFAULT 0"),
        ("items", "bonus_sta", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ("items", "pdef", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ("items", "mdef", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ("items", "item_level", "INTEGER DEFAULT 1"),
        ("items", "is_generated", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),

        ("users", "daily_contracts_completed", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ("users", "daily_contract_date", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),

        ("users", "energy", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ("users", "last_energy_update", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
        ("users", "energy_full_notified", "INTEGER DEFAULT 1"),

        ("users", "last_hp_regen_update", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
        ("users", "hp_full_notified", "INTEGER DEFAULT 1"),
        ("users", "daily_hunts", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ("users", "daily_hunts_date", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
    ]

    for table, column, column_type in migrations:
        try:
            cursor.execute(f"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD COLUMN {column} {column_type}")
        except Exception:
            pass

    cursor.execute("UPDATE users SET gold = 0 WHERE gold IS NULL")
    cursor.execute("UPDATE users SET kills = 0 WHERE kills IS NULL")
    cursor.execute(
        "UPDATE users SET bag_slots = ? WHERE bag_slots IS NULL",
        (DEFAULT_BAG_SLOTS,),
    )  # ROM 17.8.1.1 PARAMETERIZED BAG DEFAULT

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET current_location = 'start_path'
    WHERE current_location IS NULL OR current_location = ''
    """)

    cursor.execute("UPDATE inventory SET quantity = 1 WHERE quantity IS NULL")

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE inventory
    SET durability = 100
    WHERE durability IS NULL
      AND item_id IN (
          SELECT id FROM items WHERE category = 'equipment'
      )
    """)

    conn.commit()

    """
    items = [
        (401, "🔴 Мале зілля здоров'я", "potion_hp", "common", "potion", None, 1, 10, 1.00, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0),
        (402, "🔵 Мале зілля мани", "potion_mp", "common", "potion", None, 1, 10, 0.80, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0),
        (403, "🔴 Середнє зілля здоров'я", "potion_hp_medium", "common", "potion", None, 1, 10, 3.00, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0),
        (404, "🔵 Середнє зілля мани", "potion_mp_medium", "common", "potion", None, 1, 10, 2.50, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0),
    ]

    for item in items:
        cursor.execute("""
        INSERT INTO items (
            id, name, type, rarity, category,
            slot_key, weapon_hands,
            max_stack, sell_price,
            bonus_str, bonus_dex, bonus_int, bonus_wis, bonus_sta,
            pdef, mdef
        )
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET
            name=excluded.name,
            type=excluded.type,
            rarity=excluded.rarity,
            category=excluded.category,
            slot_key=excluded.slot_key,
            weapon_hands=excluded.weapon_hands,
            max_stack=excluded.max_stack,
            sell_price=excluded.sell_price,
            bonus_str=excluded.bonus_str,
            bonus_dex=excluded.bonus_dex,
            bonus_int=excluded.bonus_int,
            bonus_wis=excluded.bonus_wis,
            bonus_sta=excluded.bonus_sta,
            pdef=excluded.pdef,
            mdef=excluded.mdef
        """, item)

    conn.commit()

def get_daily_today_str():

    return date.today().isoformat()

def init_daily_quest_system():
    """
    Щоденні завдання v1.

    Поточна версія:
    - 1 завдання на день

    """

        user_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
        quest_date TEXT,
        quest_id TEXT,
        progress INTEGER,
        target_count INTEGER,
        completed INTEGER,
        reward_claimed INTEGER
    )
    """)

    conn.commit()

def reset_daily_quest_if_needed(user_id):
    init_daily_quest_system()

    today = get_daily_today_str()

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT quest_date
    FROM user_daily_quests
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,))

    row = cursor.fetchone()

    if not row:
        cursor.execute("""
        INSERT INTO user_daily_quests (
            user_id,
            quest_date,
            quest_id,
            progress,
            target_count,
            completed,
            reward_claimed
        )
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        """, (
            user_id,
            today,
            DAILY_QUEST_ID_KILL_MONSTERS,
            0,
            DAILY_QUEST_TARGET_KILLS,
            0,
            0
        ))

        conn.commit()
        return

    quest_date = row[0] or ""

    if quest_date != today:
        cursor.execute("""
        UPDATE user_daily_quests
        SET
            quest_date=?,
            quest_id=?,
            progress=0,
            target_count=?,
            completed=0,
            reward_claimed=0
        WHERE user_id=?
        """, (
            today,
            DAILY_QUEST_ID_KILL_MONSTERS,
            DAILY_QUEST_TARGET_KILLS,
            user_id
        ))

        conn.commit()

def get_daily_quest_status(user_id):
    reset_daily_quest_if_needed(user_id)

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT
        quest_date,
        quest_id,
        progress,
        target_count,
        completed,
        reward_claimed
    FROM user_daily_quests
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,))

    row = cursor.fetchone()

    if not row:
        return {
            "exists": False,
            "message": "❌ Щоденне завдання не знайдено."
        }

    (
        quest_date,
        quest_id,
        progress,
        target_count,
        completed,
        reward_claimed
    ) = row

    return {
        "exists": True,
        "quest_date": quest_date,
        "quest_id": quest_id,
        "progress": progress or 0,
        "target_count": target_count or DAILY_QUEST_TARGET_KILLS,
        "completed": bool(completed),
        "reward_claimed": bool(reward_claimed),
        "reward_item_id": DAILY_QUEST_REWARD_ITEM_ID,
        "reward_quantity": DAILY_QUEST_REWARD_QUANTITY
    }

def get_bag_capacity(user_id):
    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT bag_slots
    FROM users
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,))

    row = cursor.fetchone()

    if not row or row[0] is None:
        return DEFAULT_BAG_SLOTS

    try:
        capacity = int(row[0] or DEFAULT_BAG_SLOTS)
    except Exception:
        capacity = DEFAULT_BAG_SLOTS
    return max(DEFAULT_BAG_SLOTS, capacity)

def get_inventory_used_slots(user_id):
    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM inventory
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,))

    row = cursor.fetchone()

    if not row:
        return 0

    return row[0]

def get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, base=1.0):
    multiplier = DYNAMIC_STAT_MULTIPLIERS.get(rarity, 1.0)
    value = int(round(item_level * base * multiplier))

    return max(1, value)

def get_dynamic_sell_price(item_level, rarity):
    multiplier = DYNAMIC_SELL_MULTIPLIERS.get(rarity, 0.30)

    return round(max(0.10, item_level * multiplier), 2)

def set_player_level_for_test(user_id, target_level):
    try:
        target_level = int(target_level)
    except Exception:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Рівень має бути числом."
        }

    if target_level < 1:
        target_level = 1

    if target_level > 30:
        target_level = 30

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT user_id
    FROM users
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,))

    row = cursor.fetchone()

    if not row:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Персонажа не знайдено. Спочатку натисни /start."
        }

    base_stat = 10 + (target_level - 1)

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET
        level=?,
        exp=0,
        str=?,
        dex=?,
        intelligence=?,
        wis=?,
        sta=?
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (
        target_level,
        base_stat,
        base_stat,
        base_stat,
        base_stat,
        base_stat,
        user_id
    ))

    conn.commit()

    new_max_hp = get_max_hp(user_id)

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET
        max_hp=?,
        hp=?
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (
        new_max_hp,
        new_max_hp,
        user_id
    ))

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "success": True,
        "level": target_level,
        "base_stat": base_stat,
        "max_hp": new_max_hp,
        "message": (
            f"✅ DEV: рівень персонажа встановлено.\n\n"
            f"🏆 Рівень: {target_level}\n"
            f"✨ Досвід: 0/{get_exp_to_next_level(target_level)}\n"
            f"💪 Базові характеристики: {base_stat}\n"
            f"❤️ HP: {new_max_hp}/{new_max_hp}"
        )
    }

_DEV_RESET_HERO_LOCK = None


def _get_dev_reset_hero_lock():
    global _DEV_RESET_HERO_LOCK
    if _DEV_RESET_HERO_LOCK is None:
        import threading
        _DEV_RESET_HERO_LOCK = threading.RLock()
    return _DEV_RESET_HERO_LOCK

def _dev_reset_table_exists(table_name):
    row = cursor.execute(
        "SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name=?",
        (str(table_name),),
    ).fetchone()
    return bool(row)

def _dev_reset_table_columns(table_name):
    if not _dev_reset_table_exists(table_name):
        return set()
    return {str(row[1]) for row in cursor.execute(f'PRAGMA table_info("{table_name}")').fetchall()}

def _dev_reset_delete_by_user_columns(table_name, user_id, candidate_columns):
    columns = _dev_reset_table_columns(table_name)
    matched = [column for column in candidate_columns if column in columns]
    if not matched:
        return 0
    where_sql = " OR ".join(f'"{column}"=?' for column in matched)
    result = cursor.execute(
        f'DELETE FROM "{table_name}" WHERE {where_sql}',
        tuple(int(user_id) for _ in matched),
    )
    return max(0, int(result.rowcount or 0))

def reset_hero_for_test(user_id):
    """Atomically reset character progress without deleting the users parent row.

    Keeping users.user_id in place prevents RESTRICT foreign keys in trade and
    interaction history from breaking the reset. All mutations are enclosed in
    one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction. Every failure performs rollback so the
    shared SQLite connection cannot retain a write lock.
    """
    import time
    from datetime import datetime

    user_id = int(user_id)
    lock = _get_dev_reset_hero_lock()
    last_error = None

    with lock:
        for attempt in range(1, 4):
            stage = "prepare"
            deleted = {}
            try:
                try:
                    conn.rollback()
                except Exception:
                    pass

                conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON")
                conn.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout=30000")
                stage = "begin_immediate"
                conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")

                row = cursor.execute(
                    "SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE user_id=?",
                    (user_id,),
                ).fetchone()
                if not row:
                    conn.rollback()
                    return {
                        "success": False,
                        "message": "❌ Персонажа не знайдено. Спочатку натисни /start.",
                    }

                # Trade children must be removed before player_trades because
                # some installations can have foreign_keys disabled historically.
                stage = "trade_cleanup"
                trade_ids = []
                if _dev_reset_table_exists("player_trades"):
                    trade_ids = [
                        int(row[0])
                        for row in cursor.execute(
                            "SELECT id FROM player_trades WHERE initiator_user_id=? OR recipient_user_id=?",
                            (user_id, user_id),
                        ).fetchall()
                    ]
                if trade_ids:
                    placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in trade_ids)
                    for table_name in (
                        "inventory_reservations",
                        "player_trade_offers",
                        "player_trade_events",
                        "player_trade_history",
                    ):
                        columns = _dev_reset_table_columns(table_name)
                        if "trade_id" in columns:
                            result = cursor.execute(
                                f'DELETE FROM "{table_name}" WHERE trade_id IN ({placeholders})',
                                tuple(trade_ids),
                            )
                            deleted[table_name] = deleted.get(table_name, 0) + max(0, int(result.rowcount or 0))
                    result = cursor.execute(
                        f'DELETE FROM player_trades WHERE id IN ({placeholders})',
                        tuple(trade_ids),
                    )
                    deleted["player_trades"] = max(0, int(result.rowcount or 0))

                stage = "user_child_cleanup"
                user_column_names = (
                    "user_id",
                    "owner_user_id",
                    "initiator_user_id",
                    "recipient_user_id",
                    "actor_user_id",
                    "challenger_user_id",
                    "recipient_id",
                    "initiator_id",
                    "player_one_user_id",
                    "player_two_user_id",
                    "winner_user_id",
                    "loser_user_id",
                )
                protected_tables = {"users", "items", "inventory", "equipment_slots", "inventory_runes", "crystal_wallets", "crystal_transactions"}
                table_names = [
                    str(row[0])
                    for row in cursor.execute(
                        "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%'"
                    ).fetchall()
                ]
                for table_name in table_names:
                    if table_name in protected_tables:
                        continue
                    count = _dev_reset_delete_by_user_columns(table_name, user_id, user_column_names)
                    if count:
                        deleted[table_name] = deleted.get(table_name, 0) + count

                stage = "inventory_dependency_cleanup"
                if _dev_reset_table_exists("inventory_runes"):
                    result = cursor.execute(
                        "DELETE FROM inventory_runes WHERE inventory_id IN (SELECT id FROM inventory WHERE user_id=?)",
                        (user_id,),
                    )
                    deleted["inventory_runes"] = max(0, int(result.rowcount or 0))
                if _dev_reset_table_exists("inventory_reservations"):
                    result = cursor.execute(
                        "DELETE FROM inventory_reservations WHERE user_id=? OR inventory_id IN (SELECT id FROM inventory WHERE user_id=?)",
                        (user_id, user_id),
                    )
                    deleted["inventory_reservations"] = deleted.get("inventory_reservations", 0) + max(0, int(result.rowcount or 0))
                if _dev_reset_table_exists("equipment_slots"):
                    result = cursor.execute("DELETE FROM equipment_slots WHERE user_id=?", (user_id,))
                    deleted["equipment_slots"] = max(0, int(result.rowcount or 0))
                if _dev_reset_table_exists("inventory"):
                    result = cursor.execute("DELETE FROM inventory WHERE user_id=?", (user_id,))
                    deleted["inventory"] = max(0, int(result.rowcount or 0))

                stage = "user_in_place_reset"
                now_text = datetime.now().isoformat()
                defaults = {
                    "hp": 170,
                    "max_hp": 170,
                    "level": 1,
                    "exp": 0,
                    "gold": 0.0,
                    "kills": 0,
                    "bag_slots": max(int(globals().get("DEFAULT_BAG_SLOTS", 60)), int(get_bag_capacity(user_id))),  # ROM 17.32.1 preserve account entitlement
                    "current_location": "start_path",
                    "str": 10,
                    "dex": 10,
                    "intelligence": 10,
                    "wis": 10,
                    "sta": 10,
                    "equipped_weapon": None,
                    "equipped_armor": None,
                    "daily_contracts_completed": 0,
                    "daily_contract_date": "",
                    "daily_hunts": 0,
                    "daily_hunts_date": "",
                    "energy": 0,
                    "last_energy_update": now_text,
                    "energy_full_notified": 1,
                    "last_hp_regen_update": now_text,
                    "hp_full_notified": 1,
                    "character_name": "",
                    "character_class": "",
                    "class_selected_at": "",
                    "class_change_available": 0,
                    "mp": 0,
                    "max_mp": 0,
                    "last_regen_at": now_text,
                    "last_activity_at": None,
                }
                user_columns = _dev_reset_table_columns("users")
                assignments = []
                values = []
                for column, value in defaults.items():
                    if column in user_columns:
                        assignments.append(f'"{column}"=?')
                        values.append(value)
                if not assignments:
                    raise RuntimeError("users table has no resettable columns")
                values.append(user_id)
                cursor.execute(
                    f'UPDATE users SET {", ".join(assignments)} WHERE user_id=?',
                    tuple(values),
                )

                stage = "commit"
                conn.commit()

                # Recreate empty slots only after the atomic reset committed.
                stage = "post_commit_slots"
                ensure_equipment_slots(user_id)

                foreign_key_errors = cursor.execute("PRAGMA foreign_key_check").fetchall()
                if foreign_key_errors:
                    return {
                        "success": False,
                        "message": (
                            "❌ DEV reset completed, але foreign_key_check виявив помилки. "
                            "Не продовжуй тестування до recovery."
                        ),
                        "foreign_key_errors": [tuple(row) for row in foreign_key_errors],
                    }

                return {
                    "success": True,
                    "deleted": deleted,
                    "message": (
                        "✅ DEV: герой повністю скинутий.\n\n"
                        "Створено нового персонажа з нуля:\n"
                        "🏆 Рівень: 1\n"
                        "✨ EXP: 0\n"
                        "🪙 Золото: 0\n"
                        "🎒 Інвентар очищено\n"
                        "🛡️ Спорядження і руни очищено\n"
                        "📜 Контракти та активні взаємодії очищено\n"
                        "📆 Щоденні завдання очищено\n\n"
                        "✍️ Введи нове ім’я персонажа."
                    ),
                }

            except Exception as error:
                last_error = error
                try:
                    conn.rollback()
                except Exception:
                    pass
                locked = isinstance(error, sqlite3.OperationalError) and "locked" in str(error).lower()
                if locked and attempt < 3:
                    time.sleep(0.35 * attempt)
                    continue
                return {
                    "success": False,
                    "stage": stage,
                    "attempt": attempt,
                    "message": f"❌ DEV reset error at {stage}: {error}",
                }

    return {
        "success": False,
        "message": f"❌ DEV reset error: {last_error}",
    }

def init_dynamic_equipment_system():
    migrations = [
        ("items", "item_level", "INTEGER DEFAULT 1"),
        ("items", "is_generated", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ("items", "item_subtype", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
    ]

    for table, column, column_type in migrations:
        try:
            cursor.execute(f"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD COLUMN {column} {column_type}")
        except Exception:
            pass

    conn.commit()

def add_stat_value(stats, stat_key, value):
    if stat_key == "str":
        stats["bonus_str"] += value
    elif stat_key == "dex":
        stats["bonus_dex"] += value
    elif stat_key == "int":
        stats["bonus_int"] += value
    elif stat_key == "wis":
        stats["bonus_wis"] += value
    elif stat_key == "sta":
        stats["bonus_sta"] += value

def get_random_main_hand_profile():
    return random.choice(list(MAIN_HAND_PROFILES.keys()))

def get_random_off_hand_profile():
    return random.choice(list(OFF_HAND_PROFILES.keys()))

def get_profile_for_generated_item(slot_key, item_profile=None):
    if slot_key == "main_hand":
        if item_profile in MAIN_HAND_PROFILES:
            return item_profile

        return get_random_main_hand_profile()

    if slot_key == "off_hand":
        if item_profile in OFF_HAND_PROFILES:
            return item_profile

        return get_random_off_hand_profile()

    return ""

def get_dynamic_weapon_name(slot_key, rarity, weapon_hands=1, item_profile=None):
    icon = DYNAMIC_RARITY_ICONS.get(rarity, "⚪")

    if slot_key == "main_hand":
        profile_key = get_profile_for_generated_item(slot_key, item_profile)
        profile = MAIN_HAND_PROFILES.get(profile_key, MAIN_HAND_PROFILES["sword_1h"])
        return f"{icon} {profile['name']}"

    if slot_key == "off_hand":
        profile_key = get_profile_for_generated_item(slot_key, item_profile)
        profile = OFF_HAND_PROFILES.get(profile_key, OFF_HAND_PROFILES["shield"])
        return f"{icon} {profile['name']}"

    return f"{icon} Зброя"

def generate_dynamic_equipment_stats(slot_key, item_level, rarity, weapon_hands=1, item_profile=None):
    stats = {
        "bonus_str": 0,
        "bonus_dex": 0,
        "bonus_int": 0,
        "bonus_wis": 0,
        "bonus_sta": 0,
        "pdef": 0,
        "mdef": 0
    }

    # ==============================
    # MAIN HAND
    # ==============================

    if slot_key == "main_hand":
        profile_key = get_profile_for_generated_item(slot_key, item_profile)
        profile = MAIN_HAND_PROFILES.get(profile_key, MAIN_HAND_PROFILES["sword_1h"])

        main_stat = profile["main_stats"][0]
        base_multiplier = 1.00

        if profile["hands"] == 2:
            base_multiplier = 1.20

        value = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, base_multiplier)
        add_stat_value(stats, main_stat, value)

        extra_pool = profile["extra_stats"]

    # ==============================
    # OFF HAND
    # ==============================

    elif slot_key == "off_hand":
        profile_key = get_profile_for_generated_item(slot_key, item_profile)
        profile = OFF_HAND_PROFILES.get(profile_key, OFF_HAND_PROFILES["shield"])

        if profile_key == "shield":
            stats["pdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 1.35)
            stats["bonus_sta"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.55)

        elif profile_key == "warrior_shield":
            # 60% of Knight shield PDEF: 1.35 * 0.60 = 0.81.
            stats["pdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.81)
            stats["bonus_str"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.65)
            stats["bonus_sta"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.35)

        elif profile_key == "talisman":
            stats["mdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 1.35)
            stats["bonus_wis"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.65)

        elif profile_key == "dagger":
            stats["bonus_dex"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.95)
            stats["bonus_str"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.35)

        extra_pool = profile["extra_stats"]

    # ==============================
    # ARMOR SLOTS
    # ==============================

    elif slot_key == "helmet":
        stats["pdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.80)
        stats["mdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.40)

        bonus = random.choice(["sta", "wis", "dex"])
        value = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.25)
        add_stat_value(stats, bonus, value)

        extra_pool = ARMOR_EXTRA_STATS_BY_SLOT.get(slot_key, ["sta"])

    elif slot_key == "shoulders":
        stats["pdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 1.00)
        stats["mdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.25)

        extra_pool = ARMOR_EXTRA_STATS_BY_SLOT.get(slot_key, ["sta"])

    elif slot_key == "chest":
        stats["pdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 1.60)
        stats["mdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.35)
        stats["bonus_sta"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.55)

        extra_pool = ARMOR_EXTRA_STATS_BY_SLOT.get(slot_key, ["sta"])

    elif slot_key == "gloves":
        stats["pdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.55)
        stats["mdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.20)
        stats["bonus_dex"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.60)

        extra_pool = ARMOR_EXTRA_STATS_BY_SLOT.get(slot_key, ["dex"])

    elif slot_key == "legs":
        stats["pdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 1.20)
        stats["mdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.30)
        stats["bonus_sta"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.45)

        extra_pool = ARMOR_EXTRA_STATS_BY_SLOT.get(slot_key, ["sta"])

    elif slot_key == "boots":
        stats["pdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.45)
        stats["mdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.20)
        stats["bonus_dex"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.80)

        extra_pool = ARMOR_EXTRA_STATS_BY_SLOT.get(slot_key, ["dex"])

    # ==============================
    # JEWELRY
    # ==============================

    elif slot_key == "necklace":
        stats["mdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 1.30)
        stats["bonus_wis"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.80)

        extra_pool = ARMOR_EXTRA_STATS_BY_SLOT.get(slot_key, ["wis", "int"])

    elif slot_key == "ring":
        stat_choice = random.choice(["str", "dex", "int", "wis", "sta"])
        value = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.90)
        add_stat_value(stats, stat_choice, value)

        extra_pool = ARMOR_EXTRA_STATS_BY_SLOT.get(slot_key, ["str", "dex", "int", "wis", "sta"])

    else:
        extra_pool = ["str", "dex", "int", "wis", "sta"]

    # ==============================
    # EXTRA BONUSES BY RARITY
    # ==============================

    if rarity in ["uncommon", "rare", "epic"]:
        bonus_count = 1
        min_bonus = 2

        if rarity == "rare":
            bonus_count = 2
            min_bonus = 3

        if rarity == "epic":
            bonus_count = 3
            min_bonus = 4

        for _ in range(bonus_count):
            bonus_type = random.choice(extra_pool)

            bonus_value = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.30)
            bonus_value = max(min_bonus, bonus_value)

            add_stat_value(stats, bonus_type, bonus_value)

    return stats

    """
    🔮 Сфера нового шляху.
    Предмет для майбутньої зміни класу.
    Зараз додаємо в базу, щоб можна було видавати через DEV і тестувати інвентар.
    """

            category,

            bonus_str,
            bonus_dex,
            bonus_int,
            bonus_wis,
            bonus_sta,
            pdef,
            mdef
        )
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET
            name=excluded.name,
            type=excluded.type,
            rarity=excluded.rarity,
            category=excluded.category,
            slot_key=excluded.slot_key,
            weapon_hands=excluded.weapon_hands,
            max_stack=excluded.max_stack,
            sell_price=excluded.sell_price,
            bonus_str=excluded.bonus_str,
            bonus_dex=excluded.bonus_dex,
            bonus_int=excluded.bonus_int,
            bonus_wis=excluded.bonus_wis,
            bonus_sta=excluded.bonus_sta,
            pdef=excluded.pdef,
            mdef=excluded.mdef
        """, (
            CLASS_RESET_SPHERE_ITEM_ID,
            "🔮 Сфера нового шляху",
            "class_reset",
            "epic",
            "potion",
            None,
            1,
            10,
            0.0,
            0,
            0,
            0,
            0,
            0,
            0,
            0
        ))

        conn.commit()
    except Exception:
        pass

ARMOR_SLOTS = [
    "helmet",
    "shoulders",
    "chest",
    "gloves",
    "legs",
    "boots"
]

def init_class_equipment_restrictions_system():
    """
    Додає службове поле armor_type для класових обмежень броні.

    weapon_family окремо НЕ додаємо.
    У поточній системі роль weapon_family виконує items.item_subtype.
    """

    migrations = [
        ("items", "armor_type", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
    ]

    for table, column, column_type in migrations:
        try:
            cursor.execute(f"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD COLUMN {column} {column_type}")
        except Exception:
            pass

    conn.commit()

def normalize_equipment_restriction_value(value):
    if value is None:
        return ""

    return str(value).strip()

def get_armor_type_label(armor_type):
    armor_type = normalize_equipment_restriction_value(armor_type)
    return ARMOR_TYPE_LABELS.get(armor_type, armor_type or "Універсальний")

def get_item_subtype_label(item_subtype):
    item_subtype = normalize_equipment_restriction_value(item_subtype)
    return ITEM_SUBTYPE_LABELS.get(item_subtype, item_subtype or "Універсальний")
