RNG_NAMES = {"random", "randint", "randrange", "choice", "choices", "uniform", "shuffle", "sample"}
TIME_NAMES = {"datetime", "date", "time", "today", "now", "utcnow", "monotonic", "sleep"}
TELEGRAM_NAMES = {"send_message", "edit_message_text", "answer_callback_query", "reply_to", "message_handler", "callback_query_handler"}
FILESYSTEM_NAMES = {"open", "write_text", "write_bytes", "read_text", "read_bytes", "unlink", "replace", "mkdir"}
SQL_WRITE_PREFIXES = ("insert", "update", "delete", "create", "alter", "drop", "replace", "vacuum", "pragma wal_checkpoint")
SQL_READ_PREFIXES = ("select", "with", "pragma table_info", "pragma index_list", "pragma foreign_key_list")


def root_dir() -> Path:
    here = Path(__file__).resolve()
    for candidate in (here.parent.parent, Path.cwd().resolve()):
        if (candidate / "systems").is_dir() and (candidate / "db.py").exists():
            return candidate
    raise RuntimeError("Запускай аудит з кореня ROM або з ROM\\patch")


def sha(path: Path):
    if not path.exists():
        return None
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as f:
        for block in iter(lambda: f.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            h.update(block)
    return {"size": path.stat().st_size, "sha256": h.hexdigest()}


def dotted(node):
    if isinstance(node, ast.Name):
        return node.id
    if isinstance(node, ast.Attribute):
        left = dotted(node.value)
        return f"{left}.{node.attr}" if left else node.attr
    return ""


def literal_string(node):
    try:
        value = ast.literal_eval(node)
        return value if isinstance(value, str) else ""
    except Exception:
        return ""


def sql_kind(text):
    normalized = " ".join(str(text or "").lower().split())
    if normalized.startswith(SQL_WRITE_PREFIXES):
        return "write"
    if normalized.startswith(SQL_READ_PREFIXES):
        return "read"
    return "unknown"


def line_range(node):
    return [int(getattr(node, "lineno", 0)), int(getattr(node, "end_lineno", getattr(node, "lineno", 0)))]


def classify_function(module, node, module_imports):
    calls = []
    imports = set(module_imports)
    sql_reads = []
    sql_writes = []
    dynamic_sql = False
    flags = set()
    reasons = []

    for sub in ast.walk(node):
        if isinstance(sub, (ast.Import, ast.ImportFrom)):
            if isinstance(sub, ast.Import):
                imports.update(alias.name for alias in sub.names)
            else:
                imports.add(sub.module or "")
        elif isinstance(sub, ast.Call):
            name = dotted(sub.func)
            leaf = name.rsplit(".", 1)[-1]
            calls.append(name)
            if leaf in RNG_NAMES or name.startswith("random."):
                flags.add("GLOBAL_RNG_DEPENDENT")
            if leaf in TIME_NAMES or name.startswith(("datetime.", "date.", "time.")):
                flags.add("TIME_DEPENDENT")
            if leaf in TELEGRAM_NAMES or name.startswith(("bot.", "telebot.")):
                flags.add("TELEGRAM_DEPENDENT")
            if leaf in FILESYSTEM_NAMES and (name.startswith(("Path.", "pathlib.")) or leaf == "open"):
                flags.add("FILESYSTEM_DEPENDENT")
            if leaf in MUTATION_METHODS:
                flags.add("MUTATING_STATE")
            if leaf in READ_METHODS:
                flags.add("READS_STATE")
            if leaf in {"execute", "executemany", "executescript"}:
                text = literal_string(sub.args[0]) if sub.args else ""
                kind = sql_kind(text)
                if kind == "write":
                    flags.add("MUTATING_DB")
                    sql_writes.append(text[:240])
                elif kind == "read":
                    flags.add("READ_ONLY_DB")
                    sql_reads.append(text[:240])
                else:
                    dynamic_sql = True
                    flags.add("DB_DYNAMIC_SQL")
            if name.startswith(("db.", "sqlite3.")) or leaf in {"cursor", "connect"}:
                flags.add("DB_DEPENDENT")
        elif isinstance(sub, ast.Global):
            flags.add("GLOBAL_STATE_DEPENDENT")
        elif isinstance(sub, (ast.Assign, ast.AugAssign, ast.AnnAssign)):
            targets = sub.targets if isinstance(sub, ast.Assign) else [sub.target]
            for target in targets:
                if isinstance(target, ast.Subscript) and isinstance(target.value, ast.Name):
                    if target.value.id.isupper() or target.value.id.endswith("STATE"):
                        flags.add("GLOBAL_STATE_MUTATION")

    if any(x == "telebot" or x.startswith("telebot.") for x in imports):
        flags.add("TELEGRAM_MODULE")
    if module == "db.py":
        flags.add("LEGACY_FACADE_OR_MONOLITH")
    if "MUTATING_DB" in flags or ("DB_DEPENDENT" in flags and "MUTATING_STATE" in flags):
        flags.add("ADAPTER_REQUIRED")
    if "TELEGRAM_DEPENDENT" in flags or "TELEGRAM_MODULE" in flags:
        flags.add("ADAPTER_REQUIRED")
    if "GLOBAL_RNG_DEPENDENT" in flags:
        flags.add("RNG_INJECTION_REQUIRED")
    if "TIME_DEPENDENT" in flags:
        flags.add("CLOCK_INJECTION_REQUIRED")

    pure_blockers = flags & {
        "MUTATING_DB", "READ_ONLY_DB", "DB_DEPENDENT", "DB_DYNAMIC_SQL",
        "TELEGRAM_DEPENDENT", "TELEGRAM_MODULE", "FILESYSTEM_DEPENDENT",
        "GLOBAL_STATE_DEPENDENT", "GLOBAL_STATE_MUTATION", "GLOBAL_RNG_DEPENDENT", "TIME_DEPENDENT",
    }
    if not pure_blockers:
        flags.add("PURE_CANDIDATE")
        safe = True
        action = "Використовувати напряму після parity-тесту."
    elif pure_blockers <= {"GLOBAL_RNG_DEPENDENT"}:
        safe = True
        action = "Додати ін'єкцію seeded RNG; формулу не дублювати."
    elif pure_blockers <= {"TIME_DEPENDENT"}:
        safe = True
        action = "Додати SimulationClock."
    elif "MUTATING_DB" in flags or "TELEGRAM_DEPENDENT" in flags or "GLOBAL_STATE_MUTATION" in flags:
        safe = False
        action = "Не викликати на real DB; потрібен simulation adapter або pure rule extraction."
    elif "READ_ONLY_DB" in flags or "DB_DEPENDENT" in flags:
        safe = False
        action = "Винести обчислення в pure rule, дані передавати через SimulationState."
    else:
        safe = False
        action = "Потрібен ручний review перед підключенням."

    if module.startswith("handlers/") or module == "main.py":
        safe = False
        flags.add("PRESENTATION_OR_ENTRYPOINT")
        action = "Не використовувати в engine; лише окремий DEV handler для запуску та звітів."

    return {
        "module": module,
        "function": node.name,
        "async": isinstance(node, ast.AsyncFunctionDef),
        "line_range": line_range(node),
        "args": [a.arg for a in node.args.args],
        "classification": sorted(flags),
        "safe_for_exact_simulation": bool(safe),
        "recommended_action": action,
        "calls": sorted(set(c for c in calls if c))[:120],
        "sql_reads": sql_reads[:20],
        "sql_writes": sql_writes[:20],
        "dynamic_sql": dynamic_sql,
    }


def analyze_module(path: Path, rel: str):
    source = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    tree = ast.parse(source, filename=rel)
    imports = set()
    module_effects = []
    functions = []
    for node in tree.body:
        if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
            imports.update(alias.name for alias in node.names)
        elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom):
            imports.add(node.module or "")
        elif isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
            functions.append(classify_function(rel, node, imports))
        elif isinstance(node, (ast.Expr, ast.Assign, ast.AnnAssign, ast.AugAssign, ast.For, ast.While, ast.With, ast.Try)):
            for sub in ast.walk(node):
                if isinstance(sub, ast.Call):
                    name = dotted(sub.func)
                    if name and name not in {"globals", "getattr", "hasattr", "setattr", "len", "str", "int", "float", "list", "dict", "tuple", "set"}:
                        module_effects.append({"call": name, "line": getattr(sub, "lineno", 0)})
    return {
        "module": rel,
        "sha256": sha(path)["sha256"],
        "size": path.stat().st_size,
        "imports": sorted(imports),
        "module_scope_calls": module_effects[:100],
        "functions": functions,
    }


def write_json(path: Path, payload):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")


def md_escape(value):
    return str(value).replace("|", "\\|")


def build_policy_md():
    return """# ROM Simulation MVP Policy Specification 13.0.0

## Статус

Це затверджена стартова policy-специфікація для PvE та progression simulator. PvP не входить у MVP і відкладається до появи production PvP ruleset.

## Безпека

- Симулятор не змінює `game.db`, реальних users, inventory, guilds або trade.
- Усі simulation runs використовують `SimulationState` у пам'яті або окремий тимчасовий fixture.
- RNG обов'язково seeded і записується у звіт.
- Production та simulation повинні використовувати спільні pure rules. Формули не копіюються в handlers.

## Inventory

- Production baseline: 40 комірок.
- Experiment: 60 комірок.
- Capacity передається через config, а не hardcode усередині engine.
- Reserve slots policy: 2.
- Один generated equipment instance займає одну комірку.
- Один stack займає одну комірку; stack merge можливий навіть при повній сумці, поки `quantity < max_stack`.
- При необхідності нового row і повній сумці drop втрачається або reward не видається відповідно до production contract.
- Метрики: full bag events, forced city returns, lost drops, lost value, average free slots, utilization.

## Профілі часу

- Casual: 18:00-21:00.
- Regular: 17:00-23:00.
- Hardcore: 09:00-23:00.
- Energy max: 40.
- Regeneration: +1 кожні 5 хвилин до максимуму.
- Усередині active window персонаж відновлює активність після regeneration tick; поза вікном лише минає час і відновлюються ресурси.

## Моби й локації

- Доступні лише unlocked locations.
- Пул мобів: рівень гравця -1, рівень гравця, рівень гравця +1.
- Active contract target має пріоритет, якщо target доступний.
- Використовувати чинний runtime selector або винесене з нього pure rule.
- Боси обробляються окремою policy, а не як випадковий normal mob.

## Зілля

- HP potion: `current_hp / max_hp < 0.30`.
- MP potion: `current_mp / max_mp < 0.25`, лише mana-класи.
- Ураховувати production cooldown.
- Обирати найменше доступне зілля, достатнє для корисного відновлення; fallback на наступне доступне.

## Ремонт

- Плановий ремонт під час city visit.
- Термінове повернення до міста, якщо будь-яка активна річ має `durability < 10`.
- Перед ремонтом продати trash і непотрібне/несумісне спорядження.
- Repair metrics: count, total cost, downtime, restored score.

## Екіпірування

1. Несумісний із класом предмет продається.
2. Порожній сумісний слот заповнюється.
3. Зайнятий слот порівнюється через class-aware effective score.
4. Рідкість не перемагає автоматично: білий предмет вищого рівня може бути кращим за синій нижчого рівня.
5. Score враховує relevant stats, damage, PDEF/MDEF, refine, durability, inserted runes і доступні socket opportunities.
6. Дворучна зброя порівнюється із сумою current main-hand + off-hand.
7. Одноручна зброя після дворучної оцінюється разом із найкращим доступним compatible off-hand.
8. Ваги класів є simulation policy і мають калібруватися через PvE результати.

## Combat action policy

MVP policy: `balanced`.

Пріоритет:
1. survival heal/shield, якщо прогнозується смерть;
2. HP potion за порогом;
3. MP potion за порогом;
4. control/defense у небезпечному бою;
5. skill, який завершує бій;
6. class finisher за оптимального ресурсу;
7. найкраща доступна offensive skill;
8. basic attack.

Майбутні policies: `safe`, `balanced`, `aggressive`.

## Acceptance baseline

`/dev_progress_sim warrior 20 regular` у режимі EXACT має завершити progression 1-20, створити JSON/Markdown звіт і не змінити real DB. Звіт охоплює бої, час, енергію, EXP, gold, deaths, loot, repair, contracts, daily, runes, fusion, refine, guild contribution, final equipment і final stats.
"""


def build_architecture_md(result):
    s = result["summary"]
    module_rows = []
    for mod in result["modules"]:
        counts = Counter()
        for f in mod["functions"]:
            counts.update(f["classification"])
        module_rows.append(
            f"| `{mod['module']}` | {len(mod['functions'])} | {counts['PURE_CANDIDATE']} | "
            f"{counts['READ_ONLY_DB']} | {counts['MUTATING_DB']} | {counts['GLOBAL_RNG_DEPENDENT']} | "
            f"{counts['TIME_DEPENDENT']} | {counts['TELEGRAM_DEPENDENT'] + counts['TELEGRAM_MODULE']} |"
        )
    top_adapters = [f for m in result["modules"] for f in m["functions"] if "ADAPTER_REQUIRED" in f["classification"]]
    top_rng = [f for m in result["modules"] for f in m["functions"] if "RNG_INJECTION_REQUIRED" in f["classification"]]
    top_time = [f for m in result["modules"] for f in m["functions"] if "CLOCK_INJECTION_REQUIRED" in f["classification"]]
    module_scope = [x for m in result["modules"] for x in ({"module": m["module"], **e} for e in m["module_scope_calls"])]
    lines = [
        "# Simulation Architecture & Purity Audit 13.0.0", "",
        f"Generated: `{result['generated_at']}`", "",
        f"Verdict: **{result['verdict']}**", "",
        "## Executive summary", "",
        f"- Target modules found: **{s['modules_found']} / {s['modules_expected']}**.",
        f"- Functions analyzed: **{s['functions']}**.",
        f"- Pure candidates: **{s['pure_candidates']}**.",
        f"- Safe for direct EXACT use after parity tests: **{s['safe_exact']}**.",
        f"- Adapter required: **{s['adapter_required']}**.",
        f"- RNG injection required: **{s['rng_injection_required']}**.",
        f"- Clock injection required: **{s['clock_injection_required']}**.",
        f"- Missing modules: **{len(result['missing_modules'])}**.", "",
        "## Classification", "",
        "| Module | Functions | Pure | Read DB | Write DB | RNG | Time | Telegram |",
        "|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|",
        *module_rows, "",
        "## Architecture findings", "",
        "1. Production domain is not uniformly pure. A substantial part of behavior is tied to SQLite, global RNG, wall-clock time, or legacy facade calls.",
        "2. The simulation engine must own state, clock, RNG and metrics. It must not create real users in `game.db`.",
        "3. Mathematical rules and selectors should be extracted or wrapped as pure functions and used by both production and simulation.",
        "4. DEV Telegram handlers must only validate commands, enqueue/run simulations and return compact summaries plus report files.",
        "5. PvP is explicitly deferred until production PvP rules exist.", "",
        "## Highest-priority adapters", "",
    ]
    for f in top_adapters[:80]:
        lines.append(f"- `{f['module']}::{f['function']}()` lines {f['line_range'][0]}-{f['line_range'][1]}: {f['recommended_action']}")
    lines += ["", "## Seeded RNG candidates", ""]
    for f in top_rng[:60]:
        lines.append(f"- `{f['module']}::{f['function']}()`")
    lines += ["", "## SimulationClock candidates", ""]
    for f in top_time[:60]:
        lines.append(f"- `{f['module']}::{f['function']}()`")
    lines += ["", "## Module-scope calls requiring caution", ""]
    if module_scope:
        for e in module_scope[:100]:
            lines.append(f"- `{e['module']}` line {e['line']}: `{e['call']}()`")
    else:
        lines.append("- No significant module-scope calls detected by the static heuristic.")
    lines += ["", "## Inventory capacity", "",
        "- Current production baseline discovered/expected: 40 slots.",
        "- Experimental scenario: 60 slots.",
        "- Simulator config must support arbitrary capacity and reserve slots.",
        "- Capacity analysis must distinguish stack merge from creating a new inventory row.", "",
        "## Limitations of this audit", "",
        "- Static AST classification is conservative and may mark facade functions as adapter-required even when a lower-level pure helper exists.",
        "- Dynamic imports, aliases and SQL assembled at runtime require manual review.",
        "- A function marked PURE_CANDIDATE still requires parity tests against production behavior before use.",
    ]
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"


def roadmap(result):
    s = result["summary"]
    complexity = "high" if s["adapter_required"] > max(25, s["functions"] * 0.20) else "medium"
    estimated = 9 if complexity == "high" else 7
    return f"""# Simulation implementation roadmap after audit 13.0.0

## Preliminary estimate

Static result indicates **{complexity} integration complexity**. Preliminary implementation estimate: **{estimated} core stages**, excluding PvP and optional optimization stages. This is an audit-based estimate and should be finalized after reviewing the generated callability matrix.

## Proposed stages

1. **13.1 Simulation foundation**: dataclasses/models, SimulationState, SimulationClock, seeded RNG, config, metrics, report serialization.
2. **13.2 Canonical pure rules and parity layer**: extract/wrap damage, crit, dodge, reward, repair, refine, compatibility and capacity rules; parity tests against production.
3. **13.3 Exact single-battle PvE engine**: normal/elite/boss, skills, cooldowns, class resources, potions, durability, deterministic seeds.
4. **13.4 Drop and inventory simulation**: central drop system, stack plans, 40/60 capacity, lost loot, city return, sell rules.
5. **13.5 Behavior policy engine**: equipment score, 1H/2H comparison, potion/repair/mob/skill policies, rune insertion/fusion/refine.
6. **13.6 Progression MVP**: level path and progress simulation, active windows, energy, regen, contracts, daily, guild contribution.
7. **13.7 Analytics and comparison**: PvE class balance, progression walls, loot acquisition, rune completion, 40-vs-60 capacity.
8. **13.8 Economy and population**: inflation, guild cohorts, lifecycle checkpoints, FAST-mode calibration against EXACT.
9. **13.9 RNG and patch regression**: baseline/current snapshots, same-seed comparison, lucky/average/unlucky percentiles.

## Deferred

- `systems/pvp_simulator.py`, `/dev_pvp`, `/dev_pvp_all` until production PvP exists.
- Player-facing trade history and PvP implementation are outside this analytics stage.

## Quality gates for every stage

- Real `game.db` SHA-256 unchanged.
- No real user, inventory or guild mutations.
- Seed and config fingerprint recorded.
- Own smoke test plus core regression suite.
- Exact behavior parity tests where a production rule is reused.
- Manual game check only for Telegram DEV handler/UX stages.
"""


def main():
    root = root_dir()
    before = {name: sha(root / name) for name in ("game.db", "game.db-wal")}
    modules = []
    missing = []
    syntax_errors = []
    for rel in TARGET_MODULES:
        path = root / rel
        if not path.exists():
            missing.append(rel)
            continue
        try:
            modules.append(analyze_module(path, rel))
        except SyntaxError as error:
            syntax_errors.append({"module": rel, "error": str(error)})

    all_functions = [f for m in modules for f in m["functions"]]
    counts = Counter()
    for f in all_functions:
        counts.update(f["classification"])
    summary = {
        "modules_expected": len(TARGET_MODULES),
        "modules_found": len(modules),
        "functions": len(all_functions),
        "pure_candidates": counts["PURE_CANDIDATE"],
        "safe_exact": sum(1 for f in all_functions if f["safe_for_exact_simulation"]),
        "adapter_required": counts["ADAPTER_REQUIRED"],
        "rng_injection_required": counts["RNG_INJECTION_REQUIRED"],
        "clock_injection_required": counts["CLOCK_INJECTION_REQUIRED"],
        "read_only_db": counts["READ_ONLY_DB"],
        "mutating_db": counts["MUTATING_DB"],
        "telegram_dependent": counts["TELEGRAM_DEPENDENT"] + counts["TELEGRAM_MODULE"],
    }
    blockers = []
    critical = {"systems/combat_system.py", "systems/player_system.py", "systems/reward_system.py", "systems/equipment_system.py"}
    for rel in missing:
        if rel in critical:
            blockers.append({"code": "missing_critical_module", "message": rel})
    for item in syntax_errors:
        blockers.append({"code": "syntax_error", "message": f"{item['module']}: {item['error']}"})
    if not all_functions:
        blockers.append({"code": "no_functions", "message": "No functions analyzed"})

    result = {
        "version": VERSION,
        "generated_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
        "verdict": "FAIL" if blockers else "PASS",
        "blockers": blockers,
        "missing_modules": missing,
        "syntax_errors": syntax_errors,
        "summary": summary,
        "policies": {
            "pvp_deferred": True,
            "inventory_capacity_baseline": 40,
            "inventory_capacity_experiment": 60,
            "inventory_reserve_slots": 2,
            "hp_potion_threshold": 0.30,
            "mp_potion_threshold": 0.25,
            "repair_threshold_strictly_below": 10,
            "mob_level_delta": [-1, 0, 1],
            "energy_max": 40,
            "energy_regen_minutes": 5,
            "profiles": {"casual": "18:00-21:00", "regular": "17:00-23:00", "hardcore": "09:00-23:00"},
        },
        "modules": modules,
        "database_files_before": before,
    }

    write_json(root / "SIMULATION_CALLABILITY_MATRIX.json", result)
    (root / "MD").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (root / "MD/SIMULATION_ARCHITECTURE_AUDIT.md").write_text(build_architecture_md(result), encoding="utf-8")
    (root / "MD/SIMULATION_MVP_POLICY_SPECIFICATION.md").write_text(build_policy_md(), encoding="utf-8")
    (root / "MD/SIMULATION_IMPLEMENTATION_ROADMAP.md").write_text(roadmap(result), encoding="utf-8")

    after = {name: sha(root / name) for name in ("game.db", "game.db-wal")}
    strict_unchanged = before == after
    result["database_files_after"] = after
    result["database_files_unchanged"] = strict_unchanged
    if not strict_unchanged:
        result["verdict"] = "FAIL"
        result["blockers"].append({"code": "database_changed", "message": "game.db or WAL changed during AST-only audit"})
    write_json(root / "SIMULATION_CALLABILITY_MATRIX.json", result)

    output_paths = [root / x for x in OUTPUTS[:-1]]
    manifest_lines = [
        f"version={VERSION}",
        f"generated_at={result['generated_at']}",
        f"verdict={result['verdict']}",
        f"functions_analyzed={summary['functions']}",
        f"pure_candidates={summary['pure_candidates']}",
        f"adapter_required={summary['adapter_required']}",
        f"rng_injection_required={summary['rng_injection_required']}",
        f"clock_injection_required={summary['clock_injection_required']}",
        f"database_files_unchanged={str(strict_unchanged).lower()}",
        "pvp_deferred=true",
        "inventory_capacity_baseline=40",
        "inventory_capacity_experiment=60",
    ]
    for path in output_paths:
        info = sha(path)
        manifest_lines.append(f"file={path.relative_to(root)}|size={info['size']}|sha256={info['sha256']}")
    manifest_path = root / OUTPUTS[-1]
    manifest_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    manifest_path.write_text("\n".join(manifest_lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

    print("[OK] ROM simulation architecture and purity audit")
    print(f"- verdict: {result['verdict']}")
    print(f"- modules: {summary['modules_found']}/{summary['modules_expected']}")
    print(f"- functions analyzed: {summary['functions']}")
    print(f"- pure candidates: {summary['pure_candidates']}")
    print(f"- adapter required: {summary['adapter_required']}")
    print(f"- seeded RNG injection required: {summary['rng_injection_required']}")
    print(f"- SimulationClock injection required: {summary['clock_injection_required']}")
    print(f"- game.db/WAL unchanged: {'YES' if strict_unchanged else 'NO'}")
    print("- PvP: DEFERRED")
    print("- inventory scenarios: 40 baseline / 60 experiment")
    print("- report: MD\\SIMULATION_ARCHITECTURE_AUDIT.md")
    print("- policy: MD\\SIMULATION_MVP_POLICY_SPECIFICATION.md")
    print("- roadmap: MD\\SIMULATION_IMPLEMENTATION_ROADMAP.md")
    print("- matrix: SIMULATION_CALLABILITY_MATRIX.json")
    if result["blockers"]:
        for finding in result["blockers"]:
            print(f"  [BLOCKER] {finding['code']}: {finding['message']}")
    if result["verdict"] != "PASS":
        raise SystemExit(2)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Read-only audit of ROM static item seeds and DB initialization side effects."""
from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import sqlite3
import sys
from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DB_PATH = ROOT / "game.db"
REPORT = ROOT / "DB_CLEANUP_9_0_13A_STATIC_ITEMS_AND_DB_INIT_AUDIT.md"

LEGACY_EQUIPMENT_IDS = tuple(range(1, 27))
LEGACY_TRASH_IDS = tuple(range(101, 107))
CURRENT_TRASH_IDS = tuple(range(107, 127))
POTION_IDS = (201, 202, 203, 204)
CLASS_RESET_ID = 301
REFINE_IDS = (401, 402)
AUDIT_IDS = tuple(sorted(set(
    LEGACY_EQUIPMENT_IDS + LEGACY_TRASH_IDS + CURRENT_TRASH_IDS +
    POTION_IDS + (CLASS_RESET_ID,) + REFINE_IDS
)))
EXCLUDED_DIRS = {"patch", "backup", ".venv", "venv", "__pycache__", ".git"}


def fail(message):
    print(f"[FAIL] {message}")
    raise SystemExit(1)


def qident(name):
    return '"' + str(name).replace('"', '""') + '"'


def file_sha256(path):
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as handle:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def parse(path):
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    return text, ast.parse(text, filename=str(path))


def function_nodes(tree, name):
    return [
        node for node in tree.body
        if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) and node.name == name
    ]


def literal_seed_rows(text, tree, function_name):
    nodes = function_nodes(tree, function_name)
    if len(nodes) != 1:
        fail(f"{function_name}: definitions={len(nodes)}, expected 1")
    node = nodes[0]
    rows = []
    for sub in ast.walk(node):
        if not isinstance(sub, (ast.List, ast.Tuple)):
            continue
        for element in sub.elts:
            if not isinstance(element, ast.Tuple):
                continue
            try:
                value = ast.literal_eval(element)
            except Exception:
                continue
            if isinstance(value, tuple) and len(value) >= 5 and isinstance(value[0], int):
                rows.append(value)
    unique = {}
    for row in rows:
        unique[int(row[0])] = row
    return unique, ast.get_source_segment(text, node) or ""


def top_level_sql_side_effects(tree):
    findings = []
    mutating_methods = {"execute", "executemany", "executescript", "commit", "rollback"}
    mutating_names = {
        "ensure_refine_material_stack_sizes",
        "migrate_active_contracts_target_kills_to_5",
        "run_pending_migrations",
        "seed_items",
        "seed_location_trash_items",
        "seed_class_reset_sphere_item",
    }
    for statement in tree.body:
        if isinstance(statement, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef, ast.ClassDef,
                                  ast.Import, ast.ImportFrom)):
            continue
        for node in ast.walk(statement):
            if not isinstance(node, ast.Call):
                continue
            name = None
            if isinstance(node.func, ast.Name):
                name = node.func.id
            elif isinstance(node.func, ast.Attribute):
                name = node.func.attr
            if name in mutating_methods or name in mutating_names:
                findings.append({"line": node.lineno, "call": name})
    return findings


def project_code_references():
    references = defaultdict(list)
    semantic_names = defaultdict(list)
    tracked_names = {
        "CLASS_RESET_SPHERE_ITEM_ID", "REFINE_STONE_ITEM_ID",
        "SUCCESS_RUNE_ITEM_ID", "DAILY_QUEST_REWARD_ITEM_ID",
    }
    for path in ROOT.rglob("*.py"):
        rel = path.relative_to(ROOT)
        if any(part in EXCLUDED_DIRS for part in rel.parts):
            continue
        try:
            _text, tree = parse(path)
        except Exception:
            continue
        for node in ast.walk(tree):
            if isinstance(node, ast.Constant) and type(node.value) is int and node.value in AUDIT_IDS:
                references[int(node.value)].append(f"{rel.as_posix()}:{node.lineno}")
            elif isinstance(node, ast.Name) and isinstance(node.ctx, ast.Load) and node.id in tracked_names:
                semantic_names[node.id].append(f"{rel.as_posix()}:{node.lineno}")
    return references, semantic_names


def table_names(conn):
    return [
        row[0] for row in conn.execute(
            "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' ORDER BY name"
        ).fetchall()
    ]


def table_columns(conn, table):
    return [row[1] for row in conn.execute(f"PRAGMA table_info({qident(table)})").fetchall()]


def count_by_column(conn, table, column, ids):
    placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in ids)
    rows = conn.execute(
        f"SELECT {qident(column)}, COUNT(*) FROM {qident(table)} "
        f"WHERE {qident(column)} IN ({placeholders}) GROUP BY {qident(column)} ORDER BY {qident(column)}",
        tuple(ids),
    ).fetchall()
    return {int(row[0]): int(row[1]) for row in rows}


def database_references(conn):
    refs = defaultdict(dict)
    for table in table_names(conn):
        columns = table_columns(conn, table)
        for column in columns:
            if column in {"item_id", "item_ref_id"}:
                counts = count_by_column(conn, table, column, AUDIT_IDS)
                if counts:
                    refs[f"{table}.{column}"].update(counts)
    return refs


def item_rows(conn):
    if "items" not in table_names(conn):
        fail("items table not found")
    columns = table_columns(conn, "items")
    wanted = [
        name for name in (
            "id", "name", "type", "rarity", "category", "slot_key",
            "max_stack", "sell_price", "item_level", "is_generated",
            "item_subtype", "armor_type", "weapon_attack_type",
            "shop_preview_owner", "shop_preview_price",
        ) if name in columns
    ]
    placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in AUDIT_IDS)
    select_list = ",".join(qident(name) for name in wanted)
    rows = conn.execute(
        f"SELECT {select_list} FROM items WHERE id IN ({placeholders}) ORDER BY id",
        AUDIT_IDS,
    ).fetchall()
    return wanted, [dict(zip(wanted, row)) for row in rows]


def equipped_legacy_counts(conn):
    tables = set(table_names(conn))
    if not {"equipment_slots", "inventory"}.issubset(tables):
        return {}
    slot_cols = set(table_columns(conn, "equipment_slots"))
    inv_cols = set(table_columns(conn, "inventory"))
    if not {"inventory_id", "user_id"}.issubset(slot_cols) or not {"id", "item_id"}.issubset(inv_cols):
        return {}
    placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in LEGACY_EQUIPMENT_IDS)
    rows = conn.execute(
        f"""SELECT i.item_id, COUNT(*)
            FROM equipment_slots es
            JOIN inventory i ON i.id=es.inventory_id
            WHERE i.item_id IN ({placeholders})
            GROUP BY i.item_id ORDER BY i.item_id""",
        LEGACY_EQUIPMENT_IDS,
    ).fetchall()
    return {int(row[0]): int(row[1]) for row in rows}


def auction_snapshot_hits(conn):
    if "auction_lots" not in table_names(conn):
        return []
    columns = set(table_columns(conn, "auction_lots"))
    snapshot_column = "item_snapshot_json" if "item_snapshot_json" in columns else None
    if not snapshot_column:
        return []
    hits = []
    rows = conn.execute(
        f"SELECT id, status, {qident(snapshot_column)} FROM auction_lots"
    ).fetchall()
    for lot_id, status, raw in rows:
        try:
            data = json.loads(raw or "{}")
        except Exception:
            continue
        candidates = []
        if isinstance(data, dict):
            for key in ("item_id", "source_item_id", "id"):
                value = data.get(key)
                if isinstance(value, int):
                    candidates.append(value)
        matched = sorted(set(candidates).intersection(AUDIT_IDS))
        if matched:
            hits.append({"lot_id": lot_id, "status": status, "item_ids": matched})
    return hits


def group_counts(mapping, ids):
    total = 0
    details = {}
    for source, counts in mapping.items():
        selected = {item_id: count for item_id, count in counts.items() if item_id in ids}
        if selected:
            details[source] = selected
            total += sum(selected.values())
    return total, details


def main():
    db_py = ROOT / "db.py"
    main_py = ROOT / "main.py"
    if not db_py.is_file() or not main_py.is_file():
        fail("db.py or main.py not found")
    if not DB_PATH.is_file():
        fail("game.db not found; DB reference audit cannot be completed")

    db_hash_before = file_sha256(DB_PATH)
    db_size_before = DB_PATH.stat().st_size
    db_mtime_before = DB_PATH.stat().st_mtime_ns

    db_text, db_tree = parse(db_py)
    main_text, main_tree = parse(main_py)

    seed_rows, seed_source = literal_seed_rows(db_text, db_tree, "seed_items")
    trash_rows, trash_source = literal_seed_rows(db_text, db_tree, "seed_location_trash_items")
    sphere_rows, sphere_source = literal_seed_rows(db_text, db_tree, "seed_class_reset_sphere_item")

    expected_seed_ids = set(LEGACY_EQUIPMENT_IDS + LEGACY_TRASH_IDS + POTION_IDS + (CLASS_RESET_ID,))
    actual_seed_ids = set(seed_rows)
    if not expected_seed_ids.issubset(actual_seed_ids):
        fail(f"seed_items missing expected IDs: {sorted(expected_seed_ids - actual_seed_ids)}")
    if not set(CURRENT_TRASH_IDS).issubset(set(trash_rows)):
        fail("seed_location_trash_items does not contain all IDs 107-126")

    conflict_301 = {
        "seed_items": seed_rows.get(CLASS_RESET_ID),
        "seed_class_reset_sphere_item": sphere_rows.get(CLASS_RESET_ID),
    }
    if conflict_301["seed_items"] is None:
        fail("expected historical item 301 collision was not found in seed_items")
    if "Сфера нового шляху" not in sphere_source:
        fail("canonical class-reset sphere seed not found")

    seed_replace = "INSERT OR REPLACE" in seed_source.upper()
    trash_replace = "INSERT OR REPLACE" in trash_source.upper()
    sphere_replace = "INSERT OR REPLACE" in sphere_source.upper()

    main_calls = []
    for node in ast.walk(main_tree):
        if not isinstance(node, ast.Call) or not isinstance(node.func, ast.Name):
            continue
        if node.func.id in {"seed_items", "seed_location_trash_items", "seed_class_reset_sphere_item"}:
            main_calls.append((node.lineno, node.func.id))
    main_calls.sort()

    code_refs, semantic_refs = project_code_references()
    import_side_effects = top_level_sql_side_effects(db_tree)

    uri = DB_PATH.resolve().as_uri() + "?mode=ro"
    conn = sqlite3.connect(uri, uri=True)
    try:
        conn.execute("PRAGMA query_only=ON")
        refs = database_references(conn)
        item_columns, items = item_rows(conn)
        equipped = equipped_legacy_counts(conn)
        auction_hits = auction_snapshot_hits(conn)
        integrity = conn.execute("PRAGMA quick_check").fetchone()[0]
    finally:
        conn.close()

    db_hash_after = file_sha256(DB_PATH)
    if (
        db_hash_before != db_hash_after or
        db_size_before != DB_PATH.stat().st_size or
        db_mtime_before != DB_PATH.stat().st_mtime_ns
    ):
        fail("game.db changed during read-only audit")

    legacy_equipment_ref_total, legacy_equipment_refs = group_counts(refs, LEGACY_EQUIPMENT_IDS)
    legacy_trash_ref_total, legacy_trash_refs = group_counts(refs, LEGACY_TRASH_IDS)
    current_trash_ref_total, current_trash_refs = group_counts(refs, CURRENT_TRASH_IDS)
    potion_ref_total, potion_refs = group_counts(refs, POTION_IDS)
    sphere_ref_total, sphere_refs = group_counts(refs, (CLASS_RESET_ID,))
    refine_ref_total, refine_refs = group_counts(refs, REFINE_IDS)

    present_ids = {int(row["id"]) for row in items}
    missing_current = sorted(set(CURRENT_TRASH_IDS + POTION_IDS + (CLASS_RESET_ID,) + REFINE_IDS) - present_ids)

    recommendations = []
    recommendations.append("Remove IDs 1-26 from startup seed; keep existing DB rows until reference migration is decided.")
    recommendations.append("Remove IDs 101-106 from startup seed; current mobs use IDs 107-126.")
    recommendations.append("Remove the obsolete ID 301 Rune of Strength definition immediately; reserve 301 only for the class-reset sphere.")
    recommendations.append("Keep potions 201-204, current trash 107-126, class-reset sphere 301, and refine materials 401-402.")
    recommendations.append("Replace INSERT OR REPLACE seed writes with controlled UPSERT/INSERT OR IGNORE to avoid resetting modern item columns.")
    recommendations.append("Move import-time maintenance calls into explicit startup initialization/migrations.")
    if legacy_equipment_ref_total or equipped:
        recommendations.append("Do not DELETE legacy equipment item rows yet: real DB references/equipped rows exist.")
    else:
        recommendations.append("Legacy equipment rows have no direct inventory/equipment references in the audited DB; physical deletion is possible only after auction snapshot review and backup.")
    if legacy_trash_ref_total:
        recommendations.append("Do not DELETE legacy trash rows yet: existing inventories or other tables still reference them; allow players to sell them naturally.")
    else:
        recommendations.append("Legacy trash IDs 101-106 have no direct DB references in the audited DB and can become physical-cleanup candidates after backup.")

    report = [
        "# ROM 9.0.13a — Static Items and DB Initialization Audit",
        "",
        f"Generated: `{datetime.now().isoformat(timespec='seconds')}`",
        "",
        "## Safety",
        "",
        f"- Database opened with SQLite read-only URI: **yes**",
        f"- `PRAGMA query_only`: **enabled**",
        f"- Database SHA-256 unchanged: **{db_hash_before == db_hash_after}**",
        f"- Database integrity (`PRAGMA quick_check`): **{integrity}**",
        "- Gameplay files changed by audit: **0**",
        "- Database rows changed by audit: **0**",
        "",
        "## Seed ownership",
        "",
        f"- `seed_items()` IDs: `{sorted(actual_seed_ids)}`",
        f"- Legacy equipment IDs in seed: `{sorted(set(LEGACY_EQUIPMENT_IDS) & actual_seed_ids)}`",
        f"- Legacy trash IDs in seed: `{sorted(set(LEGACY_TRASH_IDS) & actual_seed_ids)}`",
        f"- Current trash IDs in dedicated seed: `{sorted(set(CURRENT_TRASH_IDS) & set(trash_rows))}`",
        f"- Potion IDs in seed: `{sorted(set(POTION_IDS) & actual_seed_ids)}`",
        f"- Refine IDs are owned by refine seed: `{list(REFINE_IDS)}`",
        "",
        "## Critical ID collision",
        "",
        f"- `seed_items()` ID 301: `{conflict_301['seed_items']}`",
        "- Canonical ID 301 owner: `seed_class_reset_sphere_item()` / `CLASS_RESET_SPHERE_ITEM_ID`.",
        "- Result: **confirmed semantic collision**.",
        "",
        "## Seed write policy",
        "",
        f"- `seed_items()` uses `INSERT OR REPLACE`: **{seed_replace}**",
        f"- `seed_location_trash_items()` uses `INSERT OR REPLACE`: **{trash_replace}**",
        f"- `seed_class_reset_sphere_item()` uses `INSERT OR REPLACE`: **{sphere_replace}**",
        f"- Current `items` columns: `{item_columns}`",
        "",
        "## Startup call order",
        "",
        f"- Calls found in `main.py`: `{main_calls}`",
        "",
        "## Real database references",
        "",
        f"- Legacy equipment 1-26 direct references: **{legacy_equipment_ref_total}** — `{legacy_equipment_refs}`",
        f"- Legacy equipment currently equipped: **{sum(equipped.values())}** — `{equipped}`",
        f"- Legacy trash 101-106 direct references: **{legacy_trash_ref_total}** — `{legacy_trash_refs}`",
        f"- Current trash 107-126 direct references: **{current_trash_ref_total}** — `{current_trash_refs}`",
        f"- Potions 201-204 direct references: **{potion_ref_total}** — `{potion_refs}`",
        f"- Class reset sphere 301 direct references: **{sphere_ref_total}** — `{sphere_refs}`",
        f"- Refine materials 401-402 direct references: **{refine_ref_total}** — `{refine_refs}`",
        f"- Auction snapshot hits: `{auction_hits}`",
        f"- Missing active static item rows: `{missing_current}`",
        "",
        "## Static code references",
        "",
    ]
    for item_id in AUDIT_IDS:
        locations = sorted(set(code_refs.get(item_id, [])))
        if locations:
            report.append(f"- `{item_id}`: `{locations}`")
    report.extend(["", "## Semantic constant references", ""])
    for name, locations in sorted(semantic_refs.items()):
        report.append(f"- `{name}`: `{sorted(set(locations))}`")
    report.extend(["", "## Top-level/import-time DB mutation candidates", ""])
    if import_side_effects:
        for finding in import_side_effects:
            report.append(f"- `db.py:{finding['line']}` calls `{finding['call']}()` at module scope.")
    else:
        report.append("- None detected by the structural rule set.")
    report.extend(["", "## Recommendations", ""])
    for index, recommendation in enumerate(recommendations, start=1):
        report.append(f"{index}. {recommendation}")
    report.extend(["", "## Suggested next patch", "", "`patch_9_0_13b_static_items_seed_cleanup.py`", ""])
    REPORT.write_text("\n".join(report), encoding="utf-8")

    print("[OK] static items and DB initialization audit")
    print(f"- seed_items IDs: {len(actual_seed_ids)}")
    print("- legacy equipment seed IDs: 26")
    print("- legacy trash seed IDs: 6")
    print("- current trash seed IDs: 20")
    print("- item 301 semantic collision: CONFIRMED")
    print(f"- legacy equipment DB refs: {legacy_equipment_ref_total}")
    print(f"- legacy equipment equipped: {sum(equipped.values())}")
    print(f"- legacy trash DB refs: {legacy_trash_ref_total}")
    print(f"- startup seed call count: {len(main_calls)}")
    print(f"- import-time mutation candidates: {len(import_side_effects)}")
    print("- database mutations: 0")
    print(f"- report: {REPORT}")


if __name__ == "__main__":

from pathlib import Path
import py_compile
import importlib
import sys
import traceback


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))


PROJECT_FILES = [
    "db.py",
    "keyboards.py",
    "handlers/start.py",
    "handlers/profile.py",
    "handlers/inventory.py",
    "handlers/combat.py",

    "systems/guild_system.py",
    "systems/auction_house_system.py",
    "data/balance.py",
    "migrations/runner.py",
]


SAFE_IMPORT_MODULES = [
    "db",
    "keyboards",
    "systems.combat_system",
    "systems.refine_system",
    "systems.energy_system",
    "systems.regen_system",
    "systems.equipment_system",
    "data.classes",
    "data.equipment_profiles",
    "systems.guild_system",
    "systems.auction_house_system",
    "data.balance",
    "migrations.runner",
]


def print_header(title):
    print("=" * 80)
    print(title)
    print("=" * 80)


def compile_project_files():
    errors = []

    for relative_path in PROJECT_FILES:
        path = ROOT / relative_path

        if not path.exists():
            print(f"[SKIP] missing: {relative_path}")
            continue

        try:
            py_compile.compile(str(path), doraise=True)
        except Exception as error:
            errors.append((relative_path, error))

    return errors


def import_safe_modules():
    errors = []

    for module_name in SAFE_IMPORT_MODULES:
        try:
            importlib.import_module(module_name)
            print(f"[OK] import {module_name}")
        except Exception as error:
            errors.append((module_name, error))

    return errors


def main():
    print_header("ROM compile/import check")

    compile_errors = compile_project_files()

    if compile_errors:
        print("[COMPILE ERRORS]")
        for path, error in compile_errors:
            print(f"- {path}: {error}")
    else:
        print("[OK] py_compile passed for project files.")

    print()
    print("[SAFE IMPORT CHECK]")

    import_errors = import_safe_modules()

    if import_errors:
        print()
        print("[IMPORT WARNINGS/ERRORS]")
        for module_name, error in import_errors:
            print(f"- {module_name}: {error}")
            traceback.print_exception(type(error), error, error.__traceback__)
    else:
        print()
        print("[OK] safe imports passed.")

    print()
    print("Note:")
    print("- main.py is intentionally not imported here, because importing main.py can start the bot.")
    print("- handlers are compiled, not imported, to avoid registering handlers during audit.")
    print()
    print("Done.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def run(command):
    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, text=True, capture_output=True)
    if result.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "Command failed: " + " ".join(command) + "\n" + result.stdout + result.stderr
        )
    return {"command": command, "returncode": result.returncode, "stdout": result.stdout[-8000:], "stderr": result.stderr[-8000:]}


def database_check():
    before = sha(DB)
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB.resolve().as_uri() + "?mode=ro", uri=True)
    try:
        conn.execute("PRAGMA query_only=ON")
        result = {
            "quick_check": conn.execute("PRAGMA quick_check").fetchone()[0],
            "foreign_key_violations": conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_key_check").fetchall(),
            "total_changes": conn.total_changes,
        }
    finally:
        conn.close()
    result.update(sha256_before=before, sha256_after=sha(DB))
    result["unchanged"] = result["sha256_before"] == result["sha256_after"]
    return result

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
ROM db.py cleanup readiness report.

Refactor 9.0.12a safety tool.

This tool produces DB_CLEANUP_9_0_12_REPORT.md and shows:
- duplicate top-level definitions in db.py;
- legacy references created by refactor wrappers;
- facade/compatibility markers;
- functions that are likely NOT safe to delete yet because wrappers still depend on legacy refs;
- recommended cleanup order.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import re
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DB_PATH = ROOT / "db.py"
REPORT_PATH = ROOT / "DB_CLEANUP_9_0_12_REPORT.md"

REFAC_SYSTEMS = [
    "systems/character_system.py",
    "systems/player_system.py",
    "systems/contract_system.py",
    "systems/energy_system.py",
    "systems/regen_system.py",
    "systems/equipment_system.py",
    "systems/refine_system.py",
    "systems/guild_system.py",
    "systems/auction_house_system.py",
]

DATA_MODULES = [
    "data/classes.py",
    "data/equipment_profiles.py",
    "data/balance.py",
]


def read_text(path: Path) -> str:
    return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")


def parse_defs(text: str):
    tree = ast.parse(text)
    results = []

    for node in tree.body:
        if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
            results.append({
                "name": node.name,
                "lineno": node.lineno,
                "end_lineno": getattr(node, "end_lineno", node.lineno),
                "kind": "async def" if isinstance(node, ast.AsyncFunctionDef) else "def",
            })
        elif isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef):
            results.append({
                "name": node.name,
                "lineno": node.lineno,
                "end_lineno": getattr(node, "end_lineno", node.lineno),
                "kind": "class",
            })

    return results


def duplicate_defs(defs):
    by_name = defaultdict(list)
    for row in defs:
        by_name[row["name"]].append(row)
    return {name: rows for name, rows in by_name.items() if len(rows) > 1}


def legacy_refs(text: str):
    pattern = re.compile(r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])_legacy_[A-Za-z0-9_]+")
    found = sorted(set(pattern.findall(text)))
    by_func = defaultdict(list)

    for legacy_name in found:
        inferred = legacy_name

        for prefix in [
            "_legacy_regen_v1_",
            "_legacy_equipment_ro_v1_",
            "_legacy_equipment_write_v1_",
            "_legacy_equipment_rds_v1_",
            "_legacy_",
        ]:
            if inferred.startswith(prefix):
                inferred = inferred[len(prefix):]
                break

        for suffix in [
            "_before_character_system_v1",
            "_before_player_system_v1",
            "_before_contract_system_v1",
            "_before_energy_system_v1",
        ]:
            if inferred.endswith(suffix):
                inferred = inferred[:-len(suffix)]

        by_func[inferred].append(legacy_name)

    return found, by_func


def facade_markers(text: str):
    markers = []
    for i, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), start=1):
        if "REFACTOR 9.0" in line or "ROM 9.0" in line or "COMPATIBILITY" in line:
            if line.strip().startswith("#"):
                markers.append((i, line.strip()))
    return markers


def module_status(paths):
    rows = []
    for rel in paths:
        path = ROOT / rel
        rows.append((rel, path.exists(), path.stat().st_size if path.exists() else 0))
    return rows


def build_report():
    if not DB_PATH.exists():
        raise SystemExit("db.py not found")

    text = read_text(DB_PATH)
    defs = parse_defs(text)
    duplicates = duplicate_defs(defs)
    legacy_names, legacy_by_func = legacy_refs(text)
    markers = facade_markers(text)
    systems = module_status(REFAC_SYSTEMS)
    data_modules = module_status(DATA_MODULES)

    unsafe_delete = []
    maybe_cleanup_later = []

    for name, rows in duplicates.items():
        if name in legacy_by_func:
            unsafe_delete.append((name, rows, legacy_by_func[name]))
        else:
            maybe_cleanup_later.append((name, rows))

    lines = []
    lines.append("# DB Cleanup 9.0.12 Readiness Report")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("This report was generated by `tools/db_cleanup_readiness.py`.")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("## Summary")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append(f"- Top-level definitions in `db.py`: **{len(defs)}**")
    lines.append(f"- Duplicate definition names: **{len(duplicates)}**")
    lines.append(f"- Legacy reference variables detected: **{len(legacy_names)}**")
    lines.append(f"- Duplicate functions currently unsafe to delete because compatibility wrappers still reference legacy implementations: **{len(unsafe_delete)}**")
    lines.append(f"- Duplicate functions that may be cleanup candidates later: **{len(maybe_cleanup_later)}**")
    lines.append("")

    lines.append("## Refactor modules status")
    lines.append("")
    for rel, exists, size in systems:
        status = "OK" if exists else "MISSING"
        lines.append(f"- `{rel}` — **{status}** ({size} bytes)")
    lines.append("")

    lines.append("## Data modules status")
    lines.append("")
    for rel, exists, size in data_modules:
        status = "OK" if exists else "MISSING"
        lines.append(f"- `{rel}` — **{status}** ({size} bytes)")
    lines.append("")

    lines.append("## Facade / compatibility markers found in db.py")
    lines.append("")
    if markers:
        for lineno, marker in markers[-80:]:
            lines.append(f"- line {lineno}: `{marker}`")
    else:
        lines.append("No markers found.")
    lines.append("")

    lines.append("## Duplicate definitions")
    lines.append("")
    if duplicates:
        for name, rows in sorted(duplicates.items()):
            places = ", ".join(f"{row['kind']}@{row['lineno']}" for row in rows)
            lines.append(f"- `{name}`: {places}")
    else:
        lines.append("No duplicates found.")
    lines.append("")

    lines.append("## Unsafe-to-delete duplicates right now")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("These names are still referenced by `_legacy_*` compatibility variables. Do **not** delete old implementations yet unless the target system has a real implementation and no longer calls legacy.")
    lines.append("")
    if unsafe_delete:
        for name, rows, refs in sorted(unsafe_delete, key=lambda x: x[0]):
            places = ", ".join(f"line {row['lineno']}" for row in rows)
            ref_text = ", ".join(refs[:6])
            if len(refs) > 6:
                ref_text += f", ... +{len(refs) - 6}"
            lines.append(f"- `{name}` ({places}) — refs: `{ref_text}`")
    else:
        lines.append("None detected.")
    lines.append("")

    lines.append("## Possible later cleanup candidates")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("These duplicates did not match a detected `_legacy_*` reference. They still require manual review before deletion.")
    lines.append("")
    if maybe_cleanup_later:
        for name, rows in sorted(maybe_cleanup_later, key=lambda x: x[0]):
            places = ", ".join(f"line {row['lineno']}" for row in rows)
            lines.append(f"- `{name}` ({places})")
    else:
        lines.append("None detected.")
    lines.append("")

    lines.append("## Recommended next steps")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("1. Do **not** mass-delete old `db.py` implementations yet. Most 9.0 systems are compatibility facades that still call legacy implementations.")
    lines.append("2. Convert each system from legacy delegation to real implementation one domain at a time.")
    lines.append("3. After a system no longer calls `_legacy_*`, remove the corresponding old `db.py` implementations and keep only facade wrappers.")
    lines.append("4. Run checks after each cleanup:")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("```powershell")
    lines.append("python -m py_compile .\\db.py")
    lines.append("python tools/check_imports.py")
    lines.append("python tools/smoke_test_rom_core.py")
    lines.append("python tools/db_cleanup_readiness.py")
    lines.append("```")
    lines.append("")

    REPORT_PATH.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

    return {
        "definitions": len(defs),
        "duplicates": len(duplicates),
        "legacy_refs": len(legacy_names),
        "unsafe_delete": len(unsafe_delete),
        "maybe_cleanup_later": len(maybe_cleanup_later),
        "report": str(REPORT_PATH),
    }


def main():
    result = build_report()
    print("DB cleanup 9.0.12 readiness")
    print("============================")
    for key, value in result.items():
        print(f"{key}: {value}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""ROM 9.0.12 final closure audit.

This tool does not alter gameplay code. It validates the final cleanup state,
runs the approved post-cleanup contract suite, checks for leaked fixture rows,
and writes DB_CLEANUP_9_0_12_FINAL_CLOSURE.md.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

REPORT = ROOT / "DB_CLEANUP_9_0_12_FINAL_CLOSURE.md"
READINESS = ROOT / "tools" / "db_cleanup_readiness.py"

# Curated final-state suites only. Historical pre-cleanup audits are intentionally
# excluded because their structural expectations describe earlier migration stages.
TESTS = (
    "smoke_test_character_mutation_contracts.py",
    "smoke_test_player_contracts.py",
    "smoke_test_player_progression_direct.py",
    "smoke_test_player_combat_stats.py",
    "smoke_test_energy_contracts.py",
    "smoke_test_regen_contracts.py",
    "smoke_test_equipment_class_compatibility.py",
    "smoke_test_equipment_readonly_core.py",
    "smoke_test_equipment_write_contracts.py",
    "smoke_test_equipment_durability_contracts.py",
    "smoke_test_equipment_trader_contracts.py",
    "smoke_test_dynamic_equipment_repair_contracts.py",
    "smoke_test_inventory_refine_contracts.py",
    "smoke_test_weapon_damage_contracts.py",
    "smoke_test_contract_contracts.py",
    "smoke_test_contract_reward_direct_facade.py",
    "smoke_test_auction_lifecycle_contracts.py",
    "smoke_test_rom_core.py",
    "check_imports.py",
)

FORBIDDEN_IDENTIFIERS = (
    "_base_claim_contract_reward_before_guild_reward_v1",
    "_guild_contract_reward_result_success_v1",
    "_guild_contract_reward_append_message_v1",
)


def fail(message):
    print(f"[FAIL] {message}")
    raise SystemExit(1)


def parse_python(path):
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    return text, ast.parse(text, filename=str(path))


def top_level_definitions(tree):
    definitions = {}
    for node in tree.body:
        if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef, ast.ClassDef)):
            definitions.setdefault(node.name, []).append(node)
    return definitions


VOLATILE_USER_COLUMNS = {
    # Runtime smoke tests intentionally synchronize derived HP and regeneration state.
    "hp",
    "max_hp",
    "last_hp_regen_update",
    "hp_full_notified",
    "last_regen_at",
    "energy",
    "last_energy_update",
    "energy_full_notified",
}


def users_snapshot(db, include_volatile=False):
    all_columns = [row[1] for row in db.conn.execute("PRAGMA table_info(users)").fetchall()]
    columns = [
        name for name in all_columns
        if include_volatile or name not in VOLATILE_USER_COLUMNS
    ]
    select_list = ",".join(f'"{name}"' for name in columns)
    rows = [
        tuple(row)
        for row in db.conn.execute(
            f"SELECT {select_list} FROM users WHERE user_id>=0 ORDER BY user_id"
        ).fetchall()
    ]
    return columns, rows


def volatile_user_changes(before, after):
    before_columns, before_rows = before
    after_columns, after_rows = after
    if before_columns != after_columns:
        return ["volatile schema changed"]
    before_map = {row[before_columns.index("user_id")]: row for row in before_rows}
    after_map = {row[after_columns.index("user_id")]: row for row in after_rows}
    changes = []
    for user_id in sorted(set(before_map) | set(after_map)):
        if user_id not in before_map or user_id not in after_map:
            changes.append(f"user set changed for {user_id}")
            continue
        for index, column in enumerate(before_columns):
            if before_map[user_id][index] != after_map[user_id][index]:
                changes.append(f"user_id={user_id} column={column}")
    return changes


def negative_fixture_counts(db):
    result = {}
    tables = [
        row[0]
        for row in db.conn.execute(
            "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%'"
        ).fetchall()
    ]
    for table in tables:
        try:
            columns = {
                row[1] for row in db.conn.execute(f'PRAGMA table_info("{table}")').fetchall()
            }
            if "user_id" not in columns:
                continue
            count = int(
                db.conn.execute(
                    f'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "{table}" WHERE user_id<0'
                ).fetchone()[0]
                or 0
            )
            if count:
                result[table] = count
        except Exception:
            continue
    return result


def run_capture(path):
    env = os.environ.copy()
    # Force UTF-8 for every child test, independent of the current PowerShell session.
    env["PYTHONUTF8"] = "1"
    env["PYTHONIOENCODING"] = "utf-8"
    result = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, str(path)],
        cwd=ROOT,
        env=env,
        text=True,
        encoding="utf-8",
        errors="replace",
        capture_output=True,
        check=False,
    )
    output = (result.stdout or "") + (result.stderr or "")
    print(output, end="" if output.endswith("\n") or not output else "\n")
    return result.returncode, output


def main():
    db_path = ROOT / "db.py"
    tools = ROOT / "tools"

    if not db_path.is_file():
        fail("db.py not found")
    if not READINESS.is_file():
        fail("tools/db_cleanup_readiness.py not found")

    missing_tests = [name for name in TESTS if not (tools / name).is_file()]
    if missing_tests:
        fail(f"missing final test files: {missing_tests}")

    db_text, db_tree = parse_python(db_path)
    definitions = top_level_definitions(db_tree)
    duplicates = {
        name: [node.lineno for node in nodes]
        for name, nodes in definitions.items()
        if len(nodes) > 1
    }
    if duplicates:
        fail(f"top-level duplicates remain: {duplicates}")

    for identifier in FORBIDDEN_IDENTIFIERS:
        if re.search(rf"(?<![A-Za-z0-9_]){re.escape(identifier)}(?![A-Za-z0-9_])", db_text):
            fail(f"obsolete identifier remains in db.py: {identifier}")

    claim_nodes = definitions.get("claim_contract_reward", [])
    if len(claim_nodes) != 1:
        fail(f"claim_contract_reward definitions={len(claim_nodes)}, expected 1")
    claim_source = ast.get_source_segment(db_text, claim_nodes[0]) or ""
    if "systems.contract_system" not in claim_source:
        fail("claim_contract_reward is not the final Contract System facade")

    # Import only after structural checks.
    import db

    users_before = users_snapshot(db, include_volatile=False)
    volatile_before = users_snapshot(db, include_volatile=True)
    negative_before = negative_fixture_counts(db)
    if negative_before:
        fail(f"negative fixture rows exist before closure tests: {negative_before}")

    test_results = []
    for test_name in TESTS:
        code, output = run_capture(tools / test_name)
        summary = "PASS" if code == 0 else f"FAIL ({code})"
        test_results.append((test_name, summary, output))
        if code != 0:
            fail(f"final suite failed: {test_name}, exit code {code}")

    readiness_code, readiness_output = run_capture(READINESS)
    if readiness_code != 0:
        fail(f"readiness failed with exit code {readiness_code}")

    expected_readiness = (
        "definitions: 348",
        "duplicates: 0",
        "legacy_refs: 0",
        "unsafe_delete: 0",
        "maybe_cleanup_later: 0",
    )
    for expected in expected_readiness:
        if expected not in readiness_output:
            fail(f"readiness missing expected value: {expected}")

    users_after = users_snapshot(db, include_volatile=False)
    if users_before != users_after:
        fail("stable real-user fields changed during final closure suite")

    volatile_after = users_snapshot(db, include_volatile=True)
    volatile_changes = volatile_user_changes(volatile_before, volatile_after)
    disallowed_volatile = [
        item for item in volatile_changes
        if not any(f"column={column}" in item for column in VOLATILE_USER_COLUMNS)
    ]
    if disallowed_volatile:
        fail(f"unexpected real-user changes detected: {disallowed_volatile}")

    negative_after = negative_fixture_counts(db)
    if negative_after:
        fail(f"fixture rows leaked after closure tests: {negative_after}")

    generated_at = datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds")
    report = [
        "# ROM 9.0.12 — Final DB Cleanup Closure",
        "",
        f"Generated: `{generated_at}`",
        "",
        "## Final status",
        "",
        "**ROM 9.0.12 DB cleanup: COMPLETE**",
        "",
        "- Top-level definitions in `db.py`: **348**",
        "- Duplicate definition names: **0**",
        "- Legacy references: **0**",
        "- Unsafe-delete candidates: **0**",
        "- Deferred cleanup candidates: **0**",
        "- Obsolete Contract Reward capture/helpers: **0**",
        "- Negative fixture rows before tests: **0**",
        "- Negative fixture rows after tests: **0**",
        "- Stable real-user field mutations during closure suite: **0**",
        f"- Allowed derived/volatile user-field synchronizations: **{len(volatile_changes)}**",
        "",
        "## Final Contract Reward architecture",
        "",
        "- `db.claim_contract_reward()` is a single public facade.",
        "- Runtime implementation lives in `systems.contract_system`.",
        "- Base reward, EXP, daily counter, Guild reward, and repeat-claim protection are contract-tested.",
        "",
        "## Final verification suite",
        "",
    ]
    for test_name, status, _output in test_results:
        report.append(f"- `{test_name}` — **{status}**")
    report.extend([
        "- `db_cleanup_readiness.py` — **PASS**",
        "",
        "## Closure decision",
        "",
        "The duplicate-removal program is closed. Historical audit and patch files may remain for traceability, but no further duplicate cleanup is required for ROM 9.0.12.",
        "",
        "Future functional refactors should start under a new versioned plan and must not reuse the completed 9.0.12 cleanup sequence.",
        "",
    ])
    REPORT.write_text("\n".join(report), encoding="utf-8")

    print("[OK] ROM 9.0.12 final DB cleanup closure")
    print("- definitions: 348")
    print("- duplicates: 0")
    print("- legacy refs: 0")
    print("- unsafe delete: 0")
    print("- deferred cleanup: 0")
    print(f"- final suites passed: {len(TESTS)}")
    print("- fixture leaks: 0")
    print("- stable real user mutations: 0")
    print(f"- allowed volatile field synchronizations: {len(volatile_changes)}")
    print("- status: COMPLETE")
    print(f"- report: {REPORT}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
r"""Controlled manual-test helper for ROM Stage 18.6.1.

Usage from ROM root:
  python .\tools\manual_test_inactivity_reminder_18_6_1.py backup 8914495259
  python .\tools\manual_test_inactivity_reminder_18_6_1.py prepare-before 8914495259
  python .\tools\manual_test_inactivity_reminder_18_6_1.py prepare-due 8914495259
  python .\tools\manual_test_inactivity_reminder_18_6_1.py status 8914495259
  python .\tools\manual_test_inactivity_reminder_18_6_1.py restore 8914495259
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import shutil
import sqlite3
import sys
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from pathlib import Path

SESSION_PREFIX = "manual_inactivity_test_18_6_1"
REMINDER_COLUMNS = (
    "id",
    "user_id",
    "inactivity_started_at",
    "eligible_at",
    "attempted_at",
    "delivery_status",
    "error_type",
    "created_at",
    "updated_at",
)


def rom_root() -> Path:
    here = Path(__file__).resolve()
    for candidate in (here.parent.parent, Path.cwd(), Path.cwd().parent):
        if (candidate / "db.py").is_file() and (candidate / "game.db").is_file():
            return candidate.resolve()
    raise RuntimeError("ROM root not found")


def state_path(root: Path, user_id: int) -> Path:
    return root / "backup" / f"{SESSION_PREFIX}_{user_id}.json"


def db_backup_path(root: Path, user_id: int) -> Path:
    return root / "backup" / f"{SESSION_PREFIX}_{user_id}_game.db"


def connect(root: Path) -> sqlite3.Connection:
    connection = sqlite3.connect(str(root / "game.db"), timeout=30)
    connection.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    connection.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON")
    connection.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout=30000")
    return connection


def utc_now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).replace(microsecond=0)


def require_schema(connection: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:
    users_columns = {
        row[1] for row in connection.execute("PRAGMA table_info(users)").fetchall()
    }
    required_users = {"user_id", "character_name", "character_class", "last_activity_at"}
    if not required_users.issubset(users_columns):
        missing = sorted(required_users - users_columns)
        raise RuntimeError(f"users schema is missing columns: {missing}")

    reminder_columns = {
        row[1]
        for row in connection.execute("PRAGMA table_info(inactivity_reminders)").fetchall()
    }
    if not set(REMINDER_COLUMNS).issubset(reminder_columns):
        missing = sorted(set(REMINDER_COLUMNS) - reminder_columns)
        raise RuntimeError(f"inactivity_reminders schema is missing columns: {missing}")


def read_user(connection: sqlite3.Connection, user_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row:
    row = connection.execute(
        """
        SELECT user_id, character_name, character_class, last_activity_at
        FROM users
        WHERE user_id=?
        """,
        (user_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        raise RuntimeError("Test user was not found in users")
    if not str(row["character_name"] or "").strip():
        raise RuntimeError("Test user has no character_name")
    if not str(row["character_class"] or "").strip():
        raise RuntimeError("Test user has no character_class")
    return row


def read_reminders(connection: sqlite3.Connection, user_id: int) -> list[dict]:
    rows = connection.execute(
        "SELECT * FROM inactivity_reminders WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY id",
        (user_id,),
    ).fetchall()
    return [{column: row[column] for column in REMINDER_COLUMNS} for row in rows]


def write_state(root: Path, user_id: int, user: sqlite3.Row, reminders: list[dict]) -> None:
    root.joinpath("backup").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    state = {
        "stage": "18.6.1",
        "user_id": user_id,
        "created_at_utc": utc_now().isoformat(),
        "original_last_activity_at": user["last_activity_at"],
        "original_reminders": reminders,
    }
    state_path(root, user_id).write_text(
        json.dumps(state, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8"
    )


def backup(root: Path, user_id: int) -> None:
    state = state_path(root, user_id)
    if state.exists():
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"Active test backup already exists: {state.name}. Run restore first."
        )
    connection = connect(root)
    try:
        require_schema(connection)
        user = read_user(connection, user_id)
        reminders = read_reminders(connection, user_id)
    finally:
        connection.close()
    shutil.copy2(root / "game.db", db_backup_path(root, user_id))
    write_state(root, user_id, user, reminders)
    print("[PASS] Manual-test backup created")
    print(f"State: backup\\{state.name}")
    print(f"DB copy: backup\\{db_backup_path(root, user_id).name}")
    print("Original values are stored locally and were not printed")


def ensure_backup(root: Path, user_id: int) -> None:
    if not state_path(root, user_id).is_file():
        backup(root, user_id)


def set_cycle(root: Path, user_id: int, mode: str) -> None:
    ensure_backup(root, user_id)
    now = utc_now()
    if mode == "prepare-before":
        value = now - timedelta(days=7) + timedelta(seconds=1)
        expected = "INELIGIBLE for approximately one second"
    elif mode == "prepare-due":
        value = now - timedelta(days=7)
        expected = "ELIGIBLE immediately"
    else:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Unknown preparation mode: {mode}")

    stamp = value.isoformat()
    connection = connect(root)
    try:
        require_schema(connection)
        read_user(connection, user_id)
        connection.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        connection.execute(
            "DELETE FROM inactivity_reminders WHERE user_id=?",
            (user_id,),
        )
        changed = connection.execute(
            "UPDATE users SET last_activity_at=? WHERE user_id=?",
            (stamp, user_id),
        ).rowcount
        if changed != 1:
            raise RuntimeError("Expected exactly one users row to be updated")
        connection.commit()
    except Exception:
        connection.rollback()
        raise
    finally:
        connection.close()

    print(f"[PASS] {mode} completed")
    print(f"Expected state: {expected}")
    print("Reminder rows for the test user were cleared for this controlled cycle")
    print("Do not send messages from the test account before the worker check")


def status(root: Path, user_id: int) -> None:
    connection = connect(root)
    try:
        require_schema(connection)
        user = read_user(connection, user_id)
        reminders = read_reminders(connection, user_id)
        quick = connection.execute("PRAGMA quick_check").fetchone()[0]
        foreign_keys = list(connection.execute("PRAGMA foreign_key_check"))
    finally:
        connection.close()

    print("[PASS] Current test state")
    print(f"User ID: {user_id}")
    print(f"Character: {user['character_name']}")
    print(f"Class: {user['character_class']}")
    print(f"last_activity_at: {user['last_activity_at']}")
    print(f"Reminder records: {len(reminders)}")
    for row in reminders:
        print(
            f"  id={row['id']} status={row['delivery_status']} "
            f"cycle={row['inactivity_started_at']} error_type={row['error_type']}"
        )
    print(f"quick_check: {quick}")
    print(f"foreign_key_violations: {len(foreign_keys)}")


def restore(root: Path, user_id: int) -> None:
    state_file = state_path(root, user_id)
    if not state_file.is_file():
        raise RuntimeError("Manual-test state backup was not found")
    state = json.loads(state_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if int(state.get("user_id")) != user_id:
        raise RuntimeError("Backup user ID mismatch")

    connection = connect(root)
    try:
        require_schema(connection)
        read_user(connection, user_id)
        connection.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        connection.execute("DELETE FROM inactivity_reminders WHERE user_id=?", (user_id,))
        for row in state.get("original_reminders", []):
            placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in REMINDER_COLUMNS)
            columns = ",".join(REMINDER_COLUMNS)
            connection.execute(
                f"INSERT INTO inactivity_reminders({columns}) VALUES({placeholders})",
                tuple(row.get(column) for column in REMINDER_COLUMNS),
            )
        changed = connection.execute(
            "UPDATE users SET last_activity_at=? WHERE user_id=?",
            (state.get("original_last_activity_at"), user_id),
        ).rowcount
        if changed != 1:
            raise RuntimeError("Expected exactly one users row to be restored")
        connection.commit()
        quick = connection.execute("PRAGMA quick_check").fetchone()[0]
        foreign_keys = list(connection.execute("PRAGMA foreign_key_check"))
        if quick != "ok" or foreign_keys:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"Post-restore database check failed: quick={quick}, FK={len(foreign_keys)}"
            )
    except Exception:
        connection.rollback()
        raise
    finally:
        connection.close()

    state_file.unlink()
    db_copy = db_backup_path(root, user_id)
    if db_copy.exists():
        db_copy.unlink()
    print("[PASS] Original test-user state restored")
    print("Temporary state and DB copy removed")
    print("main.py may be started")


def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="ROM Stage 18.6.1 manual-test helper")
    parser.add_argument(
        "action",
        choices=("backup", "prepare-before", "prepare-due", "status", "restore"),
    )
    parser.add_argument("user_id", type=int)
    return parser.parse_args()


def main() -> int:
    args = parse_args()
    root = rom_root()
    if args.user_id <= 0:
        raise RuntimeError("user_id must be positive")
    if args.action == "backup":
        backup(root, args.user_id)
    elif args.action in {"prepare-before", "prepare-due"}:
        set_cycle(root, args.user_id, args.action)
    elif args.action == "status":
        status(root, args.user_id)
    elif args.action == "restore":
        restore(root, args.user_id)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        raise SystemExit(main())
    except Exception as error:
        print(f"[FAIL] {type(error).__name__}: {error}")
        print("Do not start main.py until the failure is understood or restore succeeds")
        raise SystemExit(1)

CLASSES=("warrior","knight","scout","rogue","mage","priest")
RESOURCE={"warrior":"rage","knight":"rage","scout":"combat_energy","rogue":"combat_energy_combo","mage":"mana","priest":"mana"}
EXPECTED_EFFECT={
    "warrior_suppression":"pdef_down",
    "knight_holy_protection":"shield",
    "scout_trap":"pdef_down",
    "scout_sting_arrow":"poison",

    "mage_arcane_flow":"mana_restore",
    "priest_healing_blessing":"hot",
    "priest_purify_faith":"mdef_buff",
