def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if path.exists() else None


def actor(uid, cls, *, hp=1000, resource=100, combo=3, mp=500, effects=None, cooldowns=None, afk=0, stunned=False):
    return PvpActorState(
        user_id=uid,class_key=cls,character_name=f"Actor{uid}",max_hp=1000,hp=hp,
        max_mp=500,mp=mp,resource_type=RESOURCE[cls],resource=resource,combo=combo,
        physical_attack=75,magical_attack=75,physical_defense=35,magical_defense=35,
        weapon_physical_min=20,weapon_physical_max=20,weapon_magical_min=20,weapon_magical_max=20,
        physical_crit_chance=0,magical_crit_chance=0,dodge_chance=0,level=20,
        effects=dict(effects or {}),cooldowns=dict(cooldowns or {}),consecutive_afk=afk,stunned_next=stunned,
    )


def outcome_for(result, uid):
    return next(item for item in result.outcomes if int(item.user_id)==int(uid))


def run_skill(cls, skill, seed):
    own=actor(1,cls,hp=700,mp=400,resource=100,combo=3)
    enemy=actor(2,"warrior",resource=0,combo=0)
    if skill.get("effect")=="restore_mana_percent": own.mp=100
    if skill.get("effect")=="player_cleanse_mdef_buff":
        own.mp=200
        own.effects={"poison":{"kind":"poison","power":5,"duration":3,"source_id":2},"pdef_down":{"kind":"pdef_down","percent":30,"duration":3,"source_id":2}}
    result=resolve_pvp_round(1,1,own,enemy,PvpActionIntent(1,"skill",skill["key"]),PvpActionIntent(2,"afk_skip"),seed=seed)
    outcome=outcome_for(result,1)
    assert outcome.valid, (cls,skill["key"],outcome.reason)
    assert outcome.resource_spent>=0
    if skill.get("no_damage") or float(skill.get("damage_multiplier") or 0)==0:
        assert outcome.damage==0, skill["key"]
    else:
        assert outcome.damage>0, skill["key"]
    effect=EXPECTED_EFFECT.get(skill["key"])
    if effect:
        applied={str(x.get("effect_key")) for x in outcome.applied_effects}
        assert effect in applied, (skill["key"],applied)
    return {
        "class":cls,"key":skill["key"],"valid":outcome.valid,"damage":outcome.damage,
        "resource_spent":outcome.resource_spent,"resource_gained":outcome.resource_gained,
        "combo_spent":outcome.combo_spent,"combo_gained":outcome.combo_gained,
        "effects":[dict(x) for x in outcome.applied_effects],
    }


def main():
    db_before={name:digest(ROOT/name) for name in ("game.db","game.db-wal")}
    combat_path=ROOT/"handlers/combat.py"

    assert not outcome_for(cd,1).valid and outcome_for(cd,1).reason=="skill_on_cooldown"

    assert outcome_for(stun,1).action_type=="stunned_skip" and stun.actor_a["consecutive_afk"]==0
    periodic=resolve_pvp_round(2,2,actor(1,"priest",hp=900,effects={"hot":{"kind":"hot","power":50,"duration":2,"source_id":1}}),actor(2,"warrior",hp=900,effects={"poison":{"kind":"poison","power":20,"duration":2,"source_id":1}}),PvpActionIntent(1,"afk_skip"),PvpActionIntent(2,"afk_skip"),seed=10)
    event_types={e["type"] for e in periodic.events}

    assert periodic.actor_a["effects"]["hot"]["duration"]==1
    assert periodic.actor_b["effects"]["poison"]["duration"]==1
    cleanse=next(x for x in rows if x["key"]=="priest_purify_faith")
    assert any(x.get("effect_key")=="mdef_buff" for x in cleanse["effects"])

def _write(path: Path, text: str) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temporary = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".tmp")
    temporary.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    temporary.replace(path)


def _markdown(report: dict) -> str:
    forty = report["inventory"]["40"]
    sixty = report["inventory"]["60"]
    delta = report["inventory_60_minus_40"]
    lines = [
        "# Economy and Guild Acceptance 13.8.2",
        "",
        f"- Verdict: **{report['verdict']}**",
        f"- Guild member limit: **{report['guild_member_limit']}**",
        f"- Scenario count: **{report['scenario_count']}**",
        "",
        "## Inventory 40 vs 60",
        "",
        f"- Mean total net worth, 40 slots: {forty['mean_total_net_worth']}",
        f"- Mean total net worth, 60 slots: {sixty['mean_total_net_worth']}",
        f"- Delta 60-40: {delta['mean_total_net_worth']}",
        f"- Mean city visits, 40 slots: {forty['mean_city_visits']}",
        f"- Mean city visits, 60 slots: {sixty['mean_city_visits']}",
        f"- Mean items lost, 40 slots: {forty['mean_items_lost']}",
        f"- Mean items lost, 60 slots: {sixty['mean_items_lost']}",
        "",
        "## Guild populations",
        "",
    ]
    for row in report["guild_populations"]:
        lines.append(f"- {row['players']} players: mode={row['mode']}, guild EXP={row['guild_exp']}, kills={row['kills']}, contracts={row['contracts']}")
    if report["failures"]:
        lines.extend(["", "## Failures", ""] + [f"- {item}" for item in report["failures"]])
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--target-level", type=int, default=2)
    parser.add_argument("--profile", choices=("casual", "regular", "hardcore"), default="regular")
    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=138200)
    parser.add_argument("--force", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    report = run_acceptance(ROOT, args.target_level, args.profile, args.seed, args.force)
    audit_json = ROOT / "MD" / "SIMULATION_ECONOMY_GUILD_ACCEPTANCE_13_8_2.json"
    audit_md = ROOT / "MD" / "SIMULATION_ECONOMY_GUILD_ACCEPTANCE_13_8_2.md"
    comparison_json = ROOT / "MD" / "SIMULATION_INVENTORY_40_60_COMPARISON_13_8_2.json"
    comparison_md = ROOT / "MD" / "SIMULATION_INVENTORY_40_60_COMPARISON_13_8_2.md"
    _write(audit_json, json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    _write(audit_md, _markdown(report))
    comparison = {
        "version": report["version"],
        "target_level": report["target_level"],
        "profile": report["profile"],
        "inventory": report["inventory"],
        "inventory_60_minus_40": report["inventory_60_minus_40"],
        "asset_coverage": {"40": report["inventory"]["40"]["asset_coverage"], "60": report["inventory"]["60"]["asset_coverage"]},
        "database_writes": 0,
    }
    _write(comparison_json, json.dumps(comparison, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")

 for node in ast.walk(tree):
  if isinstance(node,ast.Dict):
   values={k.value:v for k,v in zip(node.keys,node.values) if isinstance(k,ast.Constant) and isinstance(k.value,str)}
   value=values.get("level")
   if isinstance(value,ast.Constant) and isinstance(value.value,int):max_level=max(max_level,value.value)
 if max_level<20:
  findings.append({"severity":"INFO","code":"production_content_ceiling","message":f"Current production mob content ends at level {max_level}; target level 20 cannot be accepted without future content."})
 return findings,max_level

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from systems.simulation.guild_population import simulate_guild_population
from systems.simulation.population_cache import load_progression_cache
from systems.simulation.population_reporting import atomic_json, guild_markdown


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--target-level", type=int, default=3)
    parser.add_argument("--inventory", type=int, choices=(40, 60), default=40)
    parser.add_argument("--players", default="10,50,100,500,1000")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    populations = [int(item.strip()) for item in args.players.split(",") if item.strip()]
    rows = load_progression_cache(ROOT, args.target_level, args.inventory)
    if not rows:
        raise SystemExit("No cached progression payloads match the requested parameters")
    values = [simulate_guild_population(rows, players).to_dict() for players in populations]
    report = {
        "schema": "rom.simulation.guild_population.v1",
        "version": "13.8.0",
        "target_level": args.target_level,
        "inventory_capacity": args.inventory,
        "source_runs": len(rows),
        "populations": values,
        "database_writes": 0,
    }
    base = ROOT / "MD" / f"SIMULATION_GUILD_POPULATION_13_8_0_l{args.target_level}_{args.inventory}slots"
    atomic_json(base.with_suffix(".json"), report)
    base.with_suffix(".md").write_text(guild_markdown(report), encoding="utf-8")
    print("[OK] Guild population simulation 13.8.0")
    print(f"- cached source runs: {len(rows)}")
    print(f"- populations: {','.join(map(str, populations))}")
    print(f"- JSON: {base.with_suffix('.json').relative_to(ROOT)}")
    print(f"- Markdown: {base.with_suffix('.md').relative_to(ROOT)}")
    print("- database writes: 0")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from systems.simulation.balance_analyzer import (
    AnalysisConfig,
    CLASSES,
    PROFILES,
    build_balance_report,
    build_execution_plan,
    execute_plan,
    inspect_execution_plan,
)
from systems.simulation.progression_wall_analyzer import build_progression_wall_report


def parse_csv(value, allowed):
    if value == "all":
        return tuple(allowed)
    result = tuple(item.strip() for item in value.split(",") if item.strip())
    if any(item not in allowed for item in result):
        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError(f"invalid value: {value}")
    return result


def write_json(path, data):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temporary = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".tmp")
    temporary.write_text(
        json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    temporary.replace(path)


def write_balance_md(path, data):
    config = data["config"]
    execution = data.get("execution", {})
    lines = [
        "# PvE Balance Analysis 13.7.1",
        "",
        f"- Target level: **{config['target_level']}**",
        f"- Profiles: **{', '.join(config['profiles'])}**",
        f"- Seeds: **{len(config['seeds'])}**",
        f"- Main result runs: **{data['run_count']}**",
        f"- Unique scenarios executed/planned: **{execution.get('unique_scenarios', 0)}**",
        f"- Cache hits: **{execution.get('cache_hits', 0)}**",
        f"- Fresh runs: **{execution.get('fresh_runs', 0)}**",
        f"- Workers: **{execution.get('workers', 1)}**",
        f"- Inventory: **{config['inventory_capacity']}**",
        "",
        "## Class results",
        "",
        "| Class | Profile | Runs | Win rate | Death rate | Mean battles | Mean days | EXP/hour | Gold/hour | Lost items |",
        "|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|",
    ]
    for character_class, profiles in data["groups"].items():
        for profile, item in profiles.items():
            lines.append(
                f"| {character_class} | {profile} | {item['runs']} | "
                f"{item['win_rate']:.2%} | {item['death_rate']:.2%} | "
                f"{item['mean_battles']:.2f} | {item['mean_days']:.2f} | "
                f"{item['exp_per_elapsed_hour']:.2f} | {item['gold_per_elapsed_hour']:.2f} | "
                f"{item['mean_items_lost']:.2f} |"
            )
    if data.get("inventory_comparison"):
        lines.extend(
            [
                "",
                "## Inventory 40 vs 60",
                "",
                "| Slots | Full bag events | Lost items | City visits | Mean final gold |",
                "|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|",
            ]
        )
        for slots, item in data["inventory_comparison"].items():
            lines.append(
                f"| {slots} | {item['mean_full_bag_events']:.2f} | "
                f"{item['mean_items_lost']:.2f} | {item['mean_city_visits']:.2f} | "
                f"{item['mean_final_gold']:.2f} |"
            )
    path.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def write_walls_md(path, data):
    lines = [
        "# Progression Wall Analysis 13.7.1",
        "",
        f"- Target level: **{data['target_level']}**",
        f"- Findings: **{len(data['findings'])}**",
        "",
        "## Findings",
    ]
    if not data["findings"]:
        lines.append("- No configured wall threshold was exceeded.")
    for finding in data["findings"]:
        lines.append(
            f"- [{finding['severity']}] {finding['class']} / {finding['profile']} / "
            f"{finding['from_level']}→{finding['to_level']}: "
            f"{'; '.join(finding['reasons'])}"
        )
    path.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def write_checkpoint(path, config, plan_summary, execution=None, status="planned"):
    payload = {
        "schema": "rom.simulation.pve_analysis_checkpoint.v1",
        "version": "13.7.1",
        "status": status,
        "config": {
            "target_level": config.target_level,
            "profiles": list(config.profiles),
            "classes": list(config.classes),
            "seeds": list(config.seeds),
            "inventory_capacity": config.inventory_capacity,
            "compare_inventory": config.compare_inventory,
        },
        "plan": plan_summary,
        "execution": execution or {},
    }
    write_json(path, payload)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--target-level", type=int, default=5)
    parser.add_argument("--profiles", default="regular")
    parser.add_argument("--classes", default="all")
    parser.add_argument("--seeds", type=int, default=10)
    parser.add_argument("--seed-start", type=int, default=137000)
    parser.add_argument("--inventory", type=int, default=40, choices=(40, 60))
    parser.add_argument("--compare-inventory", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--skip-walls", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--skip-inventory-comparison", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--workers", type=int, default=max(1, min((os.cpu_count() or 2) - 1, 4)))
    parser.add_argument("--plan-only", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--force", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--output", default="MD")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if args.seeds < 1:
        parser.error("--seeds must be at least 1")
    if not 1 <= args.workers <= 8:
        parser.error("--workers must be between 1 and 8")

    profiles = parse_csv(args.profiles, PROFILES)
    classes = parse_csv(args.classes, CLASSES)
    seeds = tuple(range(args.seed_start, args.seed_start + args.seeds))
    compare_inventory = args.compare_inventory and not args.skip_inventory_comparison
    config = AnalysisConfig(
        args.target_level,
        profiles,
        classes,
        seeds,
        args.inventory,
        compare_inventory,
    )
    plan = build_execution_plan(
        config,
        include_walls=not args.skip_walls,
        include_inventory=compare_inventory,
    )
    summary = inspect_execution_plan(ROOT, plan, force=args.force)
    output = ROOT / args.output
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    tag = f"l{args.target_level}_{'-'.join(profiles)}_{args.seeds}s"
    checkpoint = output / f"SIMULATION_PVE_ANALYSIS_CHECKPOINT_13_7_1_{tag}.json"
    write_checkpoint(checkpoint, config, summary)

    print("[PLAN] PvE balance analysis")
    print(f"- unique scenarios: {summary['unique_scenarios']}")
    print(f"- cache hits: {summary['cache_hits']}")
    print(f"- new simulations required: {summary['new_simulations']}")
    print(f"- workers: {args.workers}")
    print(f"- walls: {'NO' if args.skip_walls else 'YES'}")
    print(f"- inventory comparison: {'YES' if compare_inventory else 'NO'}")
    print(f"- checkpoint: {checkpoint.relative_to(ROOT)}")
    if args.plan_only:
        print("[OK] Plan-only mode completed; simulations were not started.")
        return

    def progress(done, total, spec, source, elapsed, eta):
        if done == total or done == 1 or done % max(1, total // 20) == 0:
            print(
                f"[progress] {done}/{total} {spec.character_class}/{spec.profile}/"
                f"L{spec.target_level}/slots={spec.inventory_capacity}/seed={spec.seed} "
                f"({source}) elapsed={elapsed:.1f}s eta={eta:.1f}s"
            )

    try:
        payloads, execution = execute_plan(
            ROOT,
            plan,
            workers=args.workers,
            force=args.force,
            progress=progress,
        )
    except RuntimeError as error:
        write_checkpoint(checkpoint, config, inspect_execution_plan(ROOT, plan), status="interrupted")
        print(f"[STOPPED] {error}")
        raise SystemExit(130)

    balance = build_balance_report(config, payloads, execution, include_inventory=compare_inventory)
    walls = None if args.skip_walls else build_progression_wall_report(config, payloads)

    balance_json = output / f"SIMULATION_PVE_BALANCE_13_7_1_{tag}.json"
    balance_md = output / f"SIMULATION_PVE_BALANCE_13_7_1_{tag}.md"
    write_json(balance_json, balance)
    write_balance_md(balance_md, balance)

    walls_json = walls_md = None
    if walls is not None:
        walls_json = output / f"SIMULATION_PROGRESSION_WALLS_13_7_1_{tag}.json"
        walls_md = output / f"SIMULATION_PROGRESSION_WALLS_13_7_1_{tag}.md"
        write_json(walls_json, walls)
        write_walls_md(walls_md, walls)

    write_checkpoint(checkpoint, config, summary, execution, status="completed")
    print("[OK] PvE balance and progression analysis 13.7.1")
    print(f"- unique scenarios: {execution['unique_scenarios']}")
    print(f"- cache hits: {execution['cache_hits']}")
    print(f"- fresh runs: {execution['fresh_runs']}")
    print(f"- workers: {execution['workers']}")
    print(f"- elapsed seconds: {execution['elapsed_seconds']}")
    print(f"- wall findings: {0 if walls is None else len(walls['findings'])}")
    print(f"- balance JSON: {balance_json.relative_to(ROOT)}")
    print(f"- balance Markdown: {balance_md.relative_to(ROOT)}")
    if walls_json:
        print(f"- walls JSON: {walls_json.relative_to(ROOT)}")
        print(f"- walls Markdown: {walls_md.relative_to(ROOT)}")
    print(f"- checkpoint: {checkpoint.relative_to(ROOT)}")
    print("- database writes: 0")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path: sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from systems.simulation.patch_regression import RegressionConfig, analyze_payloads, compare_reports, create_baseline, load_baseline, run_matrix, write_json_atomic


def csv_tuple(value): return tuple(part.strip() for part in str(value).split(",") if part.strip())
def int_tuple(value): return tuple(int(part.strip()) for part in str(value).split(",") if part.strip())

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="ROM RNG percentiles and patch regression analyzer")
    mode = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group(required=True)
    mode.add_argument("--create-baseline", action="store_true")
    mode.add_argument("--compare-baseline", action="store_true")
    mode.add_argument("--replace-baseline", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--baseline-name", default="stage_13_current")
    parser.add_argument("--target-level", type=int, default=2)
    parser.add_argument("--profiles", default="regular")
    parser.add_argument("--classes", default="warrior,knight,scout,rogue,mage,priest")

    parser.add_argument("--seeds", type=int, default=10)
    parser.add_argument("--inventory", default="40,60")
    parser.add_argument("--max-days", type=int, default=365)
    parser.add_argument("--force", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    config = RegressionConfig(target_level=args.target_level, profiles=csv_tuple(args.profiles), classes=csv_tuple(args.classes), seed_start=args.seed_start, seed_count=args.seeds, capacities=int_tuple(args.inventory), max_days=args.max_days)
    def progress(done,total,cls,profile,seed,capacity):
        if done == 1 or done == total or done % max(1,total//10) == 0: print(f"[progress] {done}/{total} {cls}/{profile}/seed={seed}/slots={capacity}")
    payloads = run_matrix(ROOT, config, force=args.force, progress=progress)
    current = analyze_payloads(ROOT, payloads, config)
    current_path = ROOT / "MD" / f"SIMULATION_RNG_CURRENT_13_9_0_{args.baseline_name}.json"
    write_json_atomic(current_path, current)
    replace = bool(args.replace_baseline)
    if args.create_baseline or replace:
        path = create_baseline(ROOT, args.baseline_name, current, replace=replace)
        print("[OK] RNG baseline created" if not replace else "[OK] RNG baseline replaced")
        print(f"- verdict: {current['verdict']}")
        print(f"- scenarios: {current['scenario_count']}")
        print(f"- baseline: {path.relative_to(ROOT)}")
    else:
        baseline = load_baseline(ROOT, args.baseline_name); diff = compare_reports(baseline, current)
        diff_path = ROOT / "MD" / f"SIMULATION_PATCH_REGRESSION_DIFF_13_9_0_{args.baseline_name}.json"; write_json_atomic(diff_path, diff)

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path

from systems.simulation.production_parity import run_required_parity, source_dependency_report


def main():
    parity = run_required_parity()
    dependencies = source_dependency_report()
    output = Path("MD")
    output.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (output / "SIMULATION_CANONICAL_RULES_PARITY_13_2_0.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(parity, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8"
    )
    lines = [
        "# Simulation Canonical Rules Parity 13.2.0", "",
        f"Verdict: **{parity['verdict']}**", "",
        f"- Cases: **{parity['cases']}**",
        f"- Passed: **{parity['passed']}**",
        f"- Failed: **{parity['failed']}**",
        f"- Result SHA-256: `{parity['sha256']}`", "",
        "## Canonical sources", "",
    ]
    for item in dependencies["rules"]:
        lines.append(f"- `{item['rule']}` -> `{item['qualified_name']}` `{item['signature']}` at line {item['source_line']}; RNG injected: `{item['rng_injected']}`")
    failed = [item for item in parity["results"] if not item["passed"]]
    lines += ["", "## Findings", ""]
    if failed:
        for item in failed:
            lines.append(f"- `{item['case_id']}`: {item['error']}")
    else:
        lines.append("- No parity findings.")
    (output / "SIMULATION_CANONICAL_RULES_PARITY_13_2_0.md").write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    if parity["verdict"] != "PASS":
        raise SystemExit(2)
    print("[OK] Canonical parity report generated")
    print(f"- cases: {parity['cases']}")
    print("- verdict: PASS")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from __future__ import annotations
import ast
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def function_source(relative, name):
    text = (ROOT / relative).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    tree = ast.parse(text)
    nodes = [node for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == name]
    assert len(nodes) == 1, (relative, name, len(nodes))
    return ast.get_source_segment(text, nodes[0]) or ""


def main():
    profile = function_source("handlers/profile.py", "build_stats_text")
    assert "physical_attack = get_attack(user_id)" in profile
    assert "magical_attack = get_magic_attack(user_id)" in profile
    assert "physical_attack = total_str" not in profile
    assert "magical_attack = total_int" not in profile

    attack_profile = function_source("db_modules/player.py", "get_player_attack_profile")
    assert attack_profile.count("get_attack(user_id)") == 1
    assert attack_profile.count("get_magic_attack(user_id)") == 1
    assert attack_profile.count("physical_stat_attack") >= 5
    assert attack_profile.count("magical_stat_attack") >= 2
    assert "stat_attack = total_str" not in attack_profile
    assert "stat_attack = total_int" not in attack_profile
    assert '"display_attack": physical_stat_attack' in attack_profile
    assert "display_attack = stat_attack + weapon_max" in attack_profile

    from systems.stat_system import calculate_physical_attack, calculate_magical_attack
    assert calculate_physical_attack("rogue", strength=22, dexterity=31) == 29
    assert calculate_physical_attack("scout", strength=10, dexterity=10) == 11
    assert calculate_physical_attack("warrior", strength=22, dexterity=31) == 22
    assert calculate_physical_attack("knight", strength=22, dexterity=31) == 22
    assert calculate_magical_attack("mage", intelligence=31) == 31
    assert calculate_magical_attack("priest", intelligence=31) == 31
    print("[PASS] profile parameters and attack-profile routes use canonical combat-stat APIs")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
from __future__ import annotations
import sqlite3
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
from systems.attribute_allocation_system import (
    AttributeInvariantError,
    InsufficientAttributePointsError,
    InvalidAllocationError,
    StaleAttributeStateError,
    allocate_attribute_points,
    get_attribute_point_state,
)
class TestDatabase:
    def __init__(self, path):
        self.conn = sqlite3.connect(path)
        self.conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        self.cursor = self.conn.cursor()

def require_raises(error_type, operation):
    try:
        operation()
    except error_type:
        return
    raise AssertionError(f"Expected {error_type.__name__}")

def main():
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="rom_attribute_api_") as temp:
        database = TestDatabase(str(Path(temp) / "test.db"))
        database.cursor.execute("""CREATE TABLE users (
            user_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
            free_attribute_points INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            total_attribute_points_earned INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            allocated_strength INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            allocated_dexterity INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            allocated_intelligence INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            allocated_wisdom INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            allocated_stamina INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
        )""")
        database.cursor.execute("INSERT INTO users VALUES (1, 10, 10, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)")
        database.cursor.execute("INSERT INTO users VALUES (2, 2, 10, 2, 2, 2, 1, 1)")
        database.cursor.execute("INSERT INTO users VALUES (3, 5, 99, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)")
        database.conn.commit()

        initial = get_attribute_point_state(1, db_module=database)
        assert initial["free_attribute_points"] == 10 and initial["invariant_valid"]
        result = allocate_attribute_points(
            1, {"str": 2, "dexterity": 1, "wis": 2},
            expected_free_attribute_points=10, db_module=database,
        )
        assert result["spent"] == 5
        assert result["after"]["free_attribute_points"] == 5
        assert result["after"]["allocated_strength"] == 2
        assert result["after"]["allocated_dexterity"] == 1
        assert result["after"]["allocated_wisdom"] == 2
        assert result["after"]["total_attribute_points_earned"] == 10
        assert result["after"]["invariant_valid"]

        snapshot = get_attribute_point_state(1, db_module=database)
        require_raises(
            StaleAttributeStateError,
            lambda: allocate_attribute_points(
                1, {"sta": 1}, expected_free_attribute_points=10,
                db_module=database,
            ),
        )
        assert get_attribute_point_state(1, db_module=database) == snapshot

        require_raises(
            InsufficientAttributePointsError,
            lambda: allocate_attribute_points(2, {"strength": 3}, db_module=database),
        )
        require_raises(
            InvalidAllocationError,
            lambda: allocate_attribute_points(1, {"luck": 1}, db_module=database),
        )
        require_raises(
            InvalidAllocationError,
            lambda: allocate_attribute_points(1, {"str": -1}, db_module=database),
        )
        require_raises(
            AttributeInvariantError,
            lambda: get_attribute_point_state(3, db_module=database),
        )
        assert not database.conn.in_transaction
        database.conn.close()
    print("[PASS] Stage 18.16.3 atomic allocation API contract")
    return 0
if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import ast
import sys
from pathlib import Path
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
from systems import auction_house_system as auction

def require(value, message):
    if not value:
        raise AssertionError(message)

def main():
    snapshot = {
        "slot_key": "chest", "armor_type": "cloth",
        "inserted_runes": [{"slot_index": 0, "rune_item_id": 501,
            "rune_stat": "INT", "rune_level": 2,
            "rune_name": "💠 Руна Інтелекту II"}],
    }
    require(auction._auction_equipment_type_line(snapshot) == "🏷 Тип предмета: [Тканина]", "type formatter")
    lines = auction._auction_rune_socket_lines(snapshot)
    require(lines[0] == "💠 Рунічні слоти: 1/3", "socket count")
    require("Слот 1: 💠 Руна Інтелекту II" in lines[1], "inserted rune")
    require(lines[3] == "• Слот 3: порожній", "empty socket")
    source = (ROOT / "systems" / "auction_house_system.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    for name in ("get_inventory_item_snapshot_for_auction", "_auction_insert_inventory_from_snapshot",
                 "build_auction_sell_item_review_text", "build_user_auction_lot_details",
                 "build_auction_buy_lot_details_v2"):
        count = sum(isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == name for n in tree.body)
        require(count >= 1, f"missing {name}")
    print("[PASS] Stage 17.1.0 canonical auction rune preservation")
if __name__ == "__main__":

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Isolated in-memory contracts for Auction lifecycle duplicates."""
from __future__ import annotations
import ast
import json
import sqlite3
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path: sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT))
import db
from systems import auction_house_system as auction

TARGETS=("init_auction_house","update_expired_auction_lots")
NOW="2030-01-15T12:00:00"
PAST="2030-01-01T12:00:00"
FUTURE="2030-02-01T12:00:00"
OLD_DELETE="2030-01-10T12:00:00"
FUTURE_DELETE="2030-02-10T12:00:00"


def fail(message):
 print(f"[FAIL] {message}"); raise SystemExit(1)

def parse_defs(path):
 text=path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"); tree=ast.parse(text,filename=str(path)); result={}
 for node in tree.body:
  if isinstance(node,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef)): result.setdefault(node.name,[]).append(node)
 return text,result

def insert_lot(cursor, seller, status, expires_at, delete_after=None, sold_at=None, suffix="x"):
 now="2030-01-01T00:00:00"
 cursor.execute(
  """INSERT INTO auction_lots (
  seller_user_id,buyer_user_id,item_type,item_source,item_ref_id,item_snapshot_json,
  item_name,item_name_norm,category,rarity,level,enhancement_level,durability_current,
  durability_max,quantity,price,status,created_at,expires_at,sold_at,claimed_at,
  delete_after,updated_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)""",
  (seller,None,"equipment","fixture",None,json.dumps({"fixture":suffix}),
   f"fixture-{suffix}",f"fixture-{suffix}","equipment","common",1,0,100,100,1,
   "10.00",status,now,expires_at,sold_at,None,delete_after,now),
 )
 return int(cursor.lastrowid)
def status(cursor,lot_id):
 row=cursor.execute("SELECT status,delete_after,updated_at FROM auction_lots WHERE id=?",(lot_id,)).fetchone()
 return tuple(row) if row else None

def main():
 db_text,db_defs=parse_defs(ROOT/"db.py")
 system_text,system_defs=parse_defs(ROOT/"systems"/"auction_house_system.py")
 for name in TARGETS:
  if len(db_defs.get(name,[]))!=1: fail(f"db.py {name}: definitions={len(db_defs.get(name,[]))}, expected 1 after i8b")
  if len(system_defs.get(name,[]))<1: fail(f"auction_house_system.py missing {name}")
  final=ast.get_source_segment(db_text,db_defs[name][-1]) or ""
  if "auction_house_system" not in final: fail(f"final db.{name} is not Auction System wrapper")

 memory=sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
 memory.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
 cursor=memory.cursor()
 auction.conn=memory; auction.cursor=cursor
 checks=0
 try:
  # Public init delegates to the isolated system connection and is idempotent.
  if db.init_auction_house() is not True: fail("public init return contract failed")
  if db.init_auction_house() is not True: fail("second public init return contract failed")
  tables={r[0] for r in cursor.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'").fetchall()}
  if not {"auction_lots","auction_history"}.issubset(tables): fail("auction schema initialization failed")
  checks+=3

  active_expired=insert_lot(cursor,-90120801,"ACTIVE",PAST,suffix="active-expired")
  active_future=insert_lot(cursor,-90120802,"ACTIVE",FUTURE,suffix="active-future")
  expired_old=insert_lot(cursor,-90120803,"EXPIRED_UNCLAIMED",PAST,OLD_DELETE,suffix="expired-old")
  expired_future=insert_lot(cursor,-90120804,"EXPIRED_UNCLAIMED",PAST,FUTURE_DELETE,suffix="expired-future")
  sold_old=insert_lot(cursor,-90120805,"SOLD_UNCLAIMED",PAST,OLD_DELETE,PAST,"sold-old")
  sold_claimed=insert_lot(cursor,-90120806,"SOLD_CLAIMED",PAST,OLD_DELETE,PAST,"sold-claimed")
  expired_missing=insert_lot(cursor,-90120807,"EXPIRED_UNCLAIMED",PAST,None,suffix="expired-missing-delete")
  memory.commit()

  result=db.update_expired_auction_lots(now_iso=NOW)
  required={"success","now","expired_active","deleted_expired_unclaimed","deleted_sold_unclaimed","fixed_missing_delete_after"}
  if not isinstance(result,dict) or not required.issubset(result): fail(f"cleanup result contract failed: {result!r}")
  if result["success"] is not True or result["now"]!=NOW: fail("cleanup success/now contract failed")
  if int(result["expired_active"])!=1: fail(f"expired_active={result['expired_active']}, expected 1")
  if int(result["deleted_expired_unclaimed"])!=1: fail("expired-unclaimed deletion count failed")
  if int(result["deleted_sold_unclaimed"])!=1: fail("sold-unclaimed deletion count failed")
  if int(result["fixed_missing_delete_after"])!=1: fail("missing delete_after fix count failed")
  checks+=6

  if status(cursor,active_expired)[0]!="EXPIRED_UNCLAIMED": fail("expired ACTIVE transition failed")
  if not status(cursor,active_expired)[1]: fail("expired ACTIVE delete_after missing")
  if status(cursor,active_future)[0]!="ACTIVE": fail("future ACTIVE lot changed")
  if status(cursor,expired_old)[0]!="DELETED": fail("old EXPIRED_UNCLAIMED not deleted")
  if status(cursor,expired_future)[0]!="EXPIRED_UNCLAIMED": fail("future retained lot changed")
  if status(cursor,sold_old)[0]!="DELETED": fail("old SOLD_UNCLAIMED not deleted")
  if status(cursor,sold_claimed)[0]!="SOLD_CLAIMED": fail("claimed sale changed")
  if not status(cursor,expired_missing)[1]: fail("missing delete_after was not repaired")
  checks+=8

  # Same timestamp must be idempotent.
  second=db.update_expired_auction_lots(now_iso=NOW)
  for key in ("expired_active","deleted_expired_unclaimed","deleted_sold_unclaimed","fixed_missing_delete_after"):
   if int(second.get(key,-1))!=0: fail(f"idempotency failed for {key}: {second.get(key)}")
  checks+=4

  direct=auction.update_expired_auction_lots(now_iso=NOW)
  public=db.update_expired_auction_lots(now_iso=NOW)
  if direct!=public: fail(f"public/system cleanup mismatch: {public!r} != {direct!r}")
  checks+=1
 finally:
  auction.conn=real_conn; auction.cursor=real_cursor
  memory.close()

 # Real project connection was never replaced or mutated.
 if auction.conn is not real_conn or auction.cursor is not real_cursor: fail("Auction globals were not restored")
 print("[OK] auction lifecycle isolated contracts")

 print("- schema init idempotency: OK")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import ast
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
SOURCE = ROOT / "handlers" / "auction_house.py"


def require(value, message):
    if not value:
        raise AssertionError(message)


def main():
    source = SOURCE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    imports_json = any(
        isinstance(node, ast.Import) and any(alias.name == "json" for alias in node.names)
        for node in tree.body
    )
    require(imports_json, "top-level import json is missing")

    helpers = [
        node for node in tree.body
        if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == "_auction_lot_typed_name_17_1_0"
    ]
    require(len(helpers) == 1, "auction lot typed-name helper count must be exactly one")

    namespace = {"json": json}
    helper_source = ast.get_source_segment(source, helpers[0])
    exec(helper_source, namespace)
    helper = namespace["_auction_lot_typed_name_17_1_0"]

    lot = {
        "item_name": "🔵 Обладунок 8 рівня",
        "category": "equipment",
        "item_snapshot_json": json.dumps({"armor_type": "cloth"}, ensure_ascii=False),
    }
    typed = helper(lot)
    require(typed == "🔵 Обладунок [Тканина] 8 рівня", f"unexpected typed label: {typed!r}")
    require("💠" not in typed, "rune count must not appear in list labels")

    label_paths = source.count("_auction_lot_typed_name_17_1_0(lot)")
    require(label_paths >= 5, f"expected at least five list-label paths, found {label_paths}")
    print("[PASS] Stage 17.1.0.1 auction list type JSON parsing")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from __future__ import annotations
import random,sys
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT))
from data.bosses import BOSS_ENCOUNTERS_ENABLED,BOSS_ENCOUNTER_CHANCE_PERCENT
from systems.boss_system import generate_hunt_encounter,roll_boss_encounter

assert BOSS_ENCOUNTERS_ENABLED is False
assert BOSS_ENCOUNTER_CHANCE_PERCENT==1.0
assert not roll_boss_encounter(random.Random(1))

normal_calls={"build":0,"elite":0}
def factory():
 normal_calls["build"]+=1
 return {"name":"normal","level":3,"is_elite":False}
def elite(mob):
 mob=dict(mob); mob["is_elite"]=True; mob["name"]="elite"; return mob
def never_elite(): normal_calls["elite"]+=1; return False

# Live safety gate: boss is disabled and existing normal flow remains active.
r=generate_hunt_encounter(3,"start_path",factory,elite,never_elite,rng=random.Random(1))
assert r["enemy_type"]=="normal" and normal_calls=={"build":1,"elite":1}

# Forced boss: boss is exclusive and normal/elite callbacks are never called.
normal_calls={"build":0,"elite":0}
r=generate_hunt_encounter(3,"start_path",factory,elite,never_elite,rng=random.Random(1),boss_enabled=True,boss_chance_percent=100)
assert r["enemy_type"]=="boss"
assert r["mob"]["is_boss"] is True and r["mob"]["is_elite"] is False
assert r["mob"]["level"]==3 and r["mob"]["location_id"]=="start_path"
assert normal_calls=={"build":0,"elite":0}

# Forced elite when boss misses.
normal_calls={"build":0,"elite":0}
def yes_elite(): normal_calls["elite"]+=1; return True
r=generate_hunt_encounter(3,"start_path",factory,elite,yes_elite,rng=random.Random(1),boss_enabled=True,boss_chance_percent=0)
assert r["enemy_type"]=="elite"
assert r["mob"]["is_elite"] is True and r["mob"]["is_boss"] is False
assert normal_calls=={"build":1,"elite":1}

# Forced normal when both boss and elite miss.
normal_calls={"build":0,"elite":0}
r=generate_hunt_encounter(3,"start_path",factory,elite,never_elite,rng=random.Random(1),boss_enabled=True,boss_chance_percent=0)
assert r["enemy_type"]=="normal"
assert r["mob"]["is_elite"] is False and r["mob"]["is_boss"] is False
print("[PASS] boss > elite > normal encounter exclusivity and safety gate")

 assert scale_boss_stat_ranges(definition,level_max)==definition["reference_stats"]

resolve_boss_combat_action(boss,forced_skill_key="battle_cry")
assert boss["boss_state"]["attack_buff_turns"]==3
assert get_effective_boss_attack(boss)==round(base_attack*1.15)
for _ in range(3): tick_boss_temporary_buffs(boss)
assert get_effective_boss_attack(boss)==base_attack
# Defense Command: +30% PDEF/MDEF, two actions, replace policy.
resolve_boss_combat_action(boss,forced_skill_key="defense_command")
pdef,mdef=get_effective_boss_defenses(boss)
assert pdef==round(base_pdef*1.30) and mdef==round(base_mdef*1.30)
tick_boss_temporary_buffs(boss); assert boss["boss_state"]["defense_buff_turns"]==1
tick_boss_temporary_buffs(boss); assert get_effective_boss_defenses(boss)==(base_pdef,base_mdef)
# Permanent and temporary ATK are additive.
boss["boss_state"]["permanent_attack_buff_percent"]=30
resolve_boss_combat_action(boss,forced_skill_key="battle_cry")
assert get_effective_boss_attack(boss)==round(base_attack*1.45)
print("[PASS] temporary boss buffs, refresh semantics, expiry and additive ATK")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import ast
import random
import sys
from pathlib import Path

R = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
if str(R) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(R))

path = R / "systems/combat_system.py"
source = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
ast.parse(source)
assert source.count("ROM 17.18.2.4 BOW CROSSBOW RISK STABILITY BALANCE") == 1
assert 'subtype_multiplier = {"bow_2h": 0.95, "crossbow_2h": 1.10}' not in source

from systems.combat_system import calculate_player_attack

calls = []
old_randint = random.randint
old_uniform = random.uniform
try:
    def fake_randint(minimum, maximum):
        calls.append((minimum, maximum))
        return (minimum + maximum) // 2

    random.randint = fake_randint
    random.uniform = lambda a, b: 100.0
    common = dict(
        player_stat_attack=0,
        mob_def=0,
        dex=10,
        wis=10,
        level=1,
        weapon_min_damage=100,
        weapon_max_damage=200,
    )
    bow = calculate_player_attack(**common, weapon_subtype="bow_2h")
    crossbow = calculate_player_attack(**common, weapon_subtype="crossbow_2h")
    sword = calculate_player_attack(**common, weapon_subtype="sword_1h")
    unarmed = calculate_player_attack(
        player_stat_attack=10, mob_def=0, dex=10, wis=10, level=1,
        weapon_min_damage=0, weapon_max_damage=0, weapon_subtype=""
    )

    assert calls == [(105, 190), (85, 230), (100, 200)], calls
    assert bow["weapon_damage"] == 147, bow
    assert crossbow["weapon_damage"] == 157, crossbow
    assert sword["weapon_damage"] == 150, sword
    assert unarmed["weapon_damage"] == 0, unarmed
    assert bow["damage"] == 147 and crossbow["damage"] == 157
finally:
    random.randint = old_randint
    random.uniform = old_uniform

print("[PASS] Stage 17.18.2.4 bow/crossbow risk-stability contract")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Read-only contracts for removal of obsolete base captures."""
from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import hashlib
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

DB_PATH = ROOT / "game.db"
DB_PY = ROOT / "db.py"
CAPTURES = (
    "_base_get_inventory_detailed_before_refine_display_v1",
    "_base_get_inventory_entry_before_refine_display_v1",
    "_base_get_item_by_inventory_id_before_refine_display_v1",
    "_base_get_item_by_inventory_id_full_before_refine_display_v1",
    "_base_get_max_hp_before_refine_v1",
    "_base_get_sellable_equipment_items_before_refine_display_v1",
    "_base_get_weapon_damage_by_inventory_id_before_refine_v1",
    "_base_get_weapon_damage_for_refine_hotfix_v1",
)
REQUIRED_PUBLIC_APIS = (
    "get_inventory_detailed",
    "get_inventory_entry",
    "get_item_by_inventory_id",
    "get_item_by_inventory_id_full",
    "get_max_hp",
    "get_sellable_equipment_items",
    "get_weapon_damage_by_inventory_id",
)


def fail(message):
    print(f"[FAIL] {message}")
    raise SystemExit(1)


def fingerprint():
    return (
        hashlib.sha256(DB_PATH.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        DB_PATH.stat().st_size,
        DB_PATH.stat().st_mtime_ns,
    )


def main():
    before = fingerprint()
    source = DB_PY.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    tree = ast.parse(source, filename=str(DB_PY))

    residual = []
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node, ast.Name) and node.id in CAPTURES:
            residual.append((node.id, node.lineno, "name"))
        elif isinstance(node, ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.value, str) and node.value in CAPTURES:
            residual.append((node.value, node.lineno, "string"))
    if residual:
        fail(f"removed captures still occur in source: {residual}")

    import db

    runtime_residual = [name for name in CAPTURES if hasattr(db, name)]
    if runtime_residual:
        fail(f"removed captures still exist at runtime: {runtime_residual}")

    missing_public = [name for name in REQUIRED_PUBLIC_APIS if not callable(getattr(db, name, None))]
    if missing_public:
        fail(f"public APIs missing after cleanup: {missing_public}")

    # Read-only runtime probes against a real existing user when available.
    row = db.conn.execute("SELECT user_id FROM users ORDER BY user_id LIMIT 1").fetchone()
    user_id = int(row[0]) if row else None
    probes = {}
    if user_id is not None:
        probes["inventory_detailed_type"] = type(db.get_inventory_detailed(user_id)).__name__
        probes["sellable_equipment_type"] = type(db.get_sellable_equipment_items(user_id)).__name__
        probes["max_hp_type"] = type(db.get_max_hp(user_id)).__name__

        inventory_row = db.conn.execute(
            "SELECT id FROM inventory WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY id LIMIT 1",
            (user_id,),
        ).fetchone()
        if inventory_row:
            inventory_id = int(inventory_row[0])
            probes["inventory_entry_type"] = type(
                db.get_inventory_entry(user_id, inventory_id)
            ).__name__
            probes["item_by_inventory_type"] = type(
                db.get_item_by_inventory_id(inventory_id)
            ).__name__
            probes["item_by_inventory_full_type"] = type(
                db.get_item_by_inventory_id_full(inventory_id)
            ).__name__

    if before != fingerprint():
        fail("game.db changed during read-only contracts")

    print("[OK] capture-only cleanup contracts")
    print(f"- removed source captures: {len(CAPTURES)}")
    print("- removed runtime globals: 8")
    print(f"- required public APIs callable: {len(REQUIRED_PUBLIC_APIS)}")
    print(f"- read-only runtime probes: {probes}")
    print("- gameplay functions removed: 0")
    print("- database mutations: 0")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
from __future__ import annotations

import copy
import hashlib
import json
import sqlite3
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))


def fail(message):
    print(f"[FAIL] {message}")
    raise SystemExit(1)


def sequence(values):
    iterator = iter(values)
    return lambda: next(iterator)


def logical_db_fingerprint():
    uri = f"file:{(ROOT / 'game.db').as_posix()}?mode=ro"
    conn = sqlite3.connect(uri, uri=True)
    try:
        conn.execute("PRAGMA query_only=ON")
        digest = hashlib.sha256()
        tables = [row[0] for row in conn.execute(
            "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' "
            "AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' ORDER BY name"
        )]
        for table in tables:
            quoted = '"' + str(table).replace('"', '""') + '"'
            rows = [list(row) for row in conn.execute(f"SELECT * FROM {quoted}")]
            rows.sort(key=lambda row: json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False, default=str))
            digest.update(json.dumps([table, rows], ensure_ascii=False, default=str).encode("utf-8"))
        return digest.hexdigest()
    finally:
        conn.close()


def main():
    from data.drop_tables import (
        CENTRAL_DROP_PRODUCTION_ENABLED, CENTRAL_DROP_MIGRATED_RULES,
        DROP_RULES, DROP_RULES_BY_ID,
    )
    from systems.drop_system import (
        classify_enemy, get_central_drop_status, get_drop_rule,
        resolve_enemy_config, roll_drop_rule, roll_enemy_drops,
        validate_drop_tables, weighted_choice,
    )

    db_before = logical_db_fingerprint()
    validation = validate_drop_tables()
    if not CENTRAL_DROP_PRODUCTION_ENABLED:
        fail("central production must be enabled after 11.2.0")
    if tuple(CENTRAL_DROP_MIGRATED_RULES) != ("rune", "refine_stone", "equipment", "trophy", "potion"):
        fail(f"migrated rules mismatch: {CENTRAL_DROP_MIGRATED_RULES}")
    if not validation["success"]:
        fail(validation["errors"])
    if validation["rule_count"] != 8:
        fail(f"rule count mismatch: {validation}")
    production_rules = [
        rule["rule_id"] for rule in DROP_RULES
        if rule.get("production_enabled")
    ]
    if production_rules != ["equipment", "trophy", "refine_stone", "rune", "potion"]:
        fail(f"production rules mismatch: {production_rules}")

    if classify_enemy({"is_boss": True, "is_elite": True}) != "boss":
        fail("boss priority failed")
    if classify_enemy({"enemy_type": "elite", "is_boss": False}) != "elite":
        fail("elite classification failed")
    if classify_enemy({}) != "normal":
        fail("normal classification failed")

    rune = get_drop_rule("rune")
    if rune != DROP_RULES_BY_ID["rune"] or rune is DROP_RULES_BY_ID["rune"]:
        fail("get_drop_rule must return an equal defensive copy")
    hit = roll_drop_rule(rune, {"is_boss": True}, sequence([0.10, 0.99, 0.99]))
    if not hit["rolled"] or hit["payload"]["level"] != 3 or hit["payload"]["stat"] != "WIS":
        fail(f"boss rune shadow roll mismatch: {hit}")
    miss = roll_drop_rule(rune, {}, sequence([0.05]))
    if miss["rolled"] or miss["reason"] != "chance_miss":
        fail(f"normal rune boundary mismatch: {miss}")

    stone = get_drop_rule("refine_stone")
    if stone["enemy"]["boss"] != {"chance": 0.50}:
        fail(f"explicit boss stone balance mismatch: {stone}")
    from systems.drop_system import roll_central_refine_stone_drop
    boss_hit = roll_central_refine_stone_drop(
        {"is_boss": True, "is_elite": True}, sequence([0.50])
    )
    boss_miss = roll_central_refine_stone_drop(
        {"mob_type": "boss"}, sequence([0.500001])
    )
    if not boss_hit["rolled"] or boss_miss["rolled"]:
        fail(f"boss stone 50% boundary failed: hit={boss_hit}, miss={boss_miss}")
    normal_stone = roll_central_refine_stone_drop({}, sequence([0.08]))
    if not normal_stone["rolled"] or normal_stone["payload"]["item_id"] != 401:
        fail(f"normal stone inclusive boundary failed: {normal_stone}")

    trophy = get_drop_rule("trophy")
    normal_cfg = resolve_enemy_config(trophy, "normal", {"mob": {"loot_chance": 0.58}})
    elite_cfg = resolve_enemy_config(trophy, "elite", {"mob": {"loot_chance": 0.58}})
    if normal_cfg["chance"] != 0.58 or elite_cfg["chance"] != 0.78:
        fail(f"dynamic trophy chance mismatch: {normal_cfg}, {elite_cfg}")

    if weighted_choice((("a", 0.5), ("b", 0.5)), 0.5) != "b":
        fail("weighted boundary mismatch")
    broken = copy.deepcopy(list(DROP_RULES))
    broken[0]["enemy"]["normal"]["chance"] = 1.50
    invalid = validate_drop_tables(broken)
    if invalid["success"] or not invalid["errors"]:
        fail("validator accepted invalid probability")

    all_results = roll_enemy_drops({}, sequence([0.99, 0.99, 0.99, 0.99, 0.99]))
    if len(all_results) != len(DROP_RULES):
        fail("full table result count mismatch")
    if any(result["awarded"] for result in all_results):
        fail("pure engine awarded a real item")

    status = get_central_drop_status()
    if status["shadow_only"] or status["production_rules"] != ["equipment", "trophy", "refine_stone", "rune", "potion"]:
        fail(f"central status mismatch: {status}")

    reward_source = (ROOT / "systems" / "reward_system.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    if "process_enemy_drops" not in reward_source:
        fail("final central victory flow is missing")
    if "roll_central_refine_stone_drop" not in reward_source:
        fail("targeted refine-stone central delegation missing")

    if logical_db_fingerprint() != db_before:
        fail("pure engine changed game.db")

    print("[OK] Central drop config model contracts")
    print("- schema validation: OK")
    print("- enemy priority boss > elite > normal: OK")
    print("- current rune balance represented exactly: OK")
    print("- refine-stone boss chance: 50% inclusive")
    print("- trophy dynamic chance resolver: OK")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import random
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))


def fail(message):
    print(f"[FAIL] {message}")
    raise SystemExit(1)


class CountingRandom:
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = iter(values)
        self.calls = 0
    def __call__(self):
        self.calls += 1
        return next(self.values)


def legacy_selection(mob, rng):
    is_elite = bool(mob.get("is_elite", False))
    chance = 0.45 if is_elite else 0.20
    if rng() > chance:
        return None
    rarity_roll = rng()
    if is_elite:
        rarity = "uncommon" if rarity_roll <= 0.75 else "rare"
        class_aware = 0.70
    else:
        rarity = "common" if rarity_roll <= 0.80 else "uncommon"
        class_aware = 0.50
    return rarity, class_aware


def compare(name, mob, values):
    from systems.drop_system import roll_central_equipment_drop
    old_rng = CountingRandom(values)
    new_rng = CountingRandom(values)
    old = legacy_selection(mob, old_rng)
    central = roll_central_equipment_drop(mob, new_rng)
    new = None
    if central.get("rolled"):
        new = (
            central["payload"]["rarity"],
            central["payload"]["class_aware_chance"],
        )
    if old != new:
        fail(f"{name}: old={old}, new={new}, central={central}")
    if old_rng.calls != new_rng.calls:
        fail(f"{name}: RNG calls {old_rng.calls} != {new_rng.calls}")


def main():
    from data.drop_tables import CENTRAL_DROP_MIGRATED_RULES, DROP_RULES_BY_ID

        get_central_drop_status, roll_central_equipment_drop,

        fail(f"migrated rules mismatch: {CENTRAL_DROP_MIGRATED_RULES}")
    if rule["enemy"] != {
        "normal": {"chance": 0.20},

        "boss": {"chance": 0.70},
    }:

    if rule["rarity_weights"] != {
        "normal": (("common", 0.80), ("uncommon", 0.20)),

    }:
        fail(f"rarity weights mismatch: {rule['rarity_weights']}")
    if rule["class_aware_chance"] != {
        "normal": 0.50, "elite": 0.70, "boss": 0.90,
    }:
        fail(f"class-aware chances mismatch: {rule['class_aware_chance']}")
    if not rule.get("production_enabled") or not validate_drop_tables()["success"]:
        fail("equipment production/schema contract failed")

    cases = (
        ("normal chance boundary hit", {}, (0.20, 0.0)),

def fail(message): print(f"[FAIL] {message}"); raise SystemExit(1)
class Sequence:
    def __init__(self, values): self.values=iter(values); self.calls=0
    def __call__(self): self.calls+=1; return next(self.values)

def main():
    from data.drop_tables import CENTRAL_DROP_MIGRATED_RULES,DROP_RULES_BY_ID
    from systems.drop_system import get_central_drop_status,roll_central_potion_drop,validate_drop_tables

    expected_chances={"normal":0.06,"elite":0.19,"boss":0.45}
    if {k:v['chance'] for k,v in rule['enemy'].items()}!=expected_chances: fail(rule['enemy'])
    expected_weights={
      "normal":((201,4/6),(202,2/6)),
      "elite":((201,10/19),(202,6/19),(203,2/19),(204,1/19)),
      "boss":((201,20/45),(202,12/45),(203,8/45),(204,5/45)),
    }
    for enemy,weights in expected_weights.items():
        actual=rule['item_weights'][enemy]
        if len(actual)!=len(weights) or any(a[0]!=b[0] or abs(a[1]-b[1])>1e-12 for a,b in zip(actual,weights)):
            fail(f"{enemy} weights={actual}")
    if not rule.get('enabled') or not rule.get('production_enabled'): fail('potion rule disabled')
    validation=validate_drop_tables()
    if not validation['success']: fail(validation['errors'])

    # Inclusive group boundaries and at-most-one contract.
    for mob,chance in (({},0.06),({'is_elite':True},0.19),({'is_boss':True},0.45)):
        hit=roll_central_potion_drop(mob,Sequence((chance,0.0)))
        miss=roll_central_potion_drop(mob,Sequence((chance+0.000001,)))
        if not hit['rolled'] or miss['rolled']: fail((hit,miss))
        if hit['payload']['quantity']!=1: fail(hit)

    # 100k simulations per enemy type; check total and individual marginal rates.
    targets={
      'normal':({201:0.04,202:0.02},{}),
      'elite':({201:0.10,202:0.06,203:0.02,204:0.01},{'is_elite':True}),
      'boss':({201:0.20,202:0.12,203:0.08,204:0.05},{'is_boss':True}),
    }
    for enemy,(expected,mob) in targets.items():
        rng=random.Random(116000+len(enemy)); counts=Counter(); none=0
        for _ in range(100000):
            result=roll_central_potion_drop(mob,rng.random)
            if result['rolled']: counts[result['payload']['item_id']]+=1
            else: none+=1
        if sum(counts.values())>100000: fail('more than one potion per kill')
        for item_id,target in expected.items():
            actual=counts[item_id]/100000
            if abs(actual-target)>0.008: fail(f"{enemy} item {item_id}: {actual} vs {target}")

    status=get_central_drop_status()
    if status['production_rules']!=['equipment','trophy','refine_stone','rune','potion']:
        fail(status)
    if DROP_RULES_BY_ID['success_rune'].get('production_enabled'): fail('success rune enabled')
    if DROP_RULES_BY_ID['perfect_extractor'].get('production_enabled'): fail('perfect extractor enabled')

    reward=(ROOT/'systems/reward_system.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    tree=ast.parse(reward)
    names=[n.name for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef)]
    if names.count('roll_potion_drop') != 1 or names.count('process_enemy_drops') != 1: fail('final potion integration missing or duplicated')
    if 'process_enemy_drops' not in reward: fail('final central integration missing')

if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

USER_ID = -101300003


def fail(message):
    print(f"[FAIL] {message}")
    raise SystemExit(1)


class CountingRandom:
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = iter(values)
        self.calls = 0

    def __call__(self):
        self.calls += 1
        return next(self.values)


def logical_db_fingerprint():
    uri = f"file:{(ROOT / 'game.db').as_posix()}?mode=ro"
    conn = sqlite3.connect(uri, uri=True)
    try:
        conn.execute("PRAGMA query_only=ON")
        digest = hashlib.sha256()
        tables = [row[0] for row in conn.execute(
            "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' "
            "AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' ORDER BY name"
        )]
        for table in tables:
            quoted = '"' + str(table).replace('"', '""') + '"'
            rows = [list(row) for row in conn.execute(f"SELECT * FROM {quoted}")]
            rows.sort(key=lambda row: json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False, default=str))
            digest.update(json.dumps([table, rows], ensure_ascii=False, default=str).encode("utf-8"))
        return digest.hexdigest()
    finally:
        conn.close()


def cleanup(db):
    # Remove the isolated fixture from every current/future user-owned table.
    # Stage 11 adds systems over time, so a hard-coded three-table cleanup is
    # no longer sufficient for a whole-database logical fingerprint.
    tables = [
        row[0] for row in db.conn.execute(
            "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' "
            "AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' ORDER BY name"
        ).fetchall()
    ]
    owned = []
    for table in tables:
        try:
            columns = {
                str(row[1]) for row in db.conn.execute(
                    f'PRAGMA table_info("{table}")'
                ).fetchall()
            }
            if "user_id" in columns and table != "users":
                owned.append(table)
        except Exception:
            pass
    # Repeat to tolerate foreign-key dependency order between owned tables.
    for _ in range(3):
        for table in owned:
            quoted = '"' + str(table).replace('"', '""') + '"'
            try:
                db.conn.execute(
                    f"DELETE FROM {quoted} WHERE user_id=?", (USER_ID,)
                )
            except Exception:
                pass
    db.conn.execute("DELETE FROM users WHERE user_id=?", (USER_ID,))
    db.conn.commit()


def compare_legacy_case(name, mob, value):
    from systems.drop_system import roll_central_refine_stone_drop
    from systems.reward_system import (
        ELITE_REFINE_STONE_DROP_CHANCE,
        NORMAL_REFINE_STONE_DROP_CHANCE,
    )

    legacy_rng = CountingRandom((value,))
    central_rng = CountingRandom((value,))
    legacy_chance = (
        ELITE_REFINE_STONE_DROP_CHANCE
        if bool(mob.get("is_elite", False))
        else NORMAL_REFINE_STONE_DROP_CHANCE
    )
    legacy_hit = float(legacy_rng()) <= float(legacy_chance)
    central = roll_central_refine_stone_drop(mob, central_rng)
    if bool(central.get("rolled")) != legacy_hit:
        fail(f"{name}: legacy={legacy_hit}, central={central}")
    if legacy_rng.calls != central_rng.calls or central_rng.calls != 1:
        fail(f"{name}: RNG calls differ")

if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:

def fail(message):
    print(f"[FAIL] {message}")
    raise SystemExit(1)


class CountingRandom:
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = iter(values)
        self.calls = 0

    def __call__(self):
        self.calls += 1
        return next(self.values)


def logical_db_fingerprint():
    uri = f"file:{(ROOT / 'game.db').as_posix()}?mode=ro"
    conn = sqlite3.connect(uri, uri=True)
    try:
        conn.execute("PRAGMA query_only=ON")
        digest = hashlib.sha256()
        tables = [row[0] for row in conn.execute(
            "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' "
            "AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' ORDER BY name"
        )]
        for table in tables:
            quoted = '"' + str(table).replace('"', '""') + '"'
            rows = [list(row) for row in conn.execute(f"SELECT * FROM {quoted}")]
            rows.sort(key=lambda row: json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False, default=str))
            digest.update(json.dumps([table, rows], ensure_ascii=False, default=str).encode("utf-8"))
        return digest.hexdigest()
    finally:
        conn.close()


def comparable(result):
    keys = (
        "dropped", "enemy_type", "chance", "roll", "item_id", "name",
        "stat", "level", "quantity",
    )
    return {key: result.get(key) for key in keys if key in result}


def compare_case(name, mob, values):
    from systems.rune_system import (
        _legacy_roll_rune_drop_11_10_0,
        roll_rune_drop,
    )

    legacy_rng = CountingRandom(values)
    central_rng = CountingRandom(values)
    legacy = _legacy_roll_rune_drop_11_10_0(mob, random_func=legacy_rng)
    central = roll_rune_drop(mob, random_func=central_rng)
    if comparable(legacy) != comparable(central):
        fail(f"{name}: result mismatch\nlegacy={legacy}\ncentral={central}")
    if legacy_rng.calls != central_rng.calls:
        fail(f"{name}: random draw mismatch {legacy_rng.calls} != {central_rng.calls}")
    return central, central_rng.calls

    if not rune_rule.get("production_enabled"):
        fail("rune rule is not production-enabled")
    production_rules = sorted(
        rule_id for rule_id, rule in DROP_RULES_BY_ID.items()
        if rule.get("production_enabled")
    )
    if production_rules != ["equipment", "potion", "refine_stone", "rune", "trophy"]:
        fail(f"unexpected production rules: {production_rules}")
    if rune_rule["enemy"] != {
        key: {"chance": value} for key, value in RUNE_DROP_CHANCES.items()
    }:
        fail("central rune chances diverge from legacy balance")
    if rune_rule["level_weights"] != RUNE_LEVEL_WEIGHTS:
        fail("central rune level weights diverge")
    if rune_rule["stat_weights"] != RUNE_STAT_WEIGHTS:
        fail("central rune stat weights diverge")
    validation = validate_drop_tables()
    if not validation["success"]:
        fail(validation["errors"])

    cases = (
        ("normal miss at boundary", {}, (0.05,)),
        ("normal hit STR I", {}, (0.049999, 0.0, 0.0)),
        ("normal hit WIS I", {}, (0.0, 0.999999, 0.999999)),
        ("elite miss at boundary", {"is_elite": True}, (0.12,)),
        ("elite I", {"is_elite": True}, (0.0, 0.799999, 0.20)),
        ("elite II", {"is_elite": True}, (0.0, 0.80, 0.20)),
        ("boss I", {"is_boss": True}, (0.0, 0.599999, 0.40)),
        ("boss II", {"boss": True}, (0.0, 0.60, 0.40)),
        ("boss III", {"mob_type": "boss"}, (0.0, 0.95, 0.999999)),
        ("boss priority", {"is_boss": True, "is_elite": True}, (0.0, 0.95, 0.999999)),
        ("enemy_type boss", {"enemy_type": "boss"}, (0.349999, 0.10, 0.10)),
    )
    for name, mob, values in cases:
        compare_case(name, mob, values)

    # Statistical exact equivalence with identical generated random streams.
    for enemy_type, mob in (
        ("normal", {}),
        ("elite", {"is_elite": True}),
        ("boss", {"is_boss": True}),
    ):
        seed_source = random.Random(112000 + len(enemy_type))
        for index in range(10000):
            values = tuple(seed_source.random() for _ in range(3))
            compare_case(f"{enemy_type} statistical case {index}", mob, values)

    # Public award/simulation APIs remain dynamic users of roll_rune_drop.
    rune_source = (ROOT / "systems" / "rune_system.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    reward_source = (ROOT / "systems" / "reward_system.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    from systems.rune_system import _legacy_roll_rune_drop_11_10_0
    if not callable(_legacy_roll_rune_drop_11_10_0):
        fail("legacy equivalence helper missing")
    if "roll_central_rune_drop" not in rune_source:
        fail("central delegation missing")
    if "award_rune_drop(user_id, mob)" not in reward_source:
        fail("victory reward public rune hook changed unexpectedly")

    status = get_central_drop_status()
    if status["production_rules"] != ["equipment", "trophy", "refine_stone", "rune", "potion"]:
        fail(f"production rule status mismatch: {status}")

    # One direct public-API sanity case after all equivalence checks.
    result = roll_rune_drop({"is_boss": True}, random_func=CountingRandom((0.0, 0.95, 0.99)))
    if not result.get("dropped") or result.get("level") != 3 or result.get("stat") != "WIS":
        fail(f"public central rune result mismatch: {result}")

    if logical_db_fingerprint() != db_before:
        fail("rune migration test changed game.db")

    print("[OK] Central drop rune migration contracts")
    print("- legacy/central deterministic cases: 11/11 exact")
    print("- statistical equivalence cases: 30000 exact")
    print("- random draw count equivalence: OK")
    print("- normal/elite/boss classification equivalence: OK")
    print("- chance boundary equivalence: OK")
    print("- level/stat/item/name/quantity equivalence: OK")
    print("- award_rune_drop public API preserved: OK")
    print("- simulate_rune_drops public API preserved: OK")
    print("- production central rules include rune + refine_stone + equipment + trophy + potion")
    print("- database mutations: 0")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import random
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))


def fail(message):
    print(f"[FAIL] {message}")
    raise SystemExit(1)


class CountingRandom:
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = iter(values)
        self.calls = 0
    def __call__(self):
        self.calls += 1
        return next(self.values)


class CountingChoice:
    def __init__(self, index=0):
        self.index = index
        self.calls = 0
    def __call__(self, values):
        self.calls += 1
        return values[self.index % len(values)]


def legacy_simple(mob, rng, chooser):
    possible = []
    if "trash_item_id" in mob:
        possible.append(mob["trash_item_id"])
    if "loot_item_id" in mob:
        possible.append(mob["loot_item_id"])
    if "trash_items" in mob and isinstance(mob["trash_items"], list):
        possible.extend(mob["trash_items"])
    if "trash_drops" in mob and isinstance(mob["trash_drops"], list):
        possible.extend(mob["trash_drops"])
    if not possible:
        return None
    chance = float(mob.get("loot_chance", 0.45))
    if mob.get("is_elite"):
        chance = min(1.0, chance + 0.20)
    if rng() > chance:
        return None
    return chooser(possible)


def compare_simple(name, mob, value, choice_index=0):
    from systems.drop_system import roll_central_trophy_simple
    old_rng, new_rng = CountingRandom((value,)), CountingRandom((value,))
    old_choice, new_choice = CountingChoice(choice_index), CountingChoice(choice_index)
    old = legacy_simple(mob, old_rng, old_choice)
    central = roll_central_trophy_simple(mob, new_rng, new_choice)
    new = central["payload"]["item_id"] if central.get("rolled") else None
    if old != new:
        fail(f"{name}: old={old}, new={new}, central={central}")
    if (old_rng.calls, old_choice.calls) != (new_rng.calls, new_choice.calls):
        fail(f"{name}: RNG/choice call mismatch")


def main():
    from data.drop_tables import CENTRAL_DROP_MIGRATED_RULES, DROP_RULES_BY_ID
    from systems.drop_system import (
        get_central_drop_status,
        resolve_central_trophy_chance,
        roll_central_trophy_simple,
        roll_central_trophy_table_entry,
        validate_drop_tables,
    )

    if tuple(CENTRAL_DROP_MIGRATED_RULES) != (
        "rune", "refine_stone", "equipment", "trophy", "potion"
    ):
        fail(f"migrated rules mismatch: {CENTRAL_DROP_MIGRATED_RULES}")
    rule = DROP_RULES_BY_ID["trophy"]
    if not rule.get("production_enabled"):
        fail("trophy production rule disabled")
    if not validate_drop_tables()["success"]:
        fail(validate_drop_tables()["errors"])

    cases = (
        ("default boundary hit", {"trash_items": [107]}, 0.45, 0),
        ("default miss", {"trash_items": [107]}, 0.450001, 0),
        ("custom normal hit", {"trash_items": [107, 108], "loot_chance": 0.58}, 0.58, 1),
        ("elite hit", {"trash_items": [107], "loot_chance": 0.45, "is_elite": True}, 0.65, 0),
        ("elite miss", {"trash_items": [107], "loot_chance": 0.45, "is_elite": True}, 0.650001, 0),
        ("empty pool", {}, 0.0, 0),
    )
    for case in cases:
        compare_simple(*case)

    # Exact compatibility over a large deterministic stream.
    for elite in (False, True):
        mob = {"trash_items": [107, 108, 109], "loot_chance": 0.52}
        if elite:
            mob["is_elite"] = True
        source = random.Random(115000 + int(elite))
        for index in range(10000):
            compare_simple(
                f"exact elite={elite} #{index}", mob, source.random(), index
            )

    # Bosses preserve the historical +20 only when the old is_elite flag is set.
    boss_plain = resolve_central_trophy_chance({"is_boss": True, "loot_chance": 0.55})
    boss_elite = resolve_central_trophy_chance({
        "is_boss": True, "is_elite": True, "loot_chance": 0.55,
    })
    if boss_plain["chance"] != 0.55 or boss_elite["chance"] != 0.75:
        fail(f"boss compatibility policy mismatch: {boss_plain}, {boss_elite}")
    if boss_elite["enemy_type"] != "boss":
        fail("boss priority over elite failed")

    # Legacy table-entry boundary uses inclusive <= chance.
    table_hit = roll_central_trophy_table_entry(
        {"item_id": 201, "chance": 0.25}, CountingRandom((0.25,))
    )
    table_miss = roll_central_trophy_table_entry(
        {"item_id": 201, "chance": 0.25}, CountingRandom((0.250001,))
    )
    if not table_hit["rolled"] or table_miss["rolled"]:
        fail(f"table boundary mismatch: {table_hit}, {table_miss}")

    status = get_central_drop_status()
    if status["production_rules"] != [
        "equipment", "trophy", "refine_stone", "rune", "potion"
    ]:
        fail(f"production status mismatch: {status}")

    reward = (ROOT / "systems" / "reward_system.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    tree = ast.parse(reward)
    names = [
        node.name for node in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef)
    ]
    if names.count("roll_loot_from_simple_keys") != 1:
        fail("final simple trophy API missing or duplicated")
    if names.count("roll_loot_from_loot_table") != 1:
        fail("final table trophy API missing or duplicated")
    if "process_enemy_drops" not in reward:
        fail("final central victory integration is missing")

    print("[OK] Central drop trophy migration contracts")
    print("- simple trophy pools exact legacy equivalence: 20000 cases")
    print("- mob loot_chance default/custom values preserved: OK")
    print("- elite +20 percentage-point modifier preserved: OK")
    print("- boss historical is_elite compatibility explicit: OK")
    print("- loot_table/loot entry inclusive boundaries: OK")
    print("- legacy quantity RNG order preserved: OK")
    print("- stack-or-lose award path preserved: OK")
    print("- production central rules: equipment + refine_stone + rune + trophy + potion")
    print("- database mutations: 0")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
