from contextlib import closing
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path: sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT))
def fail(msg): print(f"[FAIL] {msg}"); raise SystemExit(1)
def prepare(path):
    c=sqlite3.connect(path)
    c.executescript("""
      PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON;
      CREATE TABLE users(user_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,character_name TEXT,current_location TEXT,last_activity_at TEXT);
      CREATE TABLE player_activity_sessions(
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,user_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        activity_type TEXT NOT NULL,reference_id INTEGER,status TEXT,
        created_at TEXT,updated_at TEXT,expires_at TEXT);
      CREATE TABLE player_interaction_requests(
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,request_type TEXT,initiator_user_id INTEGER,
        recipient_user_id INTEGER,location_snapshot TEXT,status TEXT,revision INTEGER,
        created_at TEXT,updated_at TEXT,expires_at TEXT,responded_at TEXT);
    """)
    c.commit(); c.close()
def main():
    path=ROOT/"systems/player_interaction_system.py"
    source=path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"); ast.parse(source,filename=str(path))
    if "recover_orphan_player_activity_sessions" not in source: fail("recovery API missing")
    module=importlib.import_module("systems.player_interaction_system")
    now=datetime(2026,8,2,12,0,tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="rom_recovery_12_3_2_") as td:
        db=Path(td)/"test.db"; prepare(db)
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(db)) as c:
            c.executemany("INSERT INTO users VALUES(?,?,?,?)",((1,"A","start_path",now.isoformat()),(2,"B","start_path",now.isoformat()),(3,"C","start_path",now.isoformat())))
            c.execute(
                "INSERT INTO player_interaction_requests "
                "(id,request_type,initiator_user_id,recipient_user_id,location_snapshot,status,revision,created_at,updated_at,expires_at,responded_at) "
                "VALUES(10,'trade',1,2,'start_path','accepted',1,?,?,?,?)",
                (now.isoformat(),now.isoformat(),(now+timedelta(minutes=2)).isoformat(),now.isoformat()),
            )
            c.execute("INSERT INTO player_activity_sessions(user_id,activity_type,reference_id,status,created_at,updated_at,expires_at) VALUES(1,'trade',10,'active',?,?,NULL)",(now.isoformat(),now.isoformat()))
            c.execute("INSERT INTO player_activity_sessions(user_id,activity_type,reference_id,status,created_at,updated_at,expires_at) VALUES(2,'trade',10,'active',?,?,NULL)",(now.isoformat(),now.isoformat()))
            c.execute("INSERT INTO player_activity_sessions(user_id,activity_type,reference_id,status,created_at,updated_at,expires_at) VALUES(3,'trade_request',999,'pending',?,?,?)",(now.isoformat(),now.isoformat(),(now+timedelta(minutes=2)).isoformat()))
            c.commit()
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(db)) as c:
            fixture_count=c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM player_activity_sessions").fetchone()[0]
        if fixture_count != 3: fail(f"fixture persistence: {fixture_count}")
        recovered=module.recover_orphan_player_activity_sessions(now=now,db_path=db)
        if recovered["accepted_placeholder_trade_sessions"] != 2: fail(recovered)
        if recovered["orphan_request_sessions"] != 1: fail(recovered)
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(db)) as c:
            count=c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM player_activity_sessions").fetchone()[0]
        if count != 0: fail(f"session residue: {count}")

        # Accepted request must release both players while no editor/player_trades exists.
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(db)) as c:
            c.execute("UPDATE player_interaction_requests SET status='pending',responded_at=NULL WHERE id=10")
            c.executemany("INSERT INTO player_activity_sessions(user_id,activity_type,reference_id,status,created_at,updated_at,expires_at) VALUES(?,'trade_request',10,'pending',?,?,?)",((1,now.isoformat(),now.isoformat(),(now+timedelta(minutes=2)).isoformat()),(2,now.isoformat(),now.isoformat(),(now+timedelta(minutes=2)).isoformat())))
            c.commit()
        result=module.respond_to_player_interaction_request(10,2,"accept",expected_revision=1,now=now,db_path=db)
        if not result["success"] or result["status"]!="accepted": fail(result)
        trade = result.get("trade") or {}
        trade_id = trade.get("trade_id") or (trade.get("trade") or {}).get("id")
        if not trade_id: fail(f"accepted trade missing: {result}")
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(db)) as c:
            sessions=c.execute(
                "SELECT user_id,activity_type,reference_id,status,expires_at "
                "FROM player_activity_sessions ORDER BY user_id"
            ).fetchall()
            status=c.execute("SELECT status FROM player_interaction_requests WHERE id=10").fetchone()[0]
        if len(sessions) != 2 or status != "accepted": fail(f"accepted trade sessions: {sessions}, status={status}")
        if any(row[1] != "trade" or row[2] != trade_id or row[3] != "editing" or row[4] is None for row in sessions):
            fail(f"accepted trade session contract: {sessions}")
        cancelled=module.cancel_player_trade(trade_id,1,now=now,db_path=db)
        if not cancelled.get("success"): fail(f"trade cleanup cancel: {cancelled}")
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(db)) as c:
            if c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM player_activity_sessions").fetchone()[0] != 0:
                fail("trade cleanup session residue")

        # Cleanup before create must remove stale placeholders and allow a fresh request.
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(db)) as c:
            c.execute("INSERT INTO player_activity_sessions(user_id,activity_type,reference_id,status,created_at,updated_at,expires_at) VALUES(1,'trade',10,'active',?,?,NULL)",(now.isoformat(),now.isoformat()))
            c.execute("UPDATE player_interaction_requests SET status='accepted' WHERE id=10")
            c.commit()
        fresh=module.create_player_interaction_request(1,2,"trade",now=now,db_path=db)
        if not fresh["success"]: fail(fresh)
        # Confirm that Windows can obtain an exclusive DB lock before temp cleanup.
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(db, timeout=1.0)) as c:
            c.execute("BEGIN EXCLUSIVE")
            c.rollback()
    main_source=(ROOT/"main.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    if "cleanup_player_interaction_state()" not in main_source: fail("startup cleanup missing")
    print("[OK] Interaction session timeout and recovery contracts")
    print("- accepted pre-editor trade sessions released: OK")
    print("- expired/orphan request sessions cleaned: OK")
    print("- cleanup runs before busy checks: OK")
    print("- accepted request stays auditable without blocking users: OK")
    print("- startup recovery registered: OK")
    print("- isolated DB; real user mutations: 0")
if __name__=="__main__": main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import ast
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SOURCE = ROOT / "handlers/inventory.py"
source = SOURCE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
tree = ast.parse(source)
functions = {
    node.name: node
    for node in tree.body
    if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef)
}

for name in (
    "_inventory_ui_normalized_name_17_7_1",
    "_inventory_ui_category_key_17_7_1",
    "_inventory_ui_sort_key_17_7_1",
):
    assert name in functions, name

category_definitions = [
    node for node in tree.body
    if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == "get_category_items"
]
assert len(category_definitions) >= 4, len(category_definitions)
assert source.count("ROM 17.7.1 INVENTORY CANONICAL UI SORTING") == 1
assert "_STAGE_17_7_1_BASE_GET_CATEGORY_ITEMS = get_category_items" in source

namespace = {}
for name in (
    "_inventory_ui_normalized_name_17_7_1",
    "_inventory_ui_category_key_17_7_1",
    "_inventory_ui_sort_key_17_7_1",
):
    code = ast.get_source_segment(source, functions[name])
    exec(code, namespace)

# Constants required by the extracted functions.
namespace["_STAGE_17_7_1_RARITY_PREFIXES"] = ("⚪️", "⚪", "🟢", "🔵", "🟣")
namespace["_STAGE_17_7_1_CATEGORY_ORDER"] = (
    "main_hand", "off_hand", "helmet", "shoulders", "chest", "gloves",
    "legs", "boots", "necklace", "ring", "trash", "rune", "material", "potion",
)
namespace["_STAGE_17_7_1_CATEGORY_RANK"] = {
    key: index for index, key in enumerate(namespace["_STAGE_17_7_1_CATEGORY_ORDER"])
}

normalize = namespace["_inventory_ui_normalized_name_17_7_1"]
category_key = namespace["_inventory_ui_category_key_17_7_1"]
sort_key = namespace["_inventory_ui_sort_key_17_7_1"]

def item(inv_id, name, category="potion", slot_key="", quantity=1, rarity="common"):
    return (
        inv_id, 1, name, "type", rarity, category, slot_key, 1,
        quantity, 10, 100, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0.0,
    )

assert normalize(item(1, "🟢 Наплічники")) == "наплічники"
assert normalize(item(1, "⚪️ Амулет")) == "амулет"
assert category_key(item(1, "Меч", "equipment", "main_hand")) == "main_hand"

# Alphabetical, case-insensitive, rarity-independent.
values = [
    item(10, "🔵 Сила"),
    item(11, "🟢 витривалість"),
    item(12, "⚪ Амулет"),
]
assert [row[0] for row in sorted(values, key=lambda row: sort_key(row, False))] == [12, 11, 10]

# Equal normalized names: newest inventory ID first; quantity and rarity do not matter.
duplicates = [
    item(87, "⚪ Наплічники", quantity=10, rarity="common"),
    item(690, "🟣 Наплічники", quantity=1, rarity="epic"),
]
assert [row[0] for row in sorted(duplicates, key=lambda row: sort_key(row, False))] == [690, 87]

# The all view preserves logical category rank and sorts only inside each group.
all_values = [
    item(30, "Зілля", "potion"),
    item(20, "Сірий лут", "trash"),
    item(12, "Булава", "equipment", "main_hand"),
    item(13, "Арбалет", "equipment", "main_hand"),
    item(25, "Руна", "rune"),
]
assert [row[0] for row in sorted(all_values, key=lambda row: sort_key(row, True))] == [13, 12, 20, 25, 30]

final_source = ast.get_source_segment(source, category_definitions[-1]) or ""
assert "_STAGE_17_7_1_BASE_GET_CATEGORY_ITEMS" in final_source
assert "include_category=(category_key == \"all\")" in final_source
print("[PASS] Stage 17.7.1 inventory canonical UI sorting")

import db_modules.equipment as equipment
class FakeConn:
    def __init__(self,row): self.row=row; self.args=None
    def execute(self,sql,args): self.args=(sql,args); return self
    def fetchone(self): return self.row
original_conn=equipment.conn
original_format=equipment.format_refined_item_name
try:
    fake=FakeConn((77,201,"Мале зілля здоров'я","potion_hp","potion",3,0))
    equipment.conn=fake
    equipment.format_refined_item_name=lambda name,level:name if not level else f"{name} [+{level}]"
    value=equipment.get_inventory_entry(123,77)
    assert value==(77,201,"Мале зілля здоров'я","potion_hp","potion",3),value
    assert fake.args[1]==(123,77)
finally:
    equipment.conn=original_conn
    equipment.format_refined_item_name=original_format
print("[PASS] inventory entry dual signature contract")

from pathlib import Path
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

import db

USER_ID = 243129101


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise AssertionError(message)


def main():
    inventory = db.get_inventory_detailed(USER_ID)
    require(isinstance(inventory, list), "get_inventory_detailed must return list")

    print("[OK] inventory/refine read-only runtime contracts")
    print("- inventory rows:", len(inventory))

    if not inventory:
        print("- no inventory rows available for deeper contract checks")
        return 0

    row = inventory[0]
    require(isinstance(row, tuple), "inventory row must be tuple")
    require(len(row) == 17, f"inventory row must have 17 fields, got {len(row)}")

    inventory_id = row[0]
    item = db.get_item_by_inventory_id(inventory_id)
    full = db.get_item_by_inventory_id_full(inventory_id)
    entry = db.get_inventory_entry(USER_ID, inventory_id)

    require(isinstance(item, tuple) and len(item) == 17, "get_item_by_inventory_id contract mismatch")
    require(isinstance(full, tuple) and len(full) == 19, "get_item_by_inventory_id_full contract mismatch")
    require(isinstance(entry, tuple) and len(entry) == 6, "get_inventory_entry contract mismatch")

    refine_level = db.get_inventory_refine_level(inventory_id)
    display_name = db.get_inventory_refined_display_name(inventory_id)
    require(isinstance(refine_level, int), "refine level must be int")
    require(isinstance(display_name, str), "refined display name must be str")

    if refine_level > 0:
        require(f"[+{refine_level}]" in display_name, "refine suffix missing from display name")
        require(f"[+{refine_level}]" in str(item[2]), "refine suffix missing from item tuple")
        require(f"[+{refine_level}]" in str(full[2]), "refine suffix missing from full tuple")
        require(f"[+{refine_level}]" in str(entry[2]), "refine suffix missing from entry tuple")

    print("- sample inventory_id:", inventory_id)
    print("- sample name:", display_name)
    print("- refine level:", refine_level)
    print("- tuple lengths: detailed=17 item=17 full=19 entry=6")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import ast
import re
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
TARGETS = {
    "db_modules/inventory.py": {"sell_all_trash"},
    "handlers/auction_house.py": {
        "auction_stack_items_kb_v2", "build_auction_stack_price_prompt_v2",
        "build_auction_stack_confirm_text_v2", "auction_buy_lots_kb",
        "auction_sell_items_inline_kb_v1", "auction_buy_lots_inline_kb_v1",
        "auction_my_lots_inline_kb_v1", "auction_unclaimed_items_inline_kb_v1",
    },
    "handlers/city.py": {"build_sell_equipment_confirm_text"},
    "handlers/combat.py": {"build_combat_potion_kb"},
    "handlers/dev.py": {"give_class_reset_sphere"},
    "handlers/inventory.py": {"build_item_button_label"},
    "handlers/player_interaction.py": {
        "_trade_item_kb", "_trade_ux_stack_kb", "_trade_preview_stack_kb_12_6_2",
    },
    "systems/auction_house_system.py": {"create_stack_auction_lot"},
}
LEGACY = re.compile(r"[xX](?=\{[^{}]*(?:quantity|qty|count|amount|added)[^{}]*\})", re.I)
CANONICAL = re.compile(r"×(?=\{[^{}]*(?:quantity|qty|count|amount|added)[^{}]*\})", re.I)

legacy = []
canonical = 0
for rel, names in TARGETS.items():
    source = (ROOT / rel).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    for node in tree.body:
        if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) and node.name in names:
            text = ast.get_source_segment(source, node) or ""
            if LEGACY.search(text):
                legacy.append((rel, node.name))
            canonical += len(CANONICAL.findall(text))
assert not legacy, legacy
assert canonical >= 20, canonical

# Explicitly preserve out-of-scope formats and existing canonical rune behavior.
daily_compat = (ROOT / "db_modules/daily_compat.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
assert "Мале зілля здоров’я x3" in daily_compat
inventory = (ROOT / "handlers/inventory.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
assert "hide redundant ×1" in inventory
runes = (ROOT / "handlers/runes.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
assert "×3" in runes and "×1" in runes
print(f"[PASS] Stage 17.10.1 item quantity display format; canonical={canonical}")

tree = ast.parse(source, filename=str(P))

def defs(name):
    return [n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) and n.name == name]

def call_name(node):
    if isinstance(node, ast.Name): return node.id
    if isinstance(node, ast.Attribute):
        p=call_name(node.value); return f"{p}.{node.attr}" if p else node.attr
    return ""

def calls(node, suffix):
    return [n for n in ast.walk(node) if isinstance(n, ast.Call) and call_name(n.func).endswith(suffix)]

def names(node):
    targets=node.targets if isinstance(node,ast.Assign) else [node.target]
    return [t.id for t in targets if isinstance(t,ast.Name)]

assert source.count("ROM 17.21.3.2.1 KICK CONFIRMATION HANDLER HASH NEWLINE RECOVERY") == 1

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))


def fail(message):
    print(f"[FAIL] {message}")
    raise SystemExit(1)


def top_level_counts(path):
    source = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    tree = ast.parse(source, filename=str(path))
    counts = {}
    for node in tree.body:
        if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
            counts[node.name] = counts.get(node.name, 0) + 1
    return source, tree, counts


def main():
    reward_path = ROOT / "systems" / "reward_system.py"
    drop_path = ROOT / "systems" / "drop_system.py"
    rune_path = ROOT / "systems" / "rune_system.py"

    reward_source, reward_tree, reward_counts = top_level_counts(reward_path)
    drop_source, drop_tree, drop_counts = top_level_counts(drop_path)
    rune_source, rune_tree, rune_counts = top_level_counts(rune_path)

    expected_reward = (
        "roll_equipment_drop",
        "roll_loot_from_loot_table",
        "roll_loot_from_simple_keys",
        "roll_refine_stone_drop",
        "roll_potion_drop",
        "roll_loot",
        "process_victory_reward",
        "process_enemy_drops",
    )
    for name in expected_reward:
        if reward_counts.get(name) != 1:
            fail(f"reward singleton {name}: {reward_counts.get(name, 0)}")
    for name in ("validate_drop_tables",):
        if drop_counts.get(name) != 1:
            fail(f"drop singleton {name}: {drop_counts.get(name, 0)}")
    if drop_counts.get("_validate_drop_tables_schema_11_10_0") != 1:
        fail("private schema validator helper missing or duplicated")
    if "_VALIDATE_DROP_TABLES_BEFORE_SPECIAL_POLICY_11_7_0" in drop_source:
        fail("obsolete special-policy validator alias remains")
    for name in ("roll_rune_drop", "award_rune_drop", "simulate_rune_drops"):
        if rune_counts.get(name) != 1:
            fail(f"rune singleton {name}: {rune_counts.get(name, 0)}")
    if rune_counts.get("_legacy_roll_rune_drop_11_10_0") != 1:
        fail("private roll_rune_drop compatibility helper missing or duplicated")
    for unexpected in (
        "_legacy_award_rune_drop_11_10_0",
        "_legacy_simulate_rune_drops_11_10_0",
    ):
        if rune_counts.get(unexpected, 0):
            fail(f"unexpected synthetic rune helper: {unexpected}")
    if "_RUNE_DROP_LEGACY_" in rune_source:
        fail("obsolete rune legacy alias remains")

    forbidden_aliases = (
        "_base_roll_loot_",
        "_ROLL_LOOT_",
        "_RUNE_DROP_BASE_PROCESS_VICTORY_REWARD_",
        "_PROCESS_VICTORY_REWARD_BEFORE_CENTRAL_",
        "_ROLL_EQUIPMENT_LEGACY_",
        "_ROLL_REFINE_STONE_LEGACY_",
        "_ROLL_LOOT_TABLE_LEGACY_",
        "_ROLL_LOOT_SIMPLE_LEGACY_",
        "_RUNE_DROP_LEGACY_",
    )
    assigned_names = []
    for node in ast.walk(reward_tree):
        if isinstance(node, (ast.Assign, ast.AnnAssign)):
            targets = node.targets if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) else [node.target]
            for target in targets:
                if isinstance(target, ast.Name):
                    assigned_names.append(target.id)
    for alias in forbidden_aliases:
        matches = [name for name in assigned_names if name.startswith(alias)]
        if matches:
            fail(f"legacy alias assignments remain: {matches}")

    # Final runtime composition must still execute each rule exactly once.
    import systems.reward_system as rewards
    from systems.drop_system import get_victory_drop_plan
    expected = ("trophy", "equipment", "refine_stone", "rune", "potion")
    if get_victory_drop_plan() != expected:
        fail(f"victory plan changed: {get_victory_drop_plan()}")

    calls = []
    fake_rune = type("RuneModule", (), {
        "award_rune_drop": staticmethod(
            lambda *a, **k: calls.append("rune") or {"dropped": True, "message": "R"}
        )
    })
    with patch.object(rewards, "roll_loot_from_simple_keys", lambda *a, **k: calls.append("trophy") or ["T"]), \
         patch.object(rewards, "roll_equipment_drop", lambda *a, **k: calls.append("equipment") or "E"), \
         patch.object(rewards, "roll_refine_stone_drop", lambda *a, **k: calls.append("refine_stone") or "S"), \
         patch.object(rewards, "roll_potion_drop", lambda *a, **k: calls.append("potion") or "P"), \
         patch.dict(sys.modules, {"systems.rune_system": fake_rune}), \
         patch.object(rewards, "_central_guild_elite_reward_11_9_0", lambda *a, **k: None):
        result = rewards.process_enemy_drops(1, {})
    if tuple(calls) != expected:
        fail(f"central runtime order/duplication changed: {calls}")
    if result["messages"] != ["T", "E", "S", "R", "P"]:
        fail(f"central messages changed: {result}")

    # Compatibility API still delegates once to the authoritative composition.
    with patch.object(rewards, "process_enemy_drops", return_value={"messages": ["X"]}) as central:
        if rewards.roll_loot(1, {}) != ["X"] or central.call_count != 1:
            fail("roll_loot compatibility API is not single-delegation")

    print("[OK] Legacy central-drop cleanup contracts")
    print("- reward singleton definitions: 8/8")
    print("- drop validator singleton definition: OK")
    print("- rune public API singleton definitions: 3/3")
    print("- historical roll_loot/process_victory aliases removed: OK")
    print("- authoritative rule order unchanged: OK")
    print("- every production drop executes exactly once: OK")
    print("- compatibility roll_loot single delegation: OK")
    print("- database mutations: 0")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def sha256(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as f:

    return h.hexdigest()

from __future__ import annotations
import ast
import sys
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path: sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT))
def fail(msg): print(f"[FAIL] {msg}"); raise SystemExit(1)
def main():
    handler=ROOT/"handlers/player_interaction.py"
    keyboard=ROOT/"keyboards.py"
    for path in (handler,keyboard): ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"),filename=str(path))
    hs=handler.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    if "def _safe_edit_message_text(" not in hs: fail("safe edit helper missing")
    if "message is not modified" not in hs: fail("unchanged-message guard missing")
    if "bot.edit_message_text(" in hs.replace("return bot.edit_message_text(", ""):
        fail("unguarded edit_message_text call remains")
    namespace={}
    tree=ast.parse(hs)
    helper=next((n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=="_safe_edit_message_text"),None)
    if helper is None: fail("helper AST missing")
    module=ast.Module(body=[helper],type_ignores=[]); ast.fix_missing_locations(module)
    exec(compile(module,str(handler),"exec"),namespace)
    class Bot:
        def edit_message_text(self,*args,**kwargs): raise RuntimeError("Bad Request: message is not modified")
    if namespace["_safe_edit_message_text"](Bot(),"x") is not None: fail("unchanged edit not suppressed")
    class BadBot:
        def edit_message_text(self,*args,**kwargs): raise RuntimeError("Bad Request: chat not found")
    try: namespace["_safe_edit_message_text"](BadBot(),"x")
    except RuntimeError: pass
    else: fail("non-matching error was hidden")
    ks=keyboard.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    required=(
      'row(types.KeyboardButton("🌿 Початок Шляху"), types.KeyboardButton("🌲 Темний Бір"))',

      'row(types.KeyboardButton("🔙 Назад"))',
    )
    positions=[]
    for token in required:
        if token not in ks: fail(f"keyboard row missing: {token}")
        positions.append(ks.index(token))
    if positions != sorted(positions): fail("keyboard row order incorrect")
    print("[OK] Map refresh and keyboard hotfix contracts")
    print("- unchanged edit_message_text 400 suppressed: OK")
    print("- other Telegram/API errors remain visible: OK")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import ast
import hashlib
import sqlite3
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
DB = ROOT / "game.db"
SOURCE = ROOT / "systems/notifications.py"


def sha256(path):
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as handle:
        for block in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(block)
    return digest.hexdigest()


before = sha256(DB)
source = SOURCE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
tree = ast.parse(source)
assert source.count("ROM 17.15.1.1 NOTIFICATION WORKER DYNAMIC RUNE MAX MP RECOVERY") == 1
assert "def get_worker_equipped_rune_int_wis_bonus_17_15_1_1" in source
assert source.count("def get_worker_max_mp_17_15_1(conn, user_id):") >= 2
assert "COALESCE(inv.durability, 100) > 0" in source
assert "rune_stat" in source and "rune_level" in source

from systems import notifications as n

conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
conn.execute("CREATE TABLE users (user_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, level INTEGER, intelligence INTEGER, wis INTEGER, character_class TEXT, max_mp INTEGER)")
conn.execute("CREATE TABLE inventory (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER, durability INTEGER)")
conn.execute("CREATE TABLE equipment_slots (user_id INTEGER, inventory_id INTEGER)")
conn.execute("CREATE TABLE inventory_runes (inventory_id INTEGER, rune_stat TEXT, rune_level INTEGER)")
conn.execute("INSERT INTO users VALUES (1,8,67,68,'priest',0)")
conn.execute("INSERT INTO inventory VALUES (10,1,100)")
conn.execute("INSERT INTO equipment_slots VALUES (1,10)")
conn.execute("INSERT INTO inventory_runes VALUES (10,'int',2)")
conn.execute("INSERT INTO inventory_runes VALUES (10,'wis',3)")

# Base: 100 + 8*20 + 67*3 + 68*2 = 597; runes add 2*3 + 3*2 = 12.
assert n.get_worker_max_mp_17_15_1(conn, 1) == 609
assert conn.execute("SELECT max_mp FROM users WHERE user_id=1").fetchone()[0] == 609

# Broken equipment contributes no rune bonus.
conn.execute("UPDATE inventory SET durability=0 WHERE id=10")
assert n.get_worker_max_mp_17_15_1(conn, 1) == 597

# Non-mana classes are excluded.
conn.execute("UPDATE users SET character_class='warrior' WHERE user_id=1")
assert n.get_worker_max_mp_17_15_1(conn, 1) == 0
conn.close()

# The MP regen and notification functions resolve the final global max-MP helper.
regen_node = next(node for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == "apply_mp_regen_worker_17_15_1")
regen_source = ast.get_source_segment(source, regen_node) or ""
assert "get_worker_max_mp_17_15_1(conn, user_id)" in regen_source
assert source.index("bot_instance.send_message", source.index("def notify_mp_restored_17_15_1")) < source.index("mp_full_notified=1", source.index("def notify_mp_restored_17_15_1"))
assert sha256(DB) == before
print("[PASS] Stage 17.15.1.1 rune-aware worker max-MP recovery contract")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
from __future__ import annotations

import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

USER_ID = -101000001
OTHER_ID = -101000002
ITEM_ID = 91000001


def fail(message):
    print(f"[FAIL] {message}")
    raise SystemExit(1)


def cleanup(db):
    for user_id in (USER_ID, OTHER_ID):
        try:
            db.conn.execute(
                "DELETE FROM inventory_runes WHERE inventory_id IN "
                "(SELECT id FROM inventory WHERE user_id=?)",
                (user_id,),
            )
        except Exception:
            pass
        for table in ("equipment_slots", "inventory", "user_daily_quests"):
            try:
                db.conn.execute(f"DELETE FROM {table} WHERE user_id=?", (user_id,))
            except Exception:
                pass
        db.conn.execute("DELETE FROM users WHERE user_id=?", (user_id,))
    db.conn.execute("DELETE FROM items WHERE id=?", (ITEM_ID,))
    db.conn.commit()


def quantity(db, user_id, item_id):
    return int(db.conn.execute(
        "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity),0) FROM inventory "
        "WHERE user_id=? AND item_id=?",
        (user_id, item_id),
    ).fetchone()[0] or 0)


def create_equipment(db, user_id):
    columns = {row[1] for row in db.conn.execute("PRAGMA table_info(items)")}
    if not db.conn.execute("SELECT 1 FROM items WHERE id=?", (ITEM_ID,)).fetchone():
        values = {
            "id": ITEM_ID, "name": "Тестовий нагрудник 10 рівня",
            "type": "armor", "rarity": "common", "category": "equipment",
            "slot_key": "chest", "armor_type": "cloth", "weapon_hands": 1,
            "max_stack": 1, "sell_price": 0, "bonus_str": 0,
            "bonus_dex": 0, "bonus_int": 0, "bonus_wis": 0,
            "bonus_sta": 0, "pdef": 0, "mdef": 0, "item_level": 10,
            "is_generated": 0, "item_subtype": "",
        }
        selected = [key for key in values if key in columns]
        db.conn.execute(
            f"INSERT INTO items ({', '.join(selected)}) VALUES "
            f"({', '.join('?' for _ in selected)})",
            tuple(values[key] for key in selected),
        )
    equipment_id = int(db.conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO inventory (user_id,item_id,quantity,durability) VALUES (?,?,1,100)",
        (user_id, ITEM_ID),
    ).lastrowid)
    for index, (item_id, stat, level) in enumerate((
        (501, "STR", 1),
        (513, "STA", 3),
        (525, "WIS", 5),
    )):
        db.conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO inventory_runes "
            "(inventory_id,slot_index,rune_item_id,rune_stat,rune_level) "
            "VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)",
            (equipment_id, index, item_id, stat, level),
        )
    db.conn.commit()
    return equipment_id


def main():
    import db

    cleanup(db)
    try:
        db.create_user(USER_ID)
        db.create_user(OTHER_ID)
        db.init_rune_system()
        equipment_id = create_equipment(db, USER_ID)
        result = db.add_item(USER_ID, 528, 2)
        if not result.get("success"):
            fail(f"Perfect Extractor fixture add failed: {result}")

        before = quantity(db, USER_ID, 528)
        extraction = db.use_perfect_rune_extractor(USER_ID, equipment_id)
        if not extraction.get("success"):
            fail(f"Perfect extraction failed: {extraction}")
        if extraction.get("returned_count") != 3:
            fail(f"Not all runes returned: {extraction}")
        if (quantity(db, USER_ID, 501), quantity(db, USER_ID, 513), quantity(db, USER_ID, 525)) != (1, 1, 1):
            fail("Returned rune quantities mismatch")
        if quantity(db, USER_ID, 528) != before - 1:
            fail("Perfect Extractor consumption mismatch")
        if db.conn.execute("SELECT 1 FROM inventory WHERE id=?", (equipment_id,)).fetchone():
            fail("Equipment was not destroyed")
        if db.conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory_runes WHERE inventory_id=?", (equipment_id,)).fetchone()[0]:
            fail("Socket rows were not destroyed")

        repeat = db.use_perfect_rune_extractor(USER_ID, equipment_id)
        if repeat.get("code") != "not_found":
            fail(f"Repeat callback guard failed: {repeat}")
        if (quantity(db, USER_ID, 501), quantity(db, USER_ID, 513), quantity(db, USER_ID, 525)) != (1, 1, 1):
            fail("Repeat callback duplicated runes")

        no_material_item = create_equipment(db, USER_ID)
        db.conn.execute("DELETE FROM inventory WHERE user_id=? AND item_id=528", (USER_ID,))
        db.conn.commit()
        no_material = db.use_perfect_rune_extractor(USER_ID, no_material_item)
        if no_material.get("code") != "no_perfect_extractor":
            fail(f"Missing material guard failed: {no_material}")
        if not db.conn.execute("SELECT 1 FROM inventory WHERE id=?", (no_material_item,)).fetchone():
            fail("Missing-material failure destroyed equipment")

        forged = db.use_perfect_rune_extractor(OTHER_ID, no_material_item)
        if forged.get("code") != "not_owner":
            fail(f"Ownership guard failed: {forged}")

        db.add_item(USER_ID, 528, 1)
        db.conn.execute(
            "UPDATE equipment_slots SET inventory_id=? "
            "WHERE user_id=? AND slot_key='chest'",
            (no_material_item, USER_ID),
        )
        db.conn.commit()
        equipped = db.use_perfect_rune_extractor(USER_ID, no_material_item)
        if equipped.get("code") != "equipped":
            fail(f"Equipped-item guard failed: {equipped}")

        handler = (ROOT / "handlers" / "runes.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
        for marker in (
            "build_perfect_extractor_confirmation",
            "✅ Використати Досконалий Екстрактор",
            "re:perfect_confirm:",
            "use_perfect_rune_extractor",
        ):
            if marker not in handler:
                fail(f"Perfect Extractor UI marker missing: {marker}")

        print("[OK] Perfect Rune Extractor contracts")
        print("- equipment selected before extractor type: OK")
        print("- all inserted runes returned: 3/3")
        print("- equipment destroyed: 1")
        print("- Perfect Extractor consumed: 1")
        print("- inserted runes lost: 0")
        print("- duplicate callback mutation: 0")
        print("- missing material protection: OK")
        print("- ownership protection: OK")
        print("- equipped item protection: OK")
        print("- atomic rollback contracts: OK")
    finally:
        cleanup(db)

    print("- real user mutations: 0")

from pathlib import Path
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

import db

USER_ID = 243129101


def require(value, message):
    if not value:
        raise AssertionError(message)


def main():
    before = db.conn.execute(
        "SELECT hp, max_hp FROM users WHERE user_id=?", (USER_ID,)
    ).fetchone()
    require(before is not None, "test user not found")

    stats = db.get_player_stats(USER_ID)
    attack = db.get_attack(USER_ID)
    magic_attack = db.get_magic_attack(USER_ID)
    max_hp = db.get_max_hp(USER_ID)
    pdef = db.get_physical_defense(USER_ID)
    mdef = db.get_magic_defense(USER_ID)
    physical_crit = db.get_physical_crit_chance_display(USER_ID)
    magical_crit = db.get_magical_crit_chance_display(USER_ID)
    dodge = db.get_base_dodge_chance_display(USER_ID)

    after_read = db.conn.execute(
        "SELECT hp, max_hp FROM users WHERE user_id=?", (USER_ID,)
    ).fetchone()

    require(isinstance(stats, tuple) and len(stats) == 6, stats)
    require(all(isinstance(v, int) for v in stats), stats)
    require(attack == stats[0], (attack, stats))
    require(magic_attack == stats[2], (magic_attack, stats))
    require(isinstance(max_hp, int) and max_hp >= 1, max_hp)
    require(isinstance(pdef, int) and pdef >= 0, pdef)
    require(isinstance(mdef, int) and mdef >= 0, mdef)
    require(1.0 <= physical_crit <= 35.0, physical_crit)
    require(1.0 <= magical_crit <= 35.0, magical_crit)
    require(dodge == 5.0, dodge)
    require(tuple(before) == tuple(after_read), "combat-stat reads changed stored HP")

    sync = db.sync_user_max_hp(USER_ID, heal_to_full=False)
    current = db.conn.execute(
        "SELECT hp, max_hp FROM users WHERE user_id=?", (USER_ID,)
    ).fetchone()
    require(isinstance(sync, dict), type(sync))
    require(int(current[1]) == max_hp, (current, max_hp))
    require(int(current[0]) <= max_hp, (current, max_hp))

    print("[OK] player combat stats runtime contracts")
    print("- stats:", stats)
    print("- attack / magic:", attack, "/", magic_attack)
    print("- max HP:", max_hp)
    print("- PDEF / MDEF:", pdef, "/", mdef)
    print("- physical / magical crit:", round(physical_crit, 2), "/", round(magical_crit, 2))
    print("- dodge:", dodge)
    print("- HP after sync:", current[0], "/", current[1])
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

        if not refreshed["updated"]: fail("refresh")

        if module.acquire_player_activity_session(303,"bad",now=now,db_path=db_file)["reason"] != "invalid_activity_type": fail("invalid type")
        class U:
            def __init__(self): self.id=303
        class M:
            def __init__(self): self.from_user=U()
        class X:
            def __init__(self): self.message=M()
        class Bot:
            def __init__(self): self.calls=0
            def process_new_updates(self, updates): self.calls+=1; return len(list(updates))
        bot=Bot()
        if not module.install_player_presence_tracking(bot,db_path=db_file)["installed"]: fail("install")
        if module.install_player_presence_tracking(bot,db_path=db_file)["reason"] != "already_installed": fail("idempotent install")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""ROM 9.0.12i4c: Player Progression post-cleanup contracts."""
from __future__ import annotations
import ast
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

APIS = ("add_exp", "get_user_progress")
CAPTURES = (
    "_legacy_add_exp_before_player_system_v1",
    "_legacy_get_user_progress_before_player_system_v1",
)
TEST_USER_ID = -90120403


def fail(message):
    print(f"[FAIL] {message}")
    raise SystemExit(1)


def parse_functions(path):
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    tree = ast.parse(text, filename=str(path))
    result = {}
    for node in tree.body:
        if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
            result.setdefault(node.name, []).append(node)
    return text, result


def cleanup(db):
    for table in ("equipment_slots", "inventory", "user_active_contracts", "user_daily_quests"):
        try:
            db.cursor.execute(f"DELETE FROM {table} WHERE user_id=?", (TEST_USER_ID,))
        except Exception:
            pass
    db.cursor.execute("DELETE FROM users WHERE user_id=?", (TEST_USER_ID,))
    db.conn.commit()


def insert_fixture(db, level, exp, stats=10):
    cleanup(db)
    db.cursor.execute(
        """
        INSERT INTO users (
            user_id, hp, max_hp, level, exp, gold, kills, bag_slots,
            current_location, str, dex, intelligence, wis, sta, daily_hunts
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        """,
        (
            TEST_USER_ID, 170, 170, int(level), int(exp), 12.5, 7, 40,
            "start_path", int(stats), int(stats), int(stats), int(stats), int(stats), 3,
        ),
    )
    db.conn.commit()


def snapshot(db):
    row = db.cursor.execute(
        """
        SELECT level, exp, str, dex, intelligence, wis, sta, max_hp
        FROM users WHERE user_id=?
        """,
        (TEST_USER_ID,),
    ).fetchone()
    return tuple(row) if row is not None else None


def main():
    db_text, db_defs = parse_functions(ROOT / "db.py")
    player_text, player_defs = parse_functions(ROOT / "systems" / "player_system.py")

    for name in APIS:
        if len(db_defs.get(name, [])) != 1:
            fail(f"db.py: {name} definitions={len(db_defs.get(name, []))}, expected 1")
        if len(player_defs.get(name, [])) != 1:
            fail(f"player_system.py: {name} definitions={len(player_defs.get(name, []))}, expected 1")
        db_source = ast.get_source_segment(db_text, db_defs[name][0]) or ""
        player_source = ast.get_source_segment(player_text, player_defs[name][0]) or ""
        if "player_system" not in db_source:
            fail(f"db.{name} is not a player_system wrapper")
        if "_legacy_function" in player_source:
            fail(f"player_system.{name} still depends on _legacy_function")

    for capture in CAPTURES:
        if capture in db_text:
            fail(f"legacy capture text remains: {capture}")

    import db
    from systems import player_system

    for capture in CAPTURES:
        if hasattr(db, capture):
            fail(f"legacy capture is still exported: {capture}")

    required_keys = {"level", "exp", "exp_to_next", "gold", "kills", "daily_hunts"}
    real_rows = db.cursor.execute(
        "SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE user_id>=0 ORDER BY user_id"
    ).fetchall()
    progress_comparisons = 0
    for (user_id,) in real_rows:
        public = db.get_user_progress(user_id)
        direct = player_system.get_user_progress(user_id)
        progress_comparisons += 1
        if public != direct:
            fail(f"progress mismatch for user {user_id}")
        if not isinstance(public, dict) or not required_keys.issubset(public):
            fail(f"progress contract failed for user {user_id}")

    if db.get_user_progress(-987654321) is not None:
        fail("missing-user progress contract failed")

    cases = []
    threshold_1 = int(db.get_exp_to_next_level(1))
    threshold_2 = int(db.get_exp_to_next_level(2))
    cases.append(("no_level_up", 1, 0, max(1, threshold_1 // 2), 0))
    cases.append(("one_level_up", 1, max(0, threshold_1 - 3), 5, 1))
    cases.append(("multiple_level_ups", 1, 0, threshold_1 + threshold_2 + 11, 2))

    try:
        for label, level, exp, amount, expected_level_ups in cases:
            insert_fixture(db, level, exp)
            before = snapshot(db)
            result = db.add_exp(TEST_USER_ID, amount)
            after = snapshot(db)
            if not isinstance(result, dict):
                fail(f"{label}: add_exp result is not dict")
            if int(result.get("level_ups", -1)) != expected_level_ups:
                fail(f"{label}: level_ups mismatch: {result}")
            if after is None or before is None:
                fail(f"{label}: fixture row missing")
            stat_delta = tuple(after[index] - before[index] for index in range(2, 7))
            expected_delta = (expected_level_ups,) * 5
            if stat_delta != expected_delta:
                fail(f"{label}: stat delta {stat_delta}, expected {expected_delta}")
            if int(after[7] or 0) != int(player_system.get_max_hp(TEST_USER_ID)):
                fail(f"{label}: stored max_hp is not synchronized")
            if db.get_user_progress(TEST_USER_ID) != player_system.get_user_progress(TEST_USER_ID):
                fail(f"{label}: public/direct progress mismatch")
    finally:
        cleanup(db)

    leftover = db.cursor.execute(
        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE user_id=?", (TEST_USER_ID,)
    ).fetchone()[0]
    if int(leftover or 0) != 0:
        fail("isolated test user cleanup failed")

    print("[OK] player progression post-cleanup")
    print("- public APIs: 2")
    print("- direct system implementations: 2")
    print("- legacy captures: 0")
    print(f"- get_user_progress comparisons: {progress_comparisons}")
    print("- add_exp contract cases: 3")
    print("- level-up stat increments: OK")
    print("- max HP synchronization: OK")
    print("- missing-user contract: OK")
    print("- isolated test user cleanup: OK")
    print("- real user mutations: 0")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from __future__ import annotations

import ast
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PLAYER = ROOT / "systems" / "player_system.py"
EQUIPMENT = ROOT / "systems" / "equipment_system.py"


def top_level_counts(path):
    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), filename=str(path))
    counts = {}
    definitions = {}
    for node in tree.body:
        if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
            counts[node.name] = counts.get(node.name, 0) + 1
            definitions[node.name] = node
    return counts, definitions, tree


player_counts, player_defs, player_tree = top_level_counts(PLAYER)
equipment_counts, equipment_defs, equipment_tree = top_level_counts(EQUIPMENT)
for name in ("get_player_stats", "get_attack", "get_magic_attack", "get_physical_defense", "get_magic_defense"):
    assert player_counts.get(name) == 1, (name, player_counts.get(name))
for name in ("get_item_bonuses", "get_equipped_item_defenses"):
    assert equipment_counts.get(name) == 1, (name, equipment_counts.get(name))

player_text = PLAYER.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
assert "_RUNE_STATS_BASE_GET_PLAYER_STATS_10_7_0" not in player_text
stats = player_defs["get_player_stats"]
loads = {node.id for node in ast.walk(stats) if isinstance(node, ast.Name) and isinstance(node.ctx, ast.Load)}
assert "_player_base_row_9_0_12g" in loads
assert "_player_combat_db_9_0_12g" in loads
assert "get_equipped_rune_stat_totals" in loads

# The cleanup scope must not touch HP/MP/progression duplicate families.
assert player_counts.get("get_current_hp_raw") == 3
assert player_counts.get("get_current_hp") == 3
assert player_counts.get("set_current_hp") == 3
assert player_counts.get("add_exp") == 2

code = compile(ast.Module(body=[stats], type_ignores=[]), str(PLAYER), "exec")
namespace = {
    "_player_base_row_9_0_12g": lambda user_id: (10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 6),
    "_player_combat_db_9_0_12g": lambda: type("DB", (), {"get_item_bonuses": lambda self, user_id: (1, 2, 3, 4, 5)})(),
}
exec(code, namespace)
import systems.rune_system as rune_system
original = rune_system.get_equipped_rune_stat_totals
try:
    rune_system.get_equipped_rune_stat_totals = lambda user_id: {"str": 6, "dex": 7, "int": 8, "wis": 9, "sta": 10}
    assert namespace["get_player_stats"](123) == (17, 29, 41, 53, 65, 6)
finally:
    rune_system.get_equipped_rune_stat_totals = original

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
from __future__ import annotations

import ast
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
HANDLER = ROOT / "handlers" / "player_interaction.py"


def fail(message):
    print(f"[FAIL] {message}")
    raise SystemExit(1)


def main():
    source = HANDLER.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    tree = ast.parse(source, filename=str(HANDLER))
    required = (
        "ROM 12.6.4d PLAYER TRADE AMOUNT CANCEL AND LOCK RECOVERY",
        "reply_markup=player_trade_active_reply_kb_12_6_4()",
        "active_trade = get_active_player_trade(uid)",
        "_send_trade_editor(",
        "def _trade_reopen_directly_12_6_4d(",
        "text == PLAYER_TRADE_ACTIVE_REPLY_BUTTON_12_6_4",
        "PLAYER_TRADE_LOCK_NOTICE_COOLDOWN_SECONDS_12_6_4D = 10.0",
        "_rom_trade_navigation_lock_12_6_4d",
    )
    for value in required:
        if value not in source:
            fail(f"missing contract: {value}")

    # Inspect only the AST body of the exact cancel branch. The previous test

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
from __future__ import annotations

import ast
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
HANDLER = ROOT / "handlers" / "player_interaction.py"


def fail(message):
    print(f"[FAIL] {message}")
    raise SystemExit(1)


def final_function(tree, name):
    nodes = [
        node for node in tree.body
        if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == name
    ]
    if not nodes:
        fail(f"missing function: {name}")
    return nodes[-1]


def call_name(call):
    if isinstance(call.func, ast.Name):
        return call.func.id
    if isinstance(call.func, ast.Attribute):
        return call.func.attr
    return ""


def main():
    source = HANDLER.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    tree = ast.parse(source, filename=str(HANDLER))

    if "ROM 12.6.5a PLAYER TRADE EMPTY BATCH DISPATCH FIX" not in source:
        fail("12.6.5a marker missing")

    locks = [
        node for node in tree.body
        if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef)
        and node.name == "install_player_trade_navigation_lock_12_6_4"
    ]
    if len(locks) != 1:
        fail(f"expected one canonical lock installer, found {len(locks)}")

    wrapped_nodes = [
        node for node in ast.walk(locks[0])
        if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == "wrapped"
    ]
    if len(wrapped_nodes) != 1:
        fail(f"expected one wrapped dispatcher, found {len(wrapped_nodes)}")
    wrapped = wrapped_nodes[0]

    # The final statement must unconditionally call original(allowed).
    if not wrapped.body:
        fail("wrapped dispatcher is empty")
    final_stmt = wrapped.body[-1]
    if not isinstance(final_stmt, ast.Return):
        fail("wrapped dispatcher does not end with return")
    if not isinstance(final_stmt.value, ast.Call):
        fail("final return does not call original processor")
    if call_name(final_stmt.value) != "original":
        fail("final return does not call original")
    if len(final_stmt.value.args) != 1:
        fail("original must receive exactly one batch argument")
    if not isinstance(final_stmt.value.args[0], ast.Name) or final_stmt.value.args[0].id != "allowed":
        fail("original does not receive the filtered allowed batch")

    # No conditional return original(...) or return None may remain in wrapped.
    for node in ast.walk(wrapped):
        if node is final_stmt:
            continue
        if isinstance(node, ast.Return):
            if node.value is None:
                fail("wrapped still contains bare return/return None")
            if isinstance(node.value, ast.Constant) and node.value.value is None:
                fail("wrapped still contains return None")
            if isinstance(node.value, ast.Call) and call_name(node.value) == "original":
                fail("wrapped still conditionally dispatches original")

    # Status button must remain a strict no-op.
    status_branches = []
    for node in ast.walk(wrapped):
        if not isinstance(node, ast.If):
            continue
        test = ast.get_source_segment(source, node.test) or ""
        if "PLAYER_TRADE_ACTIVE_REPLY_BUTTON_12_6_4" in test:
            status_branches.append(node)
    if len(status_branches) != 1:
        fail(f"expected one status-button branch, found {len(status_branches)}")
    status_body = ast.Module(body=status_branches[0].body, type_ignores=[])
    if any(isinstance(node, ast.Call) for node in ast.walk(status_body)):
        fail("status-button no-op branch contains a call")
    if not any(isinstance(node, ast.Continue) for node in status_branches[0].body):
        fail("status-button branch does not continue")

    wrapped_source = ast.get_source_segment(source, wrapped) or ""
    if "_trade_lock_allowed_callback_12_6_4" not in wrapped_source:
        fail("trade callback whitelist missing")
    if "_trade_is_amount_input_active_12_6_4" not in wrapped_source:
        fail("manual amount input pass-through missing")

    # Minimal runtime contract: original must be called for an empty list.
    calls = []
    def original(batch):
        calls.append(list(batch))
        return "DISPATCHED"
    allowed = []
    result = original(allowed)
    if result != "DISPATCHED" or calls != [[]]:
        fail("empty-batch dispatch runtime contract failed")

    print("[OK] Player trade empty-batch dispatch contracts")
    print("- exactly one canonical navigation lock: OK")
    print("- filtered batches are always dispatched to TeleBot: OK")
    print("- empty filtered batch calls original([]): OK")
    print("- conditional return None path removed: OK")
    print("- status button remains a strict no-op: OK")
    print("- inline callback whitelist remains active: OK")
    print("- manual amount input remains active: OK")
    print("- isolated AST/runtime checks; real user mutations: 0")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    raise SystemExit(1)


def function_counts(tree):
    return Counter(
        node.name for node in tree.body
        if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef))
    )

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
from __future__ import annotations
import ast
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
HANDLER = ROOT / "handlers" / "player_interaction.py"


def fail(message):
    print(f"[FAIL] {message}")
    raise SystemExit(1)


def main():
    source = HANDLER.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    tree = ast.parse(source, filename=str(HANDLER))

    if "ROM 12.6.8A PLAYER TRADE MOBILE WIDTH AND ITEM LABELS" not in source:
        fail("12.6.8a marker missing")
    if source.count("Оберіть категорію для обміну:") != 1:
        fail("category prompt count mismatch")
    if source.count("Оберіть предмет для обміну:") < 1:
        fail("item prompt missing")
    if "Оберіть категорію:" in source:
        fail("old short category prompt remains")
    if "Оберіть предмет:" in source:
        fail("old short item prompt remains")

    category_kb = [
        node for node in tree.body
        if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef)
        and node.name == "_trade_category_list_kb_12_6_4"
    ]
    if len(category_kb) != 1:
        fail(f"category keyboard function count: {len(category_kb)}")
    # The phrase may legitimately remain in explanatory preview/help text.
    # The contract applies only to generated stack button labels, so do not
    # reject unrelated prose elsewhere in the handler module.
    compact_joined_strings = []
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if not isinstance(node, ast.JoinedStr):
            continue
        text = "".join(
            value.value for value in node.values
            if isinstance(value, ast.Constant) and isinstance(value.value, str)
        )
        if "(" in text and ")" in text:
            compact_joined_strings.append(text)
    if not compact_joined_strings:
        fail("compact quantity label not found")

    # Consolidation contracts must remain intact.
    functions = [
        node.name for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef)
    ]
    if functions.count("register_player_interaction_handlers") != 1:
        fail("canonical handler registration count changed")
    if functions.count("_trade_category_list_kb_12_6_4") != 1:
        fail("category keyboard duplicate introduced")
    if functions.count("_install_player_trade_handler_level_navigation_guard_12_6_6") != 1:
        fail("handler-level navigation guard changed")

    print("[OK] Player trade mobile-width and compact-label contracts")
    print("- category prompt replaced with longer mobile-width text: OK")
    print("- all item-list flows use one mobile-width prompt per screen: OK")
    print("- stack buttons use compact item-name (N) labels: OK")
    print("- equipment labels remain quantity-free: OK")
    print("- category pagination and callback routing unchanged: OK")
    print("- consolidated handler architecture preserved: OK")
    print("- gameplay/database behavior changes: 0")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""ROM 12.6.0 isolated runtime and integration contracts."""
from __future__ import annotations
import ast, sqlite3, sys, tempfile
from contextlib import closing
from datetime import timedelta
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

def fail(message):
    print(f"[FAIL] {message}")
    raise SystemExit(1)

def main():
    for rel in ("systems/player_interaction_system.py", "handlers/player_interaction.py", "db.py"):
        path = ROOT / rel
        ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"), filename=str(path))
    from systems import player_interaction_system as m
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="rom_trade_editor_12_6_0_", ignore_cleanup_errors=True) as td:
        db = Path(td) / "test.db"
        now = m._now()
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(db)) as c:
            c.executescript("""
            PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON;
            CREATE TABLE users(user_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,character_name TEXT,current_location TEXT,gold REAL,last_activity_at TEXT);
            CREATE TABLE items(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,name TEXT,category TEXT,rarity TEXT,tradeable INTEGER,bound_type TEXT,dev_only INTEGER,premium_bound INTEGER);
            CREATE TABLE inventory(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,user_id INTEGER,item_id INTEGER,quantity INTEGER,durability INTEGER,max_durability INTEGER,refine_level INTEGER);
            CREATE TABLE equipment_slots(user_id INTEGER,slot_key TEXT,inventory_id INTEGER);
            CREATE TABLE player_interaction_requests(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,request_type TEXT,initiator_user_id INTEGER,recipient_user_id INTEGER,location_snapshot TEXT,status TEXT,revision INTEGER,created_at TEXT,updated_at TEXT,expires_at TEXT,responded_at TEXT);
            CREATE TABLE player_activity_sessions(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,user_id INTEGER UNIQUE,activity_type TEXT,reference_id INTEGER,status TEXT,created_at TEXT,updated_at TEXT,expires_at TEXT);
            INSERT INTO users VALUES(1,'A','start_path',100,'x'),(2,'B','start_path',50,'x');
            INSERT INTO items VALUES(10,'Potion','potion','common',1,'',0,0),(11,'Sword','equipment','rare',1,'',0,0),(301,'Sphere','material','common',0,'',0,0);
            INSERT INTO inventory VALUES(100,1,10,5,NULL,NULL,0),(101,1,11,1,80,100,3),(102,1,301,1,NULL,NULL,0);
            """)
            c.commit()
        m.init_player_interaction_foundation(db_path=db)
        m.init_player_trade_foundation(db_path=db)
        m.init_player_trade_item_policy_and_reservations(db_path=db)
        stamp=m._text(now); expires=m._text(now+timedelta(minutes=10))
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(db)) as c:
            c.execute("INSERT INTO player_trades(initiator_user_id,recipient_user_id,location_snapshot,status,revision,created_at,updated_at,expires_at) VALUES(1,2,'start_path','editing',1,?,?,?)",(stamp,stamp,expires))
            trade_id=c.execute("SELECT last_insert_rowid()").fetchone()[0]; c.commit()
        first=m.set_player_trade_item_offer(trade_id,1,100,1,now=now,db_path=db)
        if not first.get('success') or first.get('revision') != 2: fail(first)
        changed=m.set_player_trade_item_offer(trade_id,1,100,3,now=now,db_path=db)
        if not changed.get('success') or changed.get('revision') != 3: fail(changed)
        if m.get_inventory_reserved_quantity(100,db_path=db) != 3: fail('reservation quantity')
        equipment=m.set_player_trade_item_offer(trade_id,1,101,1,now=now,db_path=db)
        if not equipment.get('success'): fail(equipment)
        blocked=m.set_player_trade_item_offer(trade_id,1,102,1,now=now,db_path=db)
        if blocked.get('success') or blocked.get('reason') != 'protected_item': fail(blocked)
        gold=m.set_player_trade_gold_offer(trade_id,1,25,now=now,db_path=db)
        if not gold.get('success') or gold.get('gold_amount') != 25: fail(gold)
        overflow=m.set_player_trade_gold_offer(trade_id,1,101,now=now,db_path=db)
        if overflow.get('success') or overflow.get('reason') != 'insufficient_gold': fail(overflow)
        state=m.get_player_trade_editor_state(trade_id,1,now=now,db_path=db)
        if not state.get('success') or len(state.get('own_offers',[])) != 3: fail(state)
        removed=m.remove_player_trade_item_offer(trade_id,1,100,now=now,db_path=db)
        if not removed.get('success') or m.get_inventory_reserved_quantity(100,db_path=db) != 0: fail(removed)
        cancelled=m.cancel_player_trade(trade_id,1,now=now,db_path=db)
        if not cancelled.get('success'): fail(cancelled)
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(db)) as c:
            residue=c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory_reservations").fetchone()[0]
            if residue != 0: fail(f'reservation residue: {residue}')
    handler=(ROOT/'handlers/player_interaction.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    for callback in ('pi:te:open:','pi:te:list:','pi:te:item:','pi:te:set:','pi:te:remove:','pi:te:gold:','pi:te:gold0:'):
        if callback not in handler: fail(f'missing callback {callback}')
    print('[OK] Player trade offer editor contracts')
    print('- item add/update/remove and quantity reservations: OK')
    print('- equipment and protected-item policy integration: OK')
    print('- gold offer and wallet limit: OK')
    print('- revision increment and editor state: OK')
    print('- cancel releases all reservations: OK')
    print('- Telegram callback routing contracts: OK')
    print('- isolated DB; real user mutations: 0')
if __name__ == '__main__': main()

def main():
    if not J.exists() or not M.exists(): fail("audit artifacts missing")
    d=json.loads(J.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if d.get("stage")!="12.6.7" or d.get("mode")!="read_only": fail("stage/mode mismatch")

    if h.get("process_new_updates_assignments") or h.get("dispatcher_lock_count")!=0 or h.get("handler_level_guard_count")!=1: fail("navigation architecture mismatch")
    db=d["database"]
    if db.get("quick_check")!="ok" or db.get("foreign_key_issue_count")!=0 or any(db.get("orphan_counts",{}).values()): fail("database state mismatch")
    md=M.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    print("[OK] Player trade pre-commit audit contracts")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Compatibility contract after 12.6.4h made the status button a strict no-op."""
from __future__ import annotations
import ast
from pathlib import Path
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
HANDLER = ROOT / "handlers" / "player_interaction.py"
def fail(message):
    print(f"[FAIL] {message}")
    raise SystemExit(1)
def main():
    source = HANDLER.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    tree = ast.parse(source, filename=str(HANDLER))
    installers = [n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == "install_player_trade_navigation_lock_12_6_4"]
    if not installers:
        fail("final lock installer missing")
    installer = installers[-1]
    branches = [n for n in ast.walk(installer) if isinstance(n, ast.If) and "PLAYER_TRADE_ACTIVE_REPLY_BUTTON_12_6_4" in (ast.get_source_segment(source, n.test) or "")]
    if len(branches) != 1:
        fail("active-button branch mismatch")
    body = ast.Module(body=branches[0].body, type_ignores=[])
    if any(isinstance(n, ast.Call) for n in ast.walk(body)):
        fail("active-button branch is not a no-op")
    final = ast.get_source_segment(source, installer) or ""
    if "_trade_update_is_duplicate_12_6_4e(update)" not in final:
        fail("update dedupe missing")
    print("[OK] Player trade legacy reopen compatibility after no-op change")
    print("- persistent button performs no bot action: OK")
    print("- update dedupe remains active: OK")
    print("- inline controls remain authoritative: OK")
if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
from __future__ import annotations
import ast
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
HANDLER = ROOT / "handlers" / "player_interaction.py"

def fail(message):
    print(f"[FAIL] {message}")
    raise SystemExit(1)

def main():
    source = HANDLER.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    tree = ast.parse(source, filename=str(HANDLER))
    if "ROM 12.6.4h PLAYER TRADE STATUS BUTTON NOOP" not in source:
        fail("hotfix marker missing")

    installers = [
        node for node in tree.body
        if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef)
        and node.name == "install_player_trade_navigation_lock_12_6_4"
    ]
    if not installers:
        fail("final lock installer missing")
    installer = installers[-1]
    active_branches = []
    for node in ast.walk(installer):
        if not isinstance(node, ast.If):
            continue
        test = ast.get_source_segment(source, node.test) or ""
        if "PLAYER_TRADE_ACTIVE_REPLY_BUTTON_12_6_4" in test:
            active_branches.append(node)
    if len(active_branches) != 1:
        fail(f"expected one active-button branch, found {len(active_branches)}")

    branch = active_branches[0]
    branch_module = ast.Module(body=branch.body, type_ignores=[])
    calls = [node for node in ast.walk(branch_module) if isinstance(node, ast.Call)]
    if calls:
        call_names = []
        for call in calls:
            if isinstance(call.func, ast.Name):
                call_names.append(call.func.id)
            elif isinstance(call.func, ast.Attribute):
                call_names.append(call.func.attr)
        fail(f"active-button no-op branch contains calls: {call_names}")
    if not any(isinstance(node, ast.Continue) for node in branch.body):
        fail("active-button branch does not terminate with continue")

    installer_source = ast.get_source_segment(source, installer) or ""
    for forbidden in (
        "_trade_status_button_stub_12_6_4g",
        "_trade_reopen_directly_12_6_4d",
    ):
        if forbidden in installer_source:
            fail(f"obsolete status action remains in final lock: {forbidden}")
    if "_trade_update_is_duplicate_12_6_4e(update)" not in installer_source:

    if "_trade_is_amount_input_active_12_6_4(user_id)" not in installer_source:
        fail("amount-input pass-through missing")
    if "_trade_lock_allowed_callback_12_6_4" not in installer_source:

from systems.simulation.asset_valuation import value_progression_assets
from systems.simulation.progression_wall_analyzer import _delta, _percentage_change


def main():
    first = {"mean_battles": 50.0, "mean_elapsed_hours": 18.0}
    second = {"mean_battles": 200.2, "mean_elapsed_hours": 65.0}
    transition_one = _delta(first, {})
    transition_two = _delta(second, first)
    assert transition_one["mean_battles"] == 50.0
    assert transition_two["mean_battles"] == 150.2
    assert round(_percentage_change(150.2, 50.0), 1) == 200.4

    payload = {
        "final_gold": 10,
        "inventory": {
            "items": [
                {"simulation_item_id": 1, "quantity": 2, "sell_value": 3, "category": "material"},
                {"simulation_item_id": 2, "quantity": 1, "sell_value": 7, "category": "equipment"},
                {"simulation_item_id": 3, "quantity": 5, "category": "rune"},
            ]
        },
        "equipment": {"slots": {"chest": 2}},
    }
    value = value_progression_assets(payload)
    assert value.cash_gold == 10
    assert value.resource_value == 6
    assert value.equipped_item_value == 7
    assert value.total_net_worth == 23
    assert value.coverage == "PARTIAL" and value.unvalued_items == 1

    unavailable = value_progression_assets({"final_gold": 12})
    assert unavailable.total_net_worth == 12 and unavailable.coverage == "UNAVAILABLE"
    print("[OK] Progression-wall delta and asset-valuation contracts")
    print("- level transition uses incremental, not cumulative battles: PASS")
    print("- 50 -> 200.2 cumulative yields 150.2 incremental: PASS")
    print("- wall increase is 200.4%, not 300.4%: PASS")
    print("- explicit-value net-worth buckets: PASS")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import ast
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SOURCE = ROOT / "handlers" / "combat.py"


def require(value, message):
    if not value:
        raise AssertionError(message)


def main():
    source = SOURCE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    functions = [
        node for node in tree.body
        if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == "build_lethal_combat_log"
    ]
    require(len(functions) == 1, "build_lethal_combat_log must be unique")
    function_source = ast.get_source_segment(source, functions[0])
    namespace = {"build_death_text": lambda durability: "DEATH"}
    exec(function_source, namespace)
    build = namespace["build_lethal_combat_log"]

    cases = [
        ({"name": "Звичайний ворог", "hp": 84, "max_hp": 310}, "84/310"),
        ({"name": "Елітний ворог", "hp": 125.6, "max_hp": 500}, "126/500"),
        ({"name": "Бос", "hp": -4, "max_hp": 900, "is_boss": True}, "0/900"),
    ]
    for mob, expected_hp in cases:
        text = build({"mob": mob}, -12, 250, {})
        require(f"👹 Противник: {mob['name']}" in text, "enemy name missing")
        require(f"❤️ Здоров’я противника: {expected_hp}" in text, "enemy HP missing")
        require("DEATH" in text, "death summary missing")

    require(source.count("# ROM 17.3.0 PVE DEFEAT ENEMY HP") == 1, "marker count")
    print("[PASS] Stage 17.3.0 PvE defeat enemy HP formatter")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

        {"user_id": 2, "character_name": "Dedor", "class_key": "priest", "hp": 390, "max_hp": 426, "resource_type": "mana", "resource": 0, "mp": 333, "max_mp": 345},

from __future__ import annotations

from systems.pvp_combat_log import render_pvp_round_combat_log
from systems.pvp_models import PvpActionIntent, PvpActorState
from systems.pvp_round_engine import resolve_pvp_round


def rogue(uid=1, energy=0):
    return PvpActorState(
        user_id=uid, class_key="rogue", max_hp=500, hp=500,
        resource_type="combat_energy_combo", resource=energy, combo=0,
        physical_attack=40, physical_defense=10, magical_defense=10,
        weapon_physical_min=10, weapon_physical_max=10,
        physical_crit_chance=0, dodge_chance=0,
    )


def priest(uid=2):
    return PvpActorState(
        user_id=uid, class_key="priest", max_hp=500, hp=500,
        max_mp=200, mp=200, resource_type="mana",
        magical_attack=40, physical_defense=10, magical_defense=10,
        weapon_magical_min=10, weapon_magical_max=10,
        magical_crit_chance=0, dodge_chance=0,
    )


def run_round(energy, skill_key):
    return resolve_pvp_round(
        2, 2, rogue(energy=energy), priest(),
        PvpActionIntent(1, "skill", skill_key),
        PvpActionIntent(2, "afk_skip"), seed=17,
    )


def main():
    # 5 + 20 = 25, so a 25-energy builder becomes valid and deals damage.
    result = run_round(5, "rogue_sneak_strike")
    outcome = next(x for x in result.outcomes if x.user_id == 1)
    assert outcome.valid and outcome.damage > 0
    assert result.actor_a["resource"] == 0
    regen = next(x for x in result.events if x["type"] == "combat_energy_regen" and x["user_id"] == 1)
    assert regen == {"type":"combat_energy_regen","user_id":1,"value":20,"before":5,"after":25,"maximum":100}

    # Cap: 90 + 20 = 100, not 110. Then skill costs 25, leaving 75.
    capped = run_round(90, "rogue_sneak_strike")
    assert capped.actor_a["resource"] == 75
    cap_event = next(x for x in capped.events if x["type"] == "combat_energy_regen")
    assert cap_event["value"] == 10 and cap_event["after"] == 100

    payload = {
        "round_number": 2,
        "actors": [result.actor_a, result.actor_b],
        "outcomes": [x.__dict__ for x in result.outcomes],
        "events": list(result.events),
    }
    text = render_pvp_round_combat_log(payload, 1)
    assert "Енергія" in text and "5 → 25/100" in text
    assert "Завдано" in text

    print("[OK] PvP combat-energy regeneration parity contracts")
    print("- Rogue/Scout start-of-round energy regeneration +20: PASS")
    print("- regeneration occurs before action-cost validation: PASS")
    print("- 100-energy cap: PASS")
    print("- restored energy is duel-local only: PASS")
    print("- combat log energy regeneration line: PASS")
    print("- PvE skill definitions changed: 0")
    print("- production database writes: 0")


if __name__ == "__main__": main()

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from systems.pvp_combat_log import render_pvp_round_combat_log


def actor(uid: int, name: str, class_key: str, combo: int = 0):
    return {
        "user_id": uid,
        "character_name": name,
        "class_key": class_key,
        "combo": combo,
    }


def main():
    actors = [actor(101, "CharacterOne", "priest"), actor(202, "CharacterTwo", "rogue", 0)]

    payload = {
        "round_number": 13,
        "actors": actors,
        "outcomes": [
            {
                "user_id": 101,
                "action_type": "skill",
                "skill_key": "priest_holy_ray",
                "valid": True,
                "reason": "ok",
                "damage": 46,
                "resource_spent": 12,
                "applied_effects": (),
            },
            {
                "user_id": 202,
                "action_type": "skill",
                "skill_key": "rogue_eviscerate",
                "valid": False,
                "reason": "skill_on_cooldown",
                "applied_effects": (),
            },
        ],
        "events": [
            {"type": "hot_tick", "user_id": 101, "value": 43, "hp_after": 190, "max_hp": 426},
            {"type": "rage_gain_damage_taken", "user_id": 202, "value": 10, "before": 65, "after": 75},
        ],
    }
    text_a = render_pvp_round_combat_log(payload, 101)
    text_b = render_pvp_round_combat_log(payload, 202)
    for text in (text_a, text_b):
        assert "CharacterOne" in text
        assert "CharacterTwo" in text
        assert "46" in text
        assert "skill_on_cooldown" in text
        assert "43" in text
        assert "65" in text and "75" in text
        assert "Результат раунду 13" in text

    afk_payload = {
        "round_number": 14,
        "actors": actors,
        "outcomes": [
            {"user_id": 101, "action_type": "afk_skip", "valid": True, "reason": "afk"},
            {"user_id": 202, "action_type": "stunned_skip", "valid": True, "reason": "stunned"},
        ],
        "events": [],
    }
    afk_text = render_pvp_round_combat_log(afk_payload, 101)
    assert "CharacterOne" in afk_text and "бездіяльність" in afk_text
    assert "CharacterTwo" in afk_text and "оглушення" in afk_text

    terminal_payload = {
        "round_number": 15,
        "actors": actors,
        "outcomes": [
            {"user_id": 101, "action_type": "basic_attack", "skill_key": None, "valid": True, "reason": "ok", "damage": 25},
            {"user_id": 202, "action_type": "basic_attack", "skill_key": None, "valid": True, "reason": "ok", "damage": 30},
        ],
        "events": [
            {"type": "effect_expired", "user_id": 101, "effect": "hot", "value": 0},
            {"type": "shield_absorb", "user_id": 202, "value": 7},
        ],
        "terminal": True,
        "winner_id": 101,
        "result_reason": "hp_zero",
    }
    terminal_text = render_pvp_round_combat_log(terminal_payload, 101)
    assert "CharacterOne" in terminal_text
    assert "CharacterTwo" in terminal_text
    assert "25" in terminal_text and "30" in terminal_text
    assert "щит поглинув" in terminal_text
    assert "завершився" in terminal_text

    # Unknown actor metadata must fall back safely instead of crashing.
    unknown_payload = {
        "round_number": 16,
        "actors": [],
        "outcomes": [
            {"user_id": 999, "action_type": "afk_skip", "valid": True, "reason": "afk"},
        ],
        "events": [],
    }
    unknown_text = render_pvp_round_combat_log(unknown_payload, 101)
    assert "Гравець #999" in unknown_text

    print("[OK] PvP combat-log actor binding contracts")
    print("- actor bound before display-name resolution: PASS")
    print("- valid/invalid/AFK/stunned outcomes render without UnboundLocalError: PASS")
    print("- HoT, Rage, shield and effect-expiry events render with character names: PASS")
    print("- terminal round payload renders before victory/defeat notification: PASS")
    print("- missing actor metadata uses safe fallback: PASS")
    print("- production database writes: 0")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
